data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：合同的成立与履行

正确答案：B

本题考察的核心是合同法中的要约与承诺 (Offer and Acceptance)，特别是通过履行行为 (Performance) 接受要约的法律后果。

1. 案件的时间线分析 (Timeline Analysis)

钻井工发送未签字表格：
这不是要约 (Offer)，而是要约邀请 (Invitation to Deal)。因为表格明确规定“必须由双方签字才生效”，且钻井工未签字。
开发商签字并寄回：
这是要约 (Offer)。开发商同意了条款并签字，向钻井工发出了缔结合同的请求。
钻井工未签字但开始钻井：
这是承诺 (Acceptance)。尽管表格要求签字，但法律允许通过履行行为来接受要约。

2. 核心法律规则 (Legal Rules)

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 62
当要约邀请受要约人选择“作出承诺”或“履行行为”时，开始履行 (Beginning of Performance) 即构成承诺。

这种承诺具有双重效果：

  • 它构成了对要约的接受，合同正式成立。
  • 它构成了受要约人（钻井工）完成工作的默示允诺 (Implied Promise)。

3. 为什么 B 是正确答案？

虽然合同草案上写着“必须签字才生效”，但法院通常认为：

  • 弃权 (Waiver)： 钻井工是该条款的起草者，他通过开始工作放弃了“必须签字”这一形式要求。
  • 双边合同 (Bilateral Contract)： 当钻井工开始钻井时，他不仅仅是在“试探”，而是在法律上接受了开发商的要约。根据法律规定，开始履行即意味着承诺会完成工作。

因此，钻井工中途停工并要求加价属于违约 (Breach of Contract)，开发商有权获得损害赔偿。

4. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A (错在要约的认定)： 钻井工最初发出的表格不是要约，因为他没有签字，且明确保留了签字权。所以开发商的签字不是承诺，而是发出了要约。
  • 选项 C (错在形式主义)： 虽然表格要求签字，但在合同法中，行为 (Conduct) 可以胜过形式条款。如果一方开始履行，另一方接受履行，合同即成立，未签字的抗辩通常无效。
  • 选项 D (错在合同类型)： 这是一个典型的混淆项。选项D描述的是单边合同 (Unilateral Contract) 的规则（即开始履行产生不可撤销的要约，但不强制完成）。

    但在建筑和劳务背景下，除非明确说明“只有完全做完才算接受”，否则默认视为双边合同 (Bilateral Contract)。一旦开始干活，就必须干完。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到“开始履行” (Commencement of Performance) 的题目时，首先判断是双边合同还是单边合同：
  • 双边 (大多数情况)： 开始履行 = 承诺 + 承诺做完。停工 = 违约。
  • 单边 (如悬赏广告)： 开始履行 = 仅仅阻止要约人撤销。停工 = 不违约（因为没有承诺做完）。
本题是典型的工程服务，属于双边合同逻辑。

questions.question:
A lawn service company agreed in writing to purchase from a supplier all of its requirements for lawn care products during the next calendar year. In the writing, the supplier agreed to fulfill those requirements and to give the company a 10% discount off its published prices, but it reserved the right to increase the published prices during the year. After the parties had performed under the agreement for three months, the supplier notified the company that it would no longer give the company the 10% discount off the published prices.
Does the company have a viable claim against the supplier for breach of contract?

choices.a: No, because the absence of a minimum quantity term rendered the company's promise illusory.
choices.b: No, because the supplier could, and did, revoke its offer with respect to future deliveries.
choices.c: Yes, because part performance of the agreement by both parties made it enforceable for the full year.
choices.d: Yes, because the company's agreement to buy all of its lawn care products from the supplier made the agreement enforceable.

data.questionStem:
Q81131

A lawn service company agreed in writing to purchase from a supplier all of its requirements for lawn care products during the next calendar year. In the writing, the supplier agreed to fulfill those requirements and to give the company a 10% discount off its published prices, but it reserved the right to increase the published prices during the year. After the parties had performed under the agreement for three months, the supplier notified the company that it would no longer give the company the 10% discount off the published prices.

Does the company have a viable claim against the supplier for breach of contract?

一家草坪服务公司书面同意，在下一个日历年度内，向一家供应商采购其所需的全部草坪护理产品。在该书面文件中，供应商同意满足这些需求，并给予该公司其公布价格的10%折扣，但保留了在该年度内提高公布价格的权利。双方根据协议履行了三个月后，供应商通知该公司，将不再给予其公布价格的10%折扣。

该公司是否可以向供应商提出可行的违约索赔？
options:
A. No, because the absence of a minimum quantity term rendered the company's promise illusory.
否，因为缺乏最低数量条款使得该公司的承诺虚幻不实。

B. No, because the supplier could, and did, revoke its offer with respect to future deliveries.
否，因为供应商可以，并且事实上已经撤销了其关于未来交付的要约。

C. Yes, because part performance of the agreement by both parties made it enforceable for the full year.
是，因为双方对协议的部分履行使其在整个年度内均可强制执行。

D. Yes, because the company's agreement to buy all of its lawn care products from the supplier made the agreement enforceable.
是，因为该公司同意向该供应商购买其全部草坪护理产品，这使得该协议可强制执行。
data.explanation:
Contract terms for sale of goods


(Article 2 UCC) TermsRequirementsEffect if missing
Goods to be soldMust be reasonably identifiedNo contract
QuantityMust be certain or able to be made certain by reference to objective factsNo contract
PriceN/AGap-filler: reasonable price at time of delivery
Time of deliveryN/AGap-filler: reasonable time
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs contracts for the sale of goods. Under the UCC, an offer becomes irrevocable once it is accepted. The resulting contract must contain definite terms that:
  • reasonably identify the goods to be sold and

  • specify a quantity of goods to be sold that is certain or capable of being made certain by reference to objective facts.

The quantity term is sufficiently definite in a requirements contract - ie, a contract for the sale of as many goods as the buyer needs during a specified period - because the buyer's actual requirements can be determined objectively.

Here, the lawn service company and the supplier entered into a requirements contract wherein the lawn service company agreed to buy all of its lawn care products from the supplier for one year at a 10% discount. Although this contract did not contain a certain quantity, the terms were sufficiently definite because the company's actual requirements could be determined objectively. Therefore, the contract was enforceable for its entire one-year term, and the supplier breached the contract by refusing to give the discount three months later (Choice B).

(Choice A) A promise is illusory, and therefore unenforceable, if the promisor has discretion whether to perform at all (eg, X promises to buy such goods as X wishes to order from Y). But here, the absence of a minimum quantity term does not render the company's promise illusory since it is still required to buy (and the supplier is still required to sell) all lawn care products it actually needs.

(Choice C) A contract whose terms would otherwise be too vague to be enforced may become enforceable based on part performance if the parties' subsequent acts supply the needed clarification of the terms (not needed here).

Educational objective: Contracts for the sale of goods must specify a quantity of goods to be sold that is certain or capable of being made certain by reference to objective facts - eg, the buyer's actual requirements for a product can be used to determine quantity under a requirements contract.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 24%，C选项 15%，D选项 56%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

货物销售合同条款


(UCC 第二条) 条款要求缺失的后果
待售货物必须被合理地识别无合同
数量必须是确定的，或能够通过参照客观事实来确定无合同
价格不适用补缺条款：交货时的合理价格
交货时间不适用补缺条款：合理时间
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code。

Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) 第二条管辖货物销售合同。根据 UCC，要约一旦被接受即不可撤销。由此产生的合同必须包含明确的条款，这些条款：
  • 合理地识别待售货物并且

  • 明确规定一个待售货物的数量，该数量是确定的或能够通过参照客观事实来确定。

在需求合同中，数量条款是足够明确的——即，在指定期间内，销售买方所需数量货物的合同——因为买方的实际需求可以被客观地确定。

在本案中，草坪服务公司与供应商签订了一份需求合同，其中草坪服务公司同意在一年内以10%的折扣向该供应商购买其所需的全部草坪护理产品。尽管该合同没有包含确定的数量，但其条款是足够明确的，因为公司的实际需求可以被客观地确定。因此，该合同在其整个一年期限内均可强制执行，而供应商在三个月后拒绝给予折扣，构成了违约 (选项 B)。

(选项 A) 承诺如果是虚幻的，则不可强制执行。如果承诺人对是否履行拥有自由裁量权（例如，X 承诺向 Y 购买其希望订购的货物），那么该承诺就是虚幻的。但在本案中，缺乏最低数量条款并不使公司的承诺变得虚幻，因为它仍然被要求购买（且供应商仍然被要求出售）其所有实际需要的草坪护理产品。

(选项 C) 如果一个合同的条款原本因过于模糊而无法强制执行，但若双方的后续行为对条款进行了必要的澄清，则该合同可能因部分履行而变得可强制执行（本案中不需要）。

教学目标：货物销售合同必须明确规定待售货物的数量，该数量必须是确定的，或能够通过参照客观事实来确定——例如，在需求合同下，买方对产品的实际需求可用于确定数量。

References

U.C.C. § 2-306 cmt. 2 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that the quantity term is sufficiently definite in output and requirements contracts).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Sales (UCC Art. 2)
正确答案：D
核心考点：需求合同 (Requirements Contracts) 在《统一商法典》(UCC) 下，买方承诺购买其所需的“全部”货物，即使没有具体的数字，该合同也是可强制执行的。
法律依据与推理
本题考察的是 UCC Article 2 关于货物销售合同中“数量条款”确定性的问题。
1. 一般规则：
通常，合同必须包含明确的数量条款才能成立。如果数量不确定，合同往往无效。
2. 例外规则 - 需求合同 (UCC § 2-306)：
当买方同意从卖方处购买其全部需求 (All Requirements) 时，虽然具体的数量未知，但法律认为这是“足够明确”的。
  • 确定性： 数量可以通过参考客观事实（买方的实际运营需求）来确定。
  • 对价 (Consideration)： 买方放弃了从其他供应商处购买的权利，这种“排他性”构成了有效的法律受损 (Legal Detriment)，因此合同不是虚幻的。
3. 本案应用：
草坪服务公司书面同意购买其“全部需求”。这构成了一个有效的需求合同。因此，供应商不能单方面撤销折扣，必须在整个合同年度内履行约定。
干扰项辨析
为什么 A 错误？ (Illusory Promise)
选项 A 认为没有“最低数量”导致承诺是虚幻的 (Illusory)。这是错误的。只要买方承诺排他性地向该卖方购买（即“不向别人买”），这就构成了有效的对价。只有当买方说“我想买多少就买多少，也可以向别人买”时，才是虚幻的。
为什么 B 错误？ (Revocation)
选项 B 混淆了“要约 (Offer)”和“合同 (Contract)”。一旦双方达成协议并开始履行，这就不仅仅是一个可以随时撤销的要约，而是一个具有约束力的合同。供应商无权单方面修改价格条款（除非合同中有特定允许的条款，但本题中供应商只是保留提高“公布价格”的权利，而非取消“折扣”本身的权利）。
MBE 考试技巧
在处理 UCC 货物销售题目时，看到 "all its requirements" (全部需求) 或 "all its output" (全部产出) 的字眼：
  1. 立即识别为 Requirements Contract 或 Output Contract。
  2. 记住：尽管没有具体数字，它们是有效的。
  3. 关键在于Good Faith (诚实信用)：买方不能恶意地大幅改变需求量来利用市场价格波动。

questions.question:
A toy collector purchased 10 antique toys over several years and had had them restored by an expert in toy restoration. On June 1, the collector sent an 11th antique toy to the expert with a signed note that read: "Here is another toy for you to restore. As with all prior jobs, I will pay $500 for the work, but no more." On June 4, after receipt of the collector's June 1 note and the toy, the expert began restoring the toy. On June 6, the collector unexpectedly died. On June 7, unaware of the collector's death, the expert sent the collector a note that stated that the restoration work had begun on June 4. The following day, the expert learned of the collector's death.
Does a contract exist that binds the expert and the collector's estate?

choices.a: No, because the collector died before the expert sent the June 7 note.
choices.b: No, because the offer lapsed when the collector died.
choices.c: Yes, because the expert sent the June 7 note before learning of the collector's death.
choices.d: Yes, because the offer was accepted before the collector's death.

Q81809 A toy collector purchased 10 antique toys over several years and had had them restored by an expert in toy restoration. On June 1, the collector sent an 11th antique toy to the expert with a signed note that read: "Here is another toy for you to restore. As with all prior jobs, I will pay $500 for the work, but no more." On June 4, after receipt of the collector's June 1 note and the toy, the expert began restoring the toy. On June 6, the collector unexpectedly died. On June 7, unaware of the collector's death, the expert sent the collector a note that stated that the restoration work had begun on June 4. The following day, the expert learned of the collector's death.

Does a contract exist that binds the expert and the collector's estate? 一名玩具收藏家在几年间购买了10件古董玩具，并请一位玩具修复专家对它们进行了修复。6月1日，该收藏家将第11件古董玩具寄给这位专家，并附上一张亲笔签名的便条，上面写着：“这是另一件给您修复的玩具。与之前所有工作一样，我将为此工作支付500美元，不能再多。” 6月4日，专家在收到收藏家6月1日的便条和玩具后，开始修复该玩具。6月6日，收藏家意外去世。6月7日，专家在不知道收藏家已去世的情况下，给收藏家寄去一张便条，称修复工作已于6月4日开始。第二天，专家得知了收藏家的死讯。 是否存在一份对专家和收藏家遗产具有约束力的合同？
options:
A. No, because the collector died before the expert sent the June 7 note.
不存在，因为收藏家在专家发送6月7日的便条之前就已去世。

B. No, because the offer lapsed when the collector died.
不存在，因为要约因收藏家去世而失效。

C. Yes, because the expert sent the June 7 note before learning of the collector's death.
存在，因为专家在得知收藏家去世之前发送了6月7日的便条。

D. Yes, because the offer was accepted before the collector's death.
存在，因为要约在收藏家去世前已被接受。
data.explanation:
Bilateral v. Unilateral contracts


OfferEffect of beginning performance
UnilateralInvites acceptance by performance of actCreates option contract that prevents offeror from revoking offer
Offeree is not bound to complete performance
BilateralInvites acceptance by return promiseServes as acceptance of offer
Offeree is bound to complete performance
Contract formation requires mutual assent (ie, offer and acceptance). An offer that invites acceptance by return promise—or an offer that does not specify a manner of acceptance—can be accepted by either (1) promising to perform the requested act or (2) performing the requested act. Acceptance by performance is effective as soon as the offeree begins to perform.† However, the offeror is not obligated to perform until receiving notice of the acceptance. And if the offeror dies prior to acceptance, the offer will terminate by law.

Here, the toy collector offered to pay the restoration expert $500 in exchange for the restoration of an antique toy. The expert accepted that offer by beginning to restore the toy on June 4—before the collector's death on June 6. Therefore, a contract exists that binds the expert and the collector's estate.

†Unlike in a bilateral contract, in a unilateral contract, only the offeree's complete performance constitutes acceptance.

(Choices A, B & C) The offer would have terminated by law if the collector had died before acceptance. But the expert began to perform (acceptance) before the collector's death. Therefore, a binding contract existed regardless of whether the collector died before the expert sent the note or the expert sent the note before learning of the collector's death.

Educational objective: Unless an offer specifies a manner of performance, it can be accepted by (1) promising to perform the requested act or (2) performing the requested act. Acceptance by performance is effective as soon as the offeree begins to perform, but the offeror is not obligated to perform until receiving notice of the acceptance.

双边合同与单边合同


要约开始履行的效果
单边合同以履行行为的方式邀请承诺创建一份选择权合同，阻止要约人撤销要约
受要约人没有义务完成履行
双边合同以作出对待承诺的方式邀请承诺构成对要约的承诺
受要约人有义务完成履行
合同的成立需要双方合意（即要约和承诺）。一项邀请以作出对待承诺方式作出承诺的要约——或一项未指定承诺方式的要约——可以通过以下任一方式承诺：（1）承诺履行所要求的行为，或（2）履行所要求的行为。以履行方式作出的承诺，在受要约人一开始履行时即生效。† 但是，在收到承诺通知之前，要约人没有义务履行。并且，如果要在承诺前去世，要约将依法终止。

在本案中，玩具收藏家要约支付修复专家500美元，以换取一件古董玩具的修复工作。专家于6月4日——在收藏家6月6日去世前——通过开始修复玩具而承诺了该要约。因此，存在一份对专家和收藏家遗产具有约束力的合同。

†与双边合同不同，在单边合同中，只有受要约人完成履行才构成承诺。

(选项 A、B 和 C) 如果收藏家在承诺前去世，要约本会依法终止。但专家在收藏家去世前就开始履行（承诺）。因此，无论收藏家是在专家发送便条前去世，还是专家在得知收藏家死讯前发送便条，一份具有约束力的合同都已存在。

教学目的： 除非要约指定了承诺方式，否则可以通过以下方式承诺：（1）承诺履行所要求的行为，或（2）履行所要求的行为。以履行方式作出的承诺，在受要约人一开始履行时即生效，但在收到承诺通知之前，要约人没有义务履行。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 32 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an offer generally invites acceptance by either performing or promising to perform).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 62 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the beginning of performance is an acceptance that obligates the offeree to complete the performance).

MBE 合同法解析

Contracts: Offer & Acceptance
正确答案：D

存在合同，因为要约在收藏家去世前已被接受。

📅 关键时间轴 (Timeline)
6月1日 (June 1)
收藏家发出要约 (Offer sent)。
6月4日 (June 4)
合同成立时刻：专家开始修复工作 (Begins performance)。
此处构成承诺 (Acceptance)。
6月6日 (June 6)
收藏家去世。但因合同已于6月4日成立，死亡不影响合同效力。
6月7日 (June 7)
专家发出通知。这是履行后的通知义务，而非承诺生效时刻。
⚖️ 法律原理 (Legal Analysis)

1. 要约的性质 (Nature of the Offer)
本题中的要约并未明确规定必须通过“承诺”还是“履行”来接受。根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 32，当要约未指定承诺方式时，受要约人可以选择通过承诺履行 (promise to perform) 或 开始履行 (beginning performance) 来进行承诺。

2. 开始履行的效力 (Effect of Beginning Performance)
根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 62，在上述情况下，受要约人一旦开始履行 (begins to perform)，即构成承诺。这不仅接受了要约，还构成了一份双务合同 (Bilateral Contract)，即受要约人同时也隐含承诺了会完成工作。

3. 死亡的影响 (Effect of Death)
一般规则是：要约人在承诺生效前死亡，要约失效 (Lapse of Offer)。
但是，如果合同在死亡前已经成立，死亡通常不会终止合同（除非是必须由死者亲自履行的个人服务合同）。本案中，合同在6月4日专家动工时已成立，6月6日的死亡发生在合同成立之后，因此合同有效，约束遗产管理人。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A & B： 错误地认为合同尚未成立。如果专家在6月6日之前没有采取任何行动，那么收藏家的死亡确实会让要约失效。但专家在6月4日已经通过行为接受了要约。
  • 选项 C： 错误地将“寄出便条”作为承诺生效的时间点。虽然通知是必要的，但在本案法律规则下，开始履行这一行为本身就是承诺的生效点。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，除非要约明确规定“只有完全履行才能构成承诺”（即典型的单边合同 Unilateral Contract，如悬赏广告），否则法院倾向于适用双边合同 (Bilateral Contract) 规则。

记住："Start of performance = Acceptance"（开始履行即承诺）。这不仅保护了开始干活的受要约人，也防止要约人随意撤销。

questions.question:
In January, a garden center contacted a farmer who owned a greenhouse about growing seedlings for sale in the spring. The garden center promised in writing to buy, at a fixed price, all of the seedlings that the farmer raised in his greenhouse. As a consequence, a few days later the farmer purchased containers and seeds and hired a worker to prepare the containers, plant the seeds, and tend to the seedlings. Later that week, he emailed the garden center to tell it he had taken these actions. Just prior to the delivery of any seedlings, the garden center notified the farmer that it would not purchase any of the seedlings. The farmer sold the seedlings at a price far below the price set by the garden center.
The farmer filed a breach of contract action to recover damages.
Will the farmer likely succeed?

choices.a: No, because the garden center did not receive consideration for its promise to buy the farmer's output.
choices.b: No, because the garden center revoked its offer before it was accepted by the farmer.
choices.c: Yes, because the doctrine of promissory estoppel made the offer irrevocable.
choices.d: Yes, because the farmer accepted the garden center's offer by beginning performance.

一月，一家园艺中心联系了一位拥有温室的农场主，商议为春季销售培育幼苗。该园艺中心书面承诺，将以固定价格购买该农场主在其温室中培育的所有幼苗。因此，几天后，该农场主购买了容器和种子，并雇佣了一名工人来准备容器、播种和照料幼苗。在那周晚些时候，他通过电子邮件告知园艺中心他已采取了这些行动。就在任何幼苗交付之前，园艺中心通知农场主，他们将不会购买任何幼苗。农场主以远低于园艺中心设定价格的价格出售了这些幼苗。

农场主提起了违约诉讼以寻求损害赔偿。

该农场主可能会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the garden center did not receive consideration for its promise to buy the farmer's output.
不会，因为园艺中心为其购买农场主产出的承诺没有收到对价。

B. No, because the garden center revoked its offer before it was accepted by the farmer.
不会，因为园艺中心在农场主接受之前撤销了其要约。

C. Yes, because the doctrine of promissory estoppel made the offer irrevocable.
会，因为 promissory estoppel 原则使得该要约不可撤销。

D. Yes, because the farmer accepted the garden center's offer by beginning performance.
会，因为农场主通过开始履行接受了园艺中心的要约。
data.explanation:
Contract formation requires mutual assent, which occurs upon acceptance of an offer to enter a contract. Unless an offer specifies that it can only be accepted by performance (ie, unilateral contract), it can be accepted by promising or beginning performance. If acceptance is made by beginning performance, the offeree must notify the offeror within a reasonable time that performance has begun. Failure to do so will result in a lapse of the offer.

Here, the garden center promised to buy all the seedlings raised by the farmer. Since the farmer began to raise the seedlings - eg, by purchasing containers and seeds and by hiring a worker to tend the seedlings - the farmer accepted the garden center's offer by beginning performance. And since the farmer notified the garden center of this acceptance within a reasonable time ("later that week"), the garden center could not subsequently revoke its offer and refuse to buy the seedlings (Choice B). Therefore, the farmer will likely succeed.

(Choice A) The garden center did receive consideration because its promise induced the farmer's reciprocal commitment to produce and sell the seedlings.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, an offer may become irrevocable if the offeree reasonably and detrimentally relies on it before acceptance. But this doctrine does not apply here since acceptance occurred, and a contract was formed, when the farmer began to raise the seedlings and notified the garden center.

Educational objective: Unless an offer specifies that it can only be accepted by performance, it can be accepted by promising or beginning performance. An offeree who accepts by beginning performance must notify the offeror within a reasonable time that performance has begun.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 3%，C选项 32%，D选项 62%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同的成立需要双方合意，而合意在为订立合同而接受要约时达成。除非要约明确规定只能通过履行来接受（即单方合同），否则可以通过承诺或开始履行来接受。如果通过开始履行作出接受，受要约人必须在合理时间内通知要约人履行已经开始。未能如此行事将导致要约失效。

在本案中，园艺中心承诺购买农场主培育的所有幼苗。由于农场主已经开始培育幼苗——例如，购买容器和种子，并雇佣工人照料幼苗——农场主通过开始履行接受了园艺中心的要约。并且，由于农场主在合理时间内（“在那周晚些时候”）通知了园艺中心此项接受，园艺中心不能随后撤销其要约并拒绝购买幼苗（选项B）。因此，农场主可能会胜诉。

（选项A） 园艺中心确实收到了对价，因为它的承诺引出了农场主生产和销售幼苗的对应承诺。

（选项C） 根据 promissory estoppel 原则，如果在接受之前，受要约人合理地、有损害地依赖了该要约，则该要约可能变得不可撤销。但此原则在此不适用，因为当农场主开始培育幼苗并通知园艺中心时，接受已经发生，合同已经成立。

教学目标：除非要约明确规定只能通过履行来接受，否则可以通过承诺或开始履行来接受。通过开始履行作出接受的受要约人必须在合理时间内通知要约人履行已经开始。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Formation
正确答案
选项 D
会，因为农场主通过开始履行接受了园艺中心的要约。
核心考点：要约的接受 (Acceptance)

本题考察的是在货物买卖合同（适用 UCC Article 2）中，如何通过开始履行（Beginning Performance）来接受要约。

法律规则：

  • 一般规则： 除非要约明确规定只能通过某种特定方式接受，否则要约邀请受要约人以任何合理的方式接受。
  • 通过履行接受： 受要约人可以通过承诺（Promise）或开始履行（Beginning Performance）来接受要约。
  • 通知义务： 如果通过开始履行来接受，受要约人必须在合理时间内通知要约人，否则要约人可以将要约视为失效。
案情推演

让我们将规则应用到本案事实中：

  1. 要约存在： 园艺中心书面承诺购买所有幼苗（这是一个 Output Contract，有效）。
  2. 接受行为： 农场主购买容器、种子并雇佣工人。这构成了开始履行。此时，接受已经发生，合同成立。
  3. 通知要件： 农场主在“那周晚些时候”发邮件告知了园艺中心。这是在合理时间内的有效通知。
  4. 撤销无效： 园艺中心试图撤销要约发生在合同成立之后。一旦合同成立，单方面撤销（Revocation）即构成违约。

因此，农场主胜诉的基础是合同已经通过“开始履行+通知”的方式成立。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (No Consideration)：错误。
本案属于产出合同 (Output Contract)。虽然数量不确定（“所有幼苗”），但在 UCC 下，买方承诺购买卖方生产的全部产品，卖方承诺全部卖给买方，这种互惠承诺（Mutuality of Obligation）构成了有效的对价（Consideration）。
❌ 选项 B (Revocation)：错误。
撤销必须发生在接受之前。如上所述，农场主开始履行并通知时，接受已经完成。随后的撤销是无效的。
❌ 选项 C (Promissory Estoppel)：错误。
这是一个常见的陷阱选项。Promissory Estoppel（不得反悔原则/允诺禁反言）通常用于没有有效合同但一方因信赖承诺而受损的情况。
在本案中，因为已经通过履行成立了正式合同，所以不需要退而求其次使用 Promissory Estoppel。虽然结果也是赢，但法律依据不如 D 准确。
💡 MBE 考试通关秘籍

区分“单方合同”与“双方合同”的接受方式：

除非题目明确说“此要约只能通过完全履行来接受”（Unilateral Contract），否则在 MBE 中，大多数要约都被视为可以通过“承诺”或“开始履行”来接受。

一旦受要约人开始履行，合同通常即告成立（对于双方合同），要约人就不能再撤销了。

questions.question:
On July 18, a shovel manufacturer received an order for the purchase of 500 snow shovels from a wholesaler. The wholesaler had mailed the purchase order on July 15. The order required shipment of the shovels no earlier than September 15 and no later than October 15. Typed conspicuously across the front of the order form was the following: "Wholesaler reserves the right to cancel this order at any time before September 1." The manufacturer's mailed response, "We accept your order," was received by the wholesaler on July 21.
As of July 22, which of the following is an accurate statement as to whether a contract was formed?

choices.a: A contract was formed, but prior to September 1 it was an option contract terminable only at the will of the wholesaler.
choices.b: A contract was formed, but prior to September 1 it was terminable at the will of either party.
choices.c: No contract was formed, because of the wholesaler's reservation of the right to cancel.
choices.d: No contract was formed, because the wholesaler's order was only a revocable offer.

data.questionStem:
Q81066

On July 18, a shovel manufacturer received an order for the purchase of 500 snow shovels from a wholesaler. The wholesaler had mailed the purchase order on July 15. The order required shipment of the shovels no earlier than September 15 and no later than October 15. Typed conspicuously across the front of the order form was the following: "Wholesaler reserves the right to cancel this order at any time before September 1." The manufacturer's mailed response, "We accept your order," was received by the wholesaler on July 21.

As of July 22, which of the following is an accurate statement as to whether a contract was formed?

7月18日，一家铲雪锹制造商收到了一家批发商购买500把铲雪锹的订单。该批发商于7月15日邮寄了该采购订单。订单要求铲雪锹的发货时间不早于9月15日，不晚于10月15日。在订单表格的正面显眼处打印着以下文字："批发商保留在9月1日之前随时取消此订单的权利。" 制造商邮寄的回应“我们接受您的订单”于7月21日被批发商收到。

截至7月22日，关于合同是否成立，以下哪项陈述是准确的？
options:
A. A contract was formed, but prior to September 1 it was an option contract terminable only at the will of the wholesaler.
合同已经成立，但在9月1日之前，它是一个选择权合同，只能由批发商单方面意愿终止。

B. A contract was formed, but prior to September 1 it was terminable at the will of either party.
合同已经成立，但在9月1日之前，任何一方都可以根据自己的意愿终止合同。

C. No contract was formed, because of the wholesaler's reservation of the right to cancel.
没有成立合同，因为批发商保留了取消的权利。

D. No contract was formed, because the wholesaler's order was only a revocable offer.
没有成立合同，因为批发商的订单只是一个可撤销的要约。
data.explanation:
Consideration problems that prevent contract formation


GiftNo bargained-for exchange
Token considerationNo inducement to bargain if performance entirely devoid of value
Sham considerationNo legal detriment & no inducement to bargain if recited performance not intended to be completed
Preexisting duty / past considerationNo legal detriment if performance already owed or completed
Illusory promiseNo legal detriment if apparent promise imposes no obligation
Under the UCC, which governs contracts for the sale of goods, contract formation requires:
  • mutual assent - an offer and acceptance and
  • valuable consideration - a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance.

Once a contract is formed, it cannot be terminated unilaterally (Choice B). But if either party's promise is illusory because it imposes no obligation on that party, then there is no consideration and no contract.

Here, the wholesaler sent a purchase order to the shovel manufacturer and received a mailed acceptance on July 21. But the purchase order imposed no obligation on the wholesaler because it reserved the right to cancel at any time before September 1. As a result, the wholesaler's promise to purchase shovels was illusory. Due to this lack of consideration, no contract was formed as of July 22.

(Choice A) An option is a type of contract in which one party promises to hold a separate offer open for a specified time in return for consideration. Here, however, there was no promise to hold the offer open for any amount of time. And if an option contract had formed, it would not be terminable at the will of either party.

(Choice D) Offers are revocable prior to acceptance (with a few exceptions), so the revocability of an offer does not prevent contract formation. But since the wholesaler reserved the right to cancel (ie, revoke) at any time before September 1, its illusory promise to purchase shovels prevented contract formation.

Educational objective: An illusory promise is one that imposes no obligation on the promising party and therefore fails to provide the consideration needed for contract formation.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 36%，B选项 11%，C选项 43%（正确选项），D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

阻碍合同成立的对价问题


赠与不存在交易磋商的交换
象征性对价如果履行完全没有价值，则不存在交易引诱
虚假对价如果所述履行无意完成，则不存在法律上的损害和交易引诱
先前存在的义务 / 过去的对价如果履行是已经负有或已完成的义务，则不存在法律上的损害
虚幻的承诺如果表面上的承诺未施加任何义务，则不存在法律上的损害
根据管辖货物销售合同的UCC，合同成立需要：
  • 双方合意 - 即一个要约和承诺 以及
  • 有价对价 - 即经交易磋商达成的承诺或履行的交换。

一旦合同成立，就不能单方面终止（选项B）。但如果任何一方的承诺是虚幻的，因为它没有给该方施加任何义务，那么就没有对价，也没有合同。

在本案中，批发商向铲雪锹制造商发出了采购订单，并于7月21日收到了邮寄的承诺。但该采购订单并未对批发商施加任何义务，因为它保留了在9月1日之前的任何时间取消订单的权利。因此，批发商购买铲雪锹的承诺是虚幻的。由于缺乏对价，截至7月22日，合同并未成立。

（选项A） 选择权合同是一种合同类型，其中一方承诺在特定时间内保持一个独立的要约为有效，以换取对价。然而，在本案中，并没有承诺在任何时间内保持要约为有效。并且，如果选择权合同成立，任何一方都不能随意终止。

（选项D） 要约在被承诺前是可撤销的（少数例外情况除外），因此要约的可撤销性本身并不妨碍合同的成立。但由于批发商保留了在9月1日之前的任何时间取消（即撤销）的权利，其购买铲雪锹的虚幻承诺阻碍了合同的成立。

教学目的：虚幻的承诺是指未对承诺方施加任何义务的承诺，因此未能提供合同成立所需的对价。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 77 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an apparent promise is not consideration if it makes performance entirely optional).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Formation
核心概念：虚幻承诺

Illusory Promise

如果一方的承诺完全取决于其自身的意愿，且未对该方施加任何实际的法律义务（Legal Detriment），则该承诺是“虚幻的”。虚幻承诺不能构成有效的对价（Consideration）。

案情关键点分析

本案适用《统一商法典》（UCC），因为涉及货物（铲雪锹）的买卖。

  • 关键条款：批发商保留在9月1日之前随时取消订单的权利。
  • 时间点：题目询问的是7月22日的状态（此时在9月1日之前）。
  • 法律后果：批发商拥有“不受限制的退出权”（Unfettered right to exit）。这意味着批发商实际上并没有承诺购买任何东西。
为什么选 C？
✅ 选项 C：没有成立合同，因为批发商保留了取消的权利。

合同成立的核心要素是对价 (Consideration)，即双方必须存在“讨价还价的交换”（Bargained-for exchange）。

在本案中：

  1. 制造商承诺出售铲子。
  2. 批发商表面上承诺购买，但附加了一个条款：它可以随时取消，没有任何惩罚或限制。

这种承诺被称为虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise)。因为批发商实际上没有承担任何义务（No Mutuality of Obligation），所以不存在有效的对价。没有对价，合同就不成立。

其他选项为何错误
❌ 选项 A & B：认为合同已成立

这两个选项的前提都是“合同已成立”。但由于缺乏对价（Consideration），合同自始至终未成立。此外，选项A提到的“选择权合同”（Option Contract）需要为“保持要约开放”这一行为支付额外的对价，本案中不存在。

❌ 选项 D：归咎于“可撤销的要约”

这是一个干扰项。虽然要约通常是可撤销的（Revocable），但一旦受要约人（制造商）发出承诺（Acceptance），合同通常就会成立。本案无法成立合同的原因不是因为要约本身可撤销，而是因为要约的内容（承诺的内容）是虚幻的，导致缺乏对价。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在合同法题目中，当你看到"Right to cancel at any time"（随时取消权）且没有任何限制（如通知期、特定条件）时，警惕虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise)。

区分点：
1. 随时取消 = 无合同（本题情况）。
2. 需提前10天通知取消 = 有合同（因为这10天的通知期构成了法律上的损害/义务）。

questions.question:
A construction company contracted with a regional distributor to construct for $500,000 a warehouse and a driveway at highway level. Shortly after commencing work on the driveway, which required for the specified level some excavation and removal of surface material, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock.
The construction company informed the distributor (accurately) that because of the rock, the driveway as specified would cost at least $20,000 more than figured and demanded for that reason a total contract price of $520,000. Since the distributor was expecting warehousing customers immediately after the agreed completion date, he signed a writing promising to pay the additional $20,000. Following timely completion of the warehouse and driveway, which conformed to the contract in all respects, the distributor refused to pay the construction company more than $500,000.
What is the maximum amount to which the construction company is entitled?

choices.a: $500,000, because the distributor's promise to pay the additional $20,000 was exacted under duress.
choices.b: $500,000, because there was no consideration for the distributor's promise to pay the additional $20,000.
choices.c: $520,000, because the modification was fair and was made in the light of circumstances not anticipated by the parties when the original contract was made.
choices.d: $520,000, provided that the reasonable value of the construction company's total performance was that much or more.

data.questionStem:
Q81119

A construction company contracted with a regional distributor to construct for $500,000 a warehouse and a driveway at highway level. Shortly after commencing work on the driveway, which required for the specified level some excavation and removal of surface material, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock.

The construction company informed the distributor (accurately) that because of the rock, the driveway as specified would cost at least $20,000 more than figured and demanded for that reason a total contract price of $520,000. Since the distributor was expecting warehousing customers immediately after the agreed completion date, he signed a writing promising to pay the additional $20,000. Following timely completion of the warehouse and driveway, which conformed to the contract in all respects, the distributor refused to pay the construction company more than $500,000.

What is the maximum amount to which the construction company is entitled?

一家建筑公司与一家区域经销商签订合同，以500,000美元的价格建造一个仓库和一条与公路齐平的车道。在开始修建车道后不久——该工程为达到指定高度需要进行一些挖掘和地表材料的清除——建筑公司意外地遇到了一大块坚硬的岩石。

建筑公司（准确地）告知经销商，由于这块岩石，按规定修建车道的成本将比预算至少高出20,000美元，并因此要求合同总价为520,000美元。由于经销商预计在约定的完工日期后立即有仓储客户入住，他签署了一份书面文件，承诺支付额外的20,000美元。在仓库和车道按时完工且各方面均符合合同后，经销商拒绝向建筑公司支付超过500,000美元的款项。

建筑公司有权获得的最大金额是多少？
options:
A. $500,000, because the distributor's promise to pay the additional $20,000 was exacted under duress.
500,000美元，因为经销商支付额外20,000美元的承诺是在胁迫下作出的。

B. $500,000, because there was no consideration for the distributor's promise to pay the additional $20,000.
500,000美元，因为经销商支付额外20,000美元的承诺没有对价。

C. $520,000, because the modification was fair and was made in the light of circumstances not anticipated by the parties when the original contract was made.
520,000美元，因为该变更是公平的，并且是根据双方在订立原始合同时未预料到的情况作出的。

D. $520,000, provided that the reasonable value of the construction company's total performance was that much or more.
520,000美元，前提是建筑公司全部履约的合理价值等于或超过该金额。
data.explanation:
Modifying existing contracts


Governing lawRequirements
Common law
  • Traditional view: Parties' agreement New consideration
  • Modern view: Parties' agreement New consideration unless modification is fair & equitable due to unanticipated circumstances
UCC
  • Parties' agreement Good faith (ie, honesty & observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing)
  • New consideration not required
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

At common law, contract modifications generally must be supported by new consideration to be enforceable. This requires both parties to alter their duties in some way. However, modifications are enforceable without new consideration if the modification:
  • rests on circumstances not anticipated by the parties when the contract was made† and
  • is fair and equitable in light of those circumstances.

Here, the construction company and the distributor originally agreed on a contract price of $500,000. During excavations, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock. This unanticipated circumstance was going to increase construction costs by at least $20,000, so increasing the contract price by $20,000 was fair and equitable. Therefore, the modification was effective even though the construction company provided no new consideration, and the construction company is entitled to $520,000 (Choice B).

†Circumstances prompting the modification must have been unanticipated by the parties, but they need not have been completely unforeseeable.

(Choice A) A contract modification is voidable if it was induced by duress - ie, physical force or improper threat. But here, even though the distributor was expecting warehousing customers immediately after the agreed completion date, there is no indication that his promise to pay the $20,000 was exacted under duress.

(Choice D) Contract law does not require the value of a party's performance to be equal to or greater than the contract price. Therefore, the reasonable value of the construction company's performance need not be $520,000 or more for the distributor to owe it.

Educational objective: Under common law, contract modifications generally must be supported by new consideration - ie, each party must alter its duties in some way. But new consideration is not required if the modification is fair and equitable in light of unanticipated circumstances.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 35%，C选项 59%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

修改现有合同


管辖法律要求
普通法 (Common law)
  • 传统观点：双方协议 + 新的对价
  • 现代观点：双方协议 + 新的对价，除非因未预见情况导致的变更是公平合理的
UCC
  • 双方协议 + 善意（即，诚实并遵守合理的商业公平交易标准）
  • 不需要新的对价
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

在普通法下，合同变更通常必须有新的对价支持才能强制执行。这要求双方都以某种方式改变其义务。然而，在没有新的对价的情况下，如果合同变更满足以下条件，仍然可以强制执行：
  • 基于双方在订立合同时未预料到的情况† 并且
  • 根据这些情况，变更是公平合理的。

在本案中，建筑公司和经销商最初约定合同价格为500,000美元。在挖掘过程中，建筑公司意外地遇到了一大块坚硬的岩石。这一未预料到的情况将导致建筑成本增加至少20,000美元，因此将合同价格增加20,000美元是公平合理的。因此，即使建筑公司没有提供新的对价，该变更也是有效的，建筑公司有权获得520,000美元（选项 B）。

†促使变更的情况必须是双方未曾预料的，但并不要求是完全不可预见的。

(选项 A) 如果合同变更是由胁迫——即物理暴力或不正当威胁——引起的，则是可撤销的。但在本案中，即使经销商预计在约定的完工日期后立即有仓储客户入住，也没有迹象表明他支付20,000美元的承诺是在胁迫下作出的。

(选项 D) 合同法不要求一方履约的价值等于或大于合同价格。因此，经销商支付520,000美元的义务，并不要求建筑公司履约的合理价值必须等于或超过该金额。

教学目标：根据普通法，合同变更通常必须有新的对价支持——即每一方都必须以某种方式改变其义务。但是，如果变更是基于未预料到的情况而作出，并且是公平合理的，则不需要新的对价。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 89 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that modification of a contract without new consideration is binding if it is fair and equitable in view of unanticipated circumstances).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：合同变更与对价

核心考点：既有义务原则的例外
Exception to the Pre-existing Duty Rule

在普通法（Common Law）下，修改合同通常需要新的对价（Consideration）。但是，如果满足以下两个条件，无需新对价，变更依然有效：

  1. 变更是基于双方在订立合同时未预料到的情况 (unanticipated circumstances)；
  2. 变更在当时的情况下是公平合理的 (fair and equitable)。
参考来源：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 89

⚖️ 法律分析逻辑

1. 确定适用法律
本案涉及建筑工程（服务与不动产），因此适用普通法 (Common Law)，而非《统一商法典》(UCC)。
2. 识别问题
建筑公司要求加价 $20,000 完成原本合同内的工作。根据传统的既有义务原则 (Pre-existing Duty Rule)，承诺做自己已经有法律义务要做的事情，通常不能作为新承诺的对价。
3. 应用现代规则 (Modern View)
虽然没有新的对价（公司只是完成了原本要建的车道），但遇到了"意外的坚硬岩石"。
  • 这是一个典型的未预见情况。
  • 加价金额仅涵盖额外成本，是公平合理的。
因此，该修改具有约束力。

✅ 正确答案解析

选项 C 正确

$520,000，因为该变更是公平的，并且是根据双方在订立原始合同时未预料到的情况作出的。

这是对 Restatement § 89 规则的直接应用。只要变更不是由一方的无能或过错导致，而是由外部未预见的困难引起，且修改内容公平，法院会执行该修改协议。

❌ 干扰项排除

🚫 选项 B (没有对价)
这是最强的干扰项。它陈述了传统的普通法规则（Strict View）。但在现代合同法考试中，必须考虑"未预见情况"这一例外。如果题目中出现了"unexpected"（意外的）困难，通常是在提示你应用此例外。
🚫 选项 A (胁迫 Duress)
虽然经销商急需仓库，但建筑公司只是陈述了客观事实（岩石导致成本增加）并据此要求修改，这属于商业谈判而非经济胁迫 (Economic Duress)。胁迫通常需要"不正当的威胁" (wrongful threat)，本案中未体现。
🚫 选项 D (合理价值)
合同法遵循"意思自治"，不要求履行的客观价值必须等于价格。只要修改有效，就按修改后的价格执行，无需证明工程的"合理价值" (Reasonable Value) 是否达到 $520,000。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧
看到"建筑合同" + "意外困难" (如岩石、地下水) + "承诺加价" 的组合时：
1. 只要加价是公平的，修改通常有效（无需新对价）。
2. 警惕"没有对价" (No Consideration) 的选项，它通常是陷阱。
3. 只有在 UCC (货物买卖) 下，修改才完全不需要对价，只需善意 (Good Faith)。本题是服务合同，理由必须是"未预见情况"。

questions.question:
A woman obtained a bid of $10,000 to tear down her old building and another bid of $90,000 to replace it with a new structure in which she planned to operate a sporting goods store. Having only limited cash available, the woman asked a local businessman for a $100,000 loan. After reviewing the plans for the project, the businessman in a signed writing promised to lend the woman $100,000 secured by a mortgage on the property and repayable over 10 years in equal monthly installments at 10% annual interest. The woman promptly accepted the demolition bid and the old building was removed, but the businessman thereafter refused to make the loan. Despite diligent efforts, the woman was unable to obtain a loan from any other source.
Does the woman have a cause of action against the businessman?

choices.a: No, because the woman's inability to obtain a loan from any other source demonstrated that the project lacked the financial soundness that was a constructive condition to the businessman's performance.
choices.b: No, because there was no bargained-for exchange of consideration for the businessman's promise to make the loan.
choices.c: Yes, because by having the building demolished, she accepted the businessman's offer to make the loan.
choices.d: Yes, because her reliance on the businessman's promise was substantial, reasonable, and foreseeable.

data.questionStem:
Q81076

A woman obtained a bid of $10,000 to tear down her old building and another bid of $90,000 to replace it with a new structure in which she planned to operate a sporting goods store. Having only limited cash available, the woman asked a local businessman for a $100,000 loan. After reviewing the plans for the project, the businessman in a signed writing promised to lend the woman $100,000 secured by a mortgage on the property and repayable over 10 years in equal monthly installments at 10% annual interest. The woman promptly accepted the demolition bid and the old building was removed, but the businessman thereafter refused to make the loan. Despite diligent efforts, the woman was unable to obtain a loan from any other source.

Does the woman have a cause of action against the businessman?

一名女性获得了一份拆除其旧建筑的1万美元报价，以及一份以新建筑取而代之的9万美元报价，她计划在新建筑中经营一家体育用品店。由于手头现金有限，该女性向一位当地商人请求10万美元的贷款。在审查了该项目计划后，该商人在一份签署的书面文件中承诺，向该女性出借10万美元，以该房产的抵押权作为担保，偿还期为10年，以等额月度分期付款方式偿还，年利率为10%。该女性立即接受了拆除报价，旧建筑被拆除，但此后该商人拒绝提供贷款。尽管该女性尽力努力，但仍无法从任何其他来源获得贷款。

该女性对该商人是否拥有诉因？
options:
A. No, because the woman's inability to obtain a loan from any other source demonstrated that the project lacked the financial soundness that was a constructive condition to the businessman's performance.
否，因为该女性无法从任何其他来源获得贷款，表明该项目缺乏财务稳健性，而财务稳健性是该商人履行的推定条件。

B. No, because there was no bargained-for exchange of consideration for the businessman's promise to make the loan.
否，因为对于该商人提供贷款的承诺，不存在经协商的对价交换。

C. Yes, because by having the building demolished, she accepted the businessman's offer to make the loan.
是，因为通过拆除建筑物，她接受了该商人提供贷款的要约。

D. Yes, because her reliance on the businessman's promise was substantial, reasonable, and foreseeable.
是，因为她对该商人承诺的信赖是重大的、合理的且可预见的。
data.explanation:
The equitable doctrine of promissory estoppel allows a party to recover damages stemming from another's failure to perform a promise when there is no valid contract (as seen here). Recovery under promissory estoppel is warranted if:

  • the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise
  • the enforcing party reasonably relied on the promise
  • reliance on the promise caused the enforcing party to suffer substantial detriment and injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.


Here, the woman had not accepted the businessman's loan offer, so there was no valid contract between the two. However, the woman substantially, reasonably, and foreseeably relied on the businessman's promise of a loan by accepting the demolition bid. As a result, she can assert a cause of action for promissory estoppel against the businessman (and will likely prevail).

(Choice A) A constructive condition is one that is not expressly stated in a contract but is implied by law. Financial soundness of a project is not a constructive condition to performance of a party's promise to make a loan.

(Choice B) There was no bargained-for exchange of consideration for the businessman's promise, which would be required to recover under a breach-of-contract theory. But consideration is not needed to recover under a claim of promissory estoppel.

(Choice C) There are no facts indicating that the businessman authorized the woman to accept his offer to make a loan by demolishing the building. Therefore, this is not a basis for a cause of action against the businessman.

Educational objective: Promissory estoppel can be used to enforce a promise when no valid contract has been formed if (1) the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise, (2) the promise did induce such reliance, (3) that reliance caused the other party substantial detriment, and (4) injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 0%，C选项 8%，D选项 90%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

衡平法原则 promissory estoppel 允许一方在没有有效合同（如此处所示）的情况下，因另一方未能履行承诺而遭受损失时，获得损害赔偿。在以下情况下，根据 promissory estoppel 获得救济是正当的：

  • 承诺人合理预期其承诺会引致信赖
  • 请求强制执行的一方合理地信赖了该承诺
  • 对该承诺的信赖导致请求强制执行的一方遭受重大损害且只有通过强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正。


在此案中，该女性并未接受该商人的贷款要约，因此两者之间没有有效合同。然而，该女性通过接受拆除报价，重大地、合理地且可预见地信赖了该商人的贷款承诺。因此，她可以对该商人主张 promissory estoppel 的诉因（并且很可能胜诉）。

(选项 A) 推定条件是指未在合同中明确规定，但由法律默示的条件。项目的财务稳健性并非一方履行其贷款承诺的推定条件。

(选项 B) 对于该商人的承诺，不存在经协商的对价交换，而这是根据违约理论获得救济所必需的。但在 promissory estoppel 的主张下，对价并非获得救济的必要条件。

(选项 C) 没有事实表明该商人授权该女性通过拆除建筑物的方式来接受其贷款要约。因此，这不能作为对该商人提起诉讼的诉因基础。

教学目标：在未形成有效合同的情况下，如果(1) 承诺人合理预期其承诺会引致信赖，(2) 该承诺确实引致了此等信赖，(3) 该信赖导致另一方遭受重大损害，以及(4) 只有通过强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正，则可以援引 Promissory estoppel 来强制执行该承诺。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promissory estoppel).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Promissory Estoppel

正确答案：D

理由：女性对商人承诺的信赖是重大的、合理的且可预见的。

本题的核心考点是 允诺禁止反悔 (Promissory Estoppel)，这是一种衡平法上的救济手段，用于在没有正式合同（通常因为缺乏对价）的情况下强制执行承诺。

法律规则解析

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 90 (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90)，当满足以下四个要素时，即使没有有效的合同，承诺也可以被强制执行：

  1. 承诺 (Promise)： 承诺人做出了一个承诺。
  2. 可预见性 (Foreseeability)： 承诺人应当合理预期该承诺会诱导受诺人的行动或克制。
  3. 实际信赖 (Actual Reliance)： 受诺人实际上基于该承诺采取了行动或进行了克制。
  4. 避免不公 (Injustice)： 只有强制执行该承诺，才能避免不公正的结果。

在本案中，商人承诺借款，女性基于此承诺拆除了旧楼（遭受了损害/Detriment）。如果不强制执行，她将面临巨大的经济损失且无法挽回。

干扰项分析

🚫 选项 B (No Consideration) 是最大的陷阱：

选项 B 指出“没有经协商的对价交换 (Bargained-for exchange of consideration)”。

分析： 从严格的合同法角度看，这是事实。女性拆房子的行为并不是商人“讨价还价”要换取的东西，所以可能没有形成传统的合同。但是，Promissory Estoppel 正是为了解决这种“没有对价但有信赖损害”的情况而存在的。因此，缺乏对价不能阻止她基于 Promissory Estoppel 胜诉。

🚫 选项 C (Acceptance) 也是错误的：

选项 C 认为拆房构成了“承诺 (Acceptance)”。除非要约明确规定可以通过拆房来承诺，否则拆房只是履行前的准备行为 (Preparatory act)，而非对要约的承诺。这进一步证明了本案应适用 Promissory Estoppel 而非传统的违约之诉。

🎓 MBE 实战技巧

当你看到题目中出现以下模式时，请立即联想 Promissory Estoppel：

  • 一方做出了承诺 (Promise)。
  • 另一方没有提供传统的对价 (Consideration)，或者合同因技术原因（如 Statute of Frauds）无效。
  • 另一方基于承诺遭受了损失 (Detrimental Reliance)。
  • 题目问是否可以追偿。

口诀： No Contract? Look for Reliance! (没有合同？找信赖！)

questions.question:
A door-to-door saleswoman for an extermination company introduced herself to a homeowner and stated, "We are offering a one-time special. Our extermination truck is coming around this afternoon, and our technician will spray your entire yard for mosquitoes for just $100." The homeowner replied, "I will give you $75 for that service, but no more." The saleswoman said, "Unfortunately, I cannot accept $75, but the offer still stands at $100. I will be in the neighborhood for the next hour if you change your mind." The saleswoman left.
After thinking it over, the homeowner decided that $100 was a good deal, so he found the saleswoman as she was returning to her car and said to her, "I changed my mind. I accept your offer for $100." The saleswoman replied, "I apologize, but I was just informed that the truck ran out of mosquito repellent for the day and the offer is no longer available."
The extermination company never again sent its truck to the homeowner's neighborhood.
If the homeowner sues the extermination company in small claims court for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the extermination company's duty to perform was discharged due to impracticability.
choices.b: No, because the homeowner's counteroffer of $75 was also a rejection of the saleswoman's offer.
choices.c: Yes, because the extermination company was a merchant and the firm-offer rule applies.
choices.d: Yes, because the saleswoman offered the service for $100 and the homeowner accepted the offer.

The saleswoman replied, "I apologize, but I was just informed that the truck ran out of mosquito repellent for the day and the offer is no longer available."

The extermination company never again sent its truck to the homeowner's neighborhood.

If the homeowner sues the extermination company in small claims court for breach of contract, will he be likely to prevail?

一家除害公司的上门女推销员向一位房主自我介绍说：“我们正在提供一次性特价服务。我们的除害卡车今天下午会过来，我们的技术人员将为您的整个院子喷洒蚊药，仅需100美元。”房主回答说：“这项服务我给你75美元，不能再多了。”女推销员说：“很遗憾，我不能接受75美元，但100美元的要约仍然有效。如果您改变主意，接下来一个小时我都会在这附近。”女推销员随即离开。

经过考虑，房主认为100美元是个不错的交易，于是他在女推销员返回她的车子时找到了她，并对她说：“我改变主意了。我接受你100美元的要约。”女推销员回答说：“很抱歉，我刚接到通知，卡车今天用的蚊子驱避剂已经用完了，该要约已不再有效。”

该除害公司再也没有派卡车到该房主的社区。

如果该房主在小额索赔法院以违约为由起诉该除害公司，他是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the extermination company's duty to perform was discharged due to impracticability.
不会，因为除害公司的履行义务因不切实际而被免除。

B. No, because the homeowner's counteroffer of $75 was also a rejection of the saleswoman's offer.
不会，因为房主75美元的反要约也构成了对女推销员要约的拒绝。

C. Yes, because the extermination company was a merchant and the firm-offer rule applies.
会，因为除害公司是商人，且不可撤销要约规则在此适用。

D. Yes, because the saleswoman offered the service for $100 and the homeowner accepted the offer.
会，因为女推销员要约以100美元提供服务，且房主接受了该要约。
data.explanation:
To form a contract, an offer must be accepted before it terminates. An offer will terminate if, for example, the offeree rejects it by clearly conveying that he/she does not intend to accept the offer OR by making a counteroffer. Once the offer has terminated, it cannot be accepted. But the offer can be revived if the offeror conveys that it is still open. This creates a renewed opportunity for acceptance by the offeree. If the offeree then accepts, the offer can no longer be rescinded and a binding contract is formed.

Here, the saleswoman offered to spray the homeowner's yard for $100. This offer terminated when the homeowner rejected it by counteroffering for $75 (Choice B). However, the saleswoman then revived her original offer ("The offer still stands at $100"), and the homeowner accepted it shortly thereafter. The saleswoman was unable to rescind the offer once the man accepted it, and a binding contract was formed. The extermination company then breached the contract by failing to spray the homeowner's yard. Therefore, the homeowner is likely to prevail.†

†However, the homeowner can only recover damages if the market value of the agreed-upon service (spraying his yard for mosquitoes) exceeds the contract price ($100).

(Choice A) Contractual obligations can be discharged if they become impossible or impracticable to perform due to unforeseen circumstances. But here, even though the truck ran out of mosquito repellent that day, the truck could have sprayed the homeowner's yard on another day.

(Choice C) Under the UCC's firm-offer rule, a merchant's offer to buy or sell goods is irrevocable for a stated or reasonable time. But since this rule does not apply to contracts for services (eg, spraying for mosquitoes), the extermination company's merchant status is irrelevant and the firm- offer rule does not apply.

Educational objective:

An offer cannot be accepted after it terminates (eg, is rejected by the offeree). But the offer can be revived if the offeror conveys that it is still open, which creates a renewed opportunity for the offeree to accept.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.



选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 25%，C选项 3%，D选项 54%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

要形成一份合同，要约必须在其终止前被接受。例如，若受要约人通过明确表示其不打算接受要约，或通过提出反要约来拒绝要约，则要约将终止。一旦要约终止，便不能被接受。但若要约人表示要约仍然有效，则要约可以被恢复。这为受要约人创造了一个新的接受机会。如果受要约人随后接受，则该要约不能再被撤销，一份有约束力的合同即告成立。

在此案中，女推销员要约以100美元为房主的院子喷药。当房主以75美元提出反要约时，该要约因被拒绝而终止(选项 B)。然而，女推销员随后恢复了她的原始要约（“100美元的要约仍然有效”），房主不久后便接受了该要约。一旦该男子接受，女推销员就无法撤销该要约，一份有约束力的合同即告成立。除害公司未能为房主的院子喷药，从而违反了合同。因此，房主很可能胜诉。†

†然而，只有在双方约定的服务（为其院子喷洒蚊药）的市场价值超过合同价格（100美元）时，房主才能获得损害赔偿。

(选项 A) 如果因不可预见的情况导致合同义务的履行变得不可能或不切实际，则该义务可被免除。但在本案中，即使当天卡车的蚊子驱避剂用完了，卡车也可以在另一天为房主的院子喷药。

(选项 C) 根据 UCC 的不可撤销要约规则，商人购买或销售货物的要约在规定或合理的时间内是不可撤销的。但由于该规则不适用于服务合同（例如，喷洒蚊药），除害公司的商人身份与此无关，不可撤销要约规则也不适用。

教学目标：

要约在终止后（例如，被受要约人拒绝）不能被接受。但若要约人表示要约仍然有效，则要约可以被恢复，这为受要约人创造了一个新的接受机会。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (美国《统一商法典》)。

References

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 84 (2020) (explaining that a rejected offer has new vitality if the offeror renews the offer).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Formation
正确答案：D 房主胜诉。因为女推销员在房主拒绝后“复活”了要约，而房主在要约有效期内完成了接受。
本案合同形成时间轴
要约 (Offer)
推销员：$100 喷洒庭院。
反要约 = 拒绝 (Counteroffer)
房主：$75 行不行？
(通常这会终止原始要约)
要约复活 (Revival of Offer)
推销员：“不行，但 $100 的要约仍然有效 (offer still stands)。”
承诺 (Acceptance)
房主：“我接受 $100 的价格。”
合同成立 (Contract Formed)
试图撤销 (Attempted Revocation)
推销员：“没货了。”
(太晚了，合同已成立)
核心考点：要约的复活

一般规则：受要约人（房主）提出反要约（$75）通常会构成对原始要约（$100）的拒绝（Rejection），导致原始要约终止。

例外（本题关键）：要约人（推销员）可以明确表示原始要约仍然有效。这被称为要约的复活 (Revival of the Offer)。

推销员明确说 "the offer still stands at $100"，这为房主创造了一个新的承诺权（Power of Acceptance）。房主随后行使了该权利，合同即告成立。

为什么不能免责？

公司主张“卡车没药了”属于履行不能 (Impossibility) 或 履行不切实际 (Impracticability)。

但在法律上，这属于主观不能 (Subjective Impossibility)，而非客观不能。仅仅是当天没药了，并不代表“整个院子喷药”这件事在客观上无法完成（例如，可以第二天再来）。因此，义务不能被免除。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (履行不能) 错误。如上所述，暂时性的供应短缺不足以构成法律上的“履行不能”来免除合同义务。
选项 B (反要约) 错误。虽然反要约确实通常会终止要约，但该选项忽略了推销员随后“复活”要约的关键事实。
选项 C (UCC 商人规则) 错误。本案涉及的是服务 (Services)，适用普通法 (Common Law)，而非涉及货物买卖的 UCC Article 2。因此，商人的“不可撤销要约规则” (Firm Offer Rule) 不适用。
MBE 备考提示：注意对话中的每一个转折。
"Offer still stands" 是能够起死回生的魔法词句。

questions.question:
On December 15, a lawyer received from a retailer of office supplies an offer consisting of its catalog and a signed letter stating, "We will supply you with as many of the items in the enclosed catalog as you order during the next calendar year. We assure you that this offer and the prices in the catalog will remain firm throughout the coming year."
No other correspondence passed between the retailer and the lawyer until the following April 15 (four months later), when the retailer received from the lawyer a faxed order for "100 reams of your paper, catalog item #101."
Did the lawyer's April 15 fax constitute an effective acceptance of the retailer's offer at the prices specified in the catalog?

choices.a: No, because the lawyer did not accept the retailer's offer within a reasonable time.
choices.b: No, because under applicable law the irrevocability of the retailer's offer was limited to a period of three months.
choices.c: Yes, because a one-year option contract had been created by the retailer's offer.
choices.d: Yes, because the retailer had not revoked its offer before April 15.

12月15日，一位律师收到一家办公用品零售商发出的要约，包括其产品目录和一封经签署的信函，信中写道：“在下一个日历年度，无论您订购多少，我们都将按照所附目录中的品类为您供货。我们向您保证，此要约以及目录中的价格在来年全年保持不变。”

在此之后，零售商和律师之间没有其他函件往来，直到次年4月15日（四个月后），零售商收到了律师发来的一份传真订单，内容为“贵公司纸张100令，目录编号#101”。

律师在4月15日发出的传真，是否构成了对零售商要约的有效承诺，并接受了目录中指定的价格？
options:
A. No, because the lawyer did not accept the retailer's offer within a reasonable time.
否，因为律师未在合理期限内对零售商的要约作出承诺。

B. No, because under applicable law the irrevocability of the retailer's offer was limited to a period of three months.
否，因为根据适用法律，零售商要约的不可撤销性期限仅为三个月。

C. Yes, because a one-year option contract had been created by the retailer's offer.
是，因为零售商的要约已经创立了一份为期一年的选择权合同。

D. Yes, because the retailer had not revoked its offer before April 15.
是，因为零售商在4月15日之前并未撤销其要约。
data.explanation:
Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by the UCC. Under the UCC firm offer rule, a merchant's signed,† written offer to buy or sell goods may contain assurances that it will remain open. If so, the offer is irrevocable for the time stated in the offer or, if no time is stated, for a reasonable time. But in either case, the period of irrevocability cannot exceed three months. Therefore, the retailer's firm offer to sell office supplies to the lawyer at the prices listed in the catalog became revocable after three months (March 15).

However, the retailer never expressly revoked its offer (Choice B). And though a revocable offer with no deadline for acceptance will lapse after a reasonable amount of time given the circumstances surrounding the negotiation, the retailer's offer letter referenced orders placed "during the next calendar year." This indicates that the reasonable time for acceptance was any time during that year (Choice A). Therefore, the lawyer's April 15 faxed order was an effective acceptance of the retailer's offer at the prices listed in the catalog.

†A full handwritten signature is not always required, such as when
  • initialing the relevant clause is appropriate under the circumstances or
  • the merchant handwrites on his/her letterhead to confirm that a firm offer was already made.


(Choice C) Although the UCC is silent as to option contracts, they can be created for the sale of goods (under the common law rule) if they are supported by consideration. But here, the retailer's promise to hold the offer open was not supported by consideration because the promise was not exchanged for an act or return promise.

Educational objective: A merchant's firm offer to buy or sell goods is irrevocable for the time stated in the offer or, if no time is stated, for a reasonable time (not to exceed three months in either case). Once the offer becomes revocable, it may lapse (just like any other revocable offer) if it is not accepted within a reasonable amount of time.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 25%，C选项 17%，D选项 46%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

货物买卖合同受UCC管辖。根据UCC固定要约规则，商家经签署的†书面要约，在要约购买或出售货物时，可包含其要约将保持开放的保证。若如此，则该要约在要约中规定的期限内不可撤销；若未规定时间，则在一个合理期限内不可撤销。但无论哪种情况，不可撤销的期限不得超过三个月。因此，零售商以目录所列价格向律师出售办公用品的固定要约，在三个月后（3月15日）即变为可撤销。

然而，该零售商从未明确撤销其要约（选项B）。尽管一个没有规定承诺期限的可撤销要约，在考虑到谈判相关情况后，若未在合理时间内被承诺则会失效，但零售商的要约函中提到了“在下一个日历年度”内下的订单。这表明承诺的合理期限是该年度内的任何时间（选项A）。因此，律师于4月15日发出的传真订单，是对零售商要约的有效承诺，并接受了目录中所列的价格。

†完整的亲笔签名并非总是必需，例如在以下情况：
  • 根据具体情况，在相关条款上签注首字母是适当的；或
  • 商家在其公司信笺上亲笔书写，以确认已发出一项固定要约。


（选项C）尽管UCC对选择权合同未作规定，但如果该合同有对价支持，可以（根据普通法规则）为货物买卖创立选择权合同。但在本案中，零售商保持要约开放的承诺没有对价支持，因为该承诺并未换取任何行为或对待承诺。

教学目标：商家的固定货物买卖要约，在要约规定的期限内不可撤销；若未规定时间，则在合理期限内不可撤销（无论何种情况，期限均不得超过三个月）。一旦该要约变为可撤销，如果未在合理时间内被承诺，它就可能（像任何其他可撤销要约一样）失效。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code（《统一商法典》）。

References

U.C.C. § 2-205 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (firm offers).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2

Formation of Contracts Firm Offer Rule
正确答案：D
是，因为零售商在4月15日之前并未撤销其要约。
核心考点分析

本题考察的是 UCC 固定要约规则 (UCC Firm Offer Rule) 与 要约失效 (Lapse of Offer) 之间的区别。

很多考生会混淆“不可撤销期”与“要约有效期”。要解对这道题，必须理清以下时间线逻辑：

12月15日
要约发出
商家书面承诺要约在“明年全年”有效。
Firm Offer created.
3月15日 (约)
不可撤销期结束
UCC § 2-205 规定无对价的固定要约不可撤销期最长为3个月。
Irrevocability ends.
4月15日
律师发出承诺 (Acceptance)
要约虽然变为“可撤销”，但商家并未撤销，且仍在要约原本设定的“一年”有效期内。
Valid Acceptance.
法律依据详解

1. 适用法律：UCC (统一商法典)
本案涉及办公用品（货物）买卖，因此适用 UCC Article 2。

2. 固定要约规则 (UCC § 2-205)
商家 (Merchant) 在经签署的书面文件中明确保证要约将保持开放，则该要约在规定时间内不可撤销，即使没有对价 (Consideration)。

关键限制：如果文件中规定的时间超过3个月，不可撤销期自动缩减为3个月。

3. 3个月后的状态变化
这是本题最大的陷阱。3个月期限届满（3月15日）后，要约并没有自动失效 (Lapse)，它只是从“不可撤销要约”变成了普通的“可撤销要约” (Revocable Offer)。

4. 结论
要约本身写明有效期为“下一个日历年度”（即一年）。虽然3个月后商家有权撤销，但题目明确指出商家没有进行任何通信（即未撤销）。因此，在4月15日，该要约仍然“活着”，律师的承诺有效。

⚠️ 常见错误 (选项 B)：
选项 B 错误地认为3个月期限一过，要约就自动失效了。请记住：
失去“不可撤销性” ≠ 要约死亡。
它只是变得脆弱了（可以被撤销），但在被实际撤销或自然过期之前，仍然可以被承诺。
其他选项排除
  • 选项 A (错误)： 要约明确规定了期限（一年），因此不需要讨论“合理时间”。只要在一年内且未被撤销，承诺均有效。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 只有支付了对价 (Consideration)，才能形成长期的选择权合同 (Option Contract)。本案中律师未支付对价，所以不是 Option Contract，而是 Firm Offer。

questions.question:
A man moved into his widowed grandfather's farmhouse. At the time, the man worked as a power plant operator earning a substantial salary plus benefits. Nevertheless, the man left that job to farm his grandfather's land after the grandfather orally promised the man that if he did so, he would inherit the farm. The man borrowed money to purchase farm equipment, cleared the land, installed irrigation, and planted crops. The grandfather told neighbors and family members that the farm belonged to the man.
Fifteen years later, the grandfather died testate. The grandfather's will specifically devised the farm to his oldest son. The man immediately filed a complaint seeking legal title to the farm.
Is the man likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because contracts for the sale or transfer of land fall under the statute of frauds and must be in writing in order to be enforceable.
choices.b: No, because the grandfather and man's conduct was insufficient to indicate the assent required to create an implied-in-fact contract.
choices.c: Yes, because the court will construct a quasi-contract between the man and the grandfather to remedy unjust enrichment of the grandfather's estate.
choices.d: Yes, because the man reasonably and detrimentally relied on the grandfather's promise.

data.questionStem:
Q81124

A man moved into his widowed grandfather's farmhouse. At the time, the man worked as a power plant operator earning a substantial salary plus benefits. Nevertheless, the man left that job to farm his grandfather's land after the grandfather orally promised the man that if he did so, he would inherit the farm. The man borrowed money to purchase farm equipment, cleared the land, installed irrigation, and planted crops. The grandfather told neighbors and family members that the farm belonged to the man.

Fifteen years later, the grandfather died testate. The grandfather's will specifically devised the farm to his oldest son. The man immediately filed a complaint seeking legal title to the farm.

Is the man likely to prevail?

一名男子搬进了他丧偶祖父的农舍。当时，该男子是一名发电厂操作员，薪水丰厚并享有福利。然而，在该男子的祖父口头承诺，如果他这么做，他将继承该农场后，该男子辞去了工作，去耕种他祖父的土地。该男子借钱购买农用设备，清理土地，安装灌溉系统，并种植了庄稼。祖父告诉邻居和家人，该农场属于该男子。

十五年后，祖父去世，并留有遗嘱。祖父的遗嘱将该农场明确遗赠给了他的长子。该男子立即提起诉状，要求获得该农场的法定所有权。

该男子有可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because contracts for the sale or transfer of land fall under the statute of frauds and must be in writing in order to be enforceable.
不会，因为土地买卖或转让合同受《反欺诈法》(statute of frauds)管辖，必须以书面形式订立才能强制执行。

B. No, because the grandfather and man's conduct was insufficient to indicate the assent required to create an implied-in-fact contract.
不会，因为祖父和该男子的行为不足以表明达成事实默示合同所需的同意。

C. Yes, because the court will construct a quasi-contract between the man and the grandfather to remedy unjust enrichment of the grandfather's estate.
会，因为法院将在该男子和祖父之间构建一个准合同(quasi-contract)，以补救祖父遗产的不当得利(unjust enrichment)。

D. Yes, because the man reasonably and detrimentally relied on the grandfather's promise.
会，因为该男子对祖父的承诺产生了合理的、有损害的信赖。
data.explanation:
Contracts for the sale or transfer of land fall under the statute of frauds and must therefore be in writing to be enforceable. Since the grandfather's promise to the man was oral, there is no enforceable contract (Choice A). However, the man can still prevail under a theory of promissory estoppel. This equitable doctrine allows a party to enforce another's promise when no valid contract was formed. It applies when:
  • the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise
  • the enforcing party reasonably relied on the promise
  • the enforcing party suffered substantial detriment as a result of such reliance and
  • injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.


Here, the grandfather should have reasonably expected the man to rely on his promise that the man would inherit the farm. In reasonable reliance on that promise, the man left his job to farm the land. This caused the man to suffer substantial detriment, as evidenced by the fact that he borrowed money and gave up a substantial salary plus benefits. And since it would be unjust not to enforce the grandfather's promise - especially after the man had farmed the land for 15 years - the man is likely to prevail.

(Choice B) An implied-in-fact contract arises when the parties' conduct indicates the requisite assent to be bound. But here, whether the grandfather and man's conduct was sufficient to imply a contract is irrelevant because only an express, written contract to transfer the farm would have been enforceable.

(Choice C) Courts can construct a quasi-contract† to compensate a party for a benefit conferred upon another and prevent the other's unjust enrichment. Here, quasi-contract might be a basis for the man to recover compensation for valuable improvements made to the land - but not title to the farm.

†This is also called an implied-in-law contract.

Educational objective: Promissory estoppel applies when (1) the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise, (2) the enforcing party reasonably relied on that promise, (3) the enforcing party suffered substantial detriment as a result, and (4) injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.



选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 0%，C选项 16%，D选项 70%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

土地买卖或转让合同受《反欺诈法》(statute of frauds)管辖，因此必须以书面形式订立才能强制执行。由于祖父对该男子的承诺是口头的，因此不存在可强制执行的合同（选项A）。然而，该男子仍然可以依据允诺禁反言(promissory estoppel)的理论胜诉。这一衡平法原则允许一方在没有成立有效合同的情况下，强制执行另一方的允诺。它适用于以下情况：
  • 允诺人合理预期其允诺会引致信赖
  • 寻求强制执行的一方合理地信赖了该允诺
  • 寻求强制执行的一方因此种信赖而遭受了重大损害，并且
  • 只有强制执行该允诺才能避免不公。


在本案中，祖父应合理预期到该男子会信赖他将继承农场的允诺。基于对该允诺的合理信赖，该男子辞去工作去耕种土地。这使该男子遭受了重大损害，其证据是他借了钱并放弃了丰厚的薪水和福利。而且，不强制执行祖父的允诺将是不公正的——尤其是在该男子已经耕种了15年土地之后——因此该男子很可能胜诉。

（选项B）事实默示合同(implied-in-fact contract)在双方行为表明有受其约束的必要同意时成立。但在本案中，祖父和该男子的行为是否足以默示一份合同并不重要，因为只有明示的、书面的农场转让合同才是可强制执行的。

（选项C）法院可以构建一个准合同(quasi-contract)†，以补偿一方给予另一方的利益，并防止另一方的不当得利(unjust enrichment)。在本案中，准合同可能可以作为该男子就土地的宝贵改良获得补偿的依据——但不能获得农场的所有权。

†这也被称为法律默示合同(implied-in-law contract)。

教学目标：允诺禁反言(Promissory estoppel)适用于以下情况：（1）允诺人合理预期其允诺会引致信赖；（2）寻求强制执行的一方合理地信赖了该允诺；（3）寻求强制执行的一方因此遭受了重大损害；以及（4）只有强制执行该允诺才能避免不公。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (promise reasonably inducing action or forbearance).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Promissory Estoppel

合同法 / 允诺禁反言

本题考察的核心是：当口头土地转让合同因违反《反欺诈法》而无效时，受损方如何通过衡平法原则获得救济。

正确答案分析 (D)

该男子胜诉的依据是 允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel)。

虽然土地转让通常需要书面合同，但在本案中，法院会强制执行祖父的口头承诺，以避免严重的不公。分析逻辑如下：

允诺禁反言的四个要素：
  • 允诺 (Promise)： 祖父承诺如果男子回来耕种，就让他继承农场。
  • 合理预期 (Reasonable Expectation)： 祖父应当预见到该承诺会促使男子采取行动。
  • 信赖与损害 (Reliance & Detriment)： 男子基于该承诺，辞去了高薪工作，借钱购买设备，并耕种了15年。这是巨大的、实质性的信赖损害。
  • 避免不公 (Avoid Injustice)： 如果不强制执行该承诺，男子15年的付出将付诸东流，造成极大的不公。

在这种情况下，法院会适用 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90，判定尽管没有书面合同，该承诺依然具有约束力，且救济方式可以是强制履行（即获得土地所有权）。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A：错误 (Statute of Frauds)

虽然《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 确实要求土地合同必须书面，但这是一个一般原则。法律存在例外情况（如部分履行或允诺禁反言），专门用来防止《反欺诈法》本身成为实施欺诈的工具。

选项 C：错误 (Quasi-Contract)

准合同 (Quasi-Contract) 或不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment) 通常提供的救济是金钱赔偿（即归还服务的价值），而不是特定履行（获得土地所有权）。如果男子想要拿到农场本身，必须依赖允诺禁反言。

MBE 考试技巧

在处理涉及口头土地合同的题目时，请注意以下模式：

  • 🚩 触发点： 口头承诺转让土地 + 接收方已经搬入并进行了重大改良或改变了生活轨迹。
  • 🧠 思考路径： 首先确认违反了《反欺诈法》（无书面）；其次寻找例外。如果接收方付出了巨大代价（辞职、装修、耕种多年），法院通常会通过 Promissory Estoppel 或 Part Performance（部分履行）来支持合同的执行。

questions.question:
A landowner and a contractor entered into a written contract under which the contractor agreed to build a building and pave an adjacent sidewalk for the landowner for $200,000. Later, while construction was proceeding, the landowner and the contractor entered into an oral modification under which the contractor was not obligated to pave the sidewalk but still would be entitled to $200,000 upon completion of the building. The contractor completed the building. The landowner, after discussions with his landscaper, demanded that the contractor pave the adjacent sidewalk. The contractor refused.
Has the contractor breached the contract?

choices.a: No, because the oral modification was in good faith and therefore enforceable.
choices.b: Yes, because a discharge of a contractual obligation must be in writing.
choices.c: Yes, because the parol evidence rule bars proof of the oral modification.
choices.d: Yes, because there was no consideration for the discharge of the contractor's duty to pave the sidewalk.

data.questionStem:
Q81130

A landowner and a contractor entered into a written contract under which the contractor agreed to build a building and pave an adjacent sidewalk for the landowner for $200,000. Later, while construction was proceeding, the landowner and the contractor entered into an oral modification under which the contractor was not obligated to pave the sidewalk but still would be entitled to $200,000 upon completion of the building. The contractor completed the building. The landowner, after discussions with his landscaper, demanded that the contractor pave the adjacent sidewalk. The contractor refused.

Has the contractor breached the contract?

一位土地所有者与一位承包商签订了一份书面合同，根据该合同，承包商同意为土地所有者建造一栋建筑并铺设相邻的人行道，费用为200,000美元。之后，在施工期间，土地所有者与承包商达成了一项口头修改协议，根据该协议，承包商没有义务铺设人行道，但在完成建筑后仍有权获得200,000美元。承包商完成了建筑的建造。土地所有者在与他的景观设计师讨论后，要求承包商铺设相邻的人行道。承包商拒绝了。

承包商是否违反了合同？
options:
A. No, because the oral modification was in good faith and therefore enforceable.
否，因为口头修改是基于善意作出的，因此具有执行力。

B. Yes, because a discharge of a contractual obligation must be in writing.
是，因为合同义务的免除必须以书面形式进行。

C. Yes, because the parol evidence rule bars proof of the oral modification.
是，因为口头证据规则(parol evidence rule)禁止采纳该口头修改的证明。

D. Yes, because there was no consideration for the discharge of the contractor's duty to pave the sidewalk.
是，因为免除承包商铺设人行道义务的行为没有对价。
data.explanation:
Modifying existing contracts


Governing lawRequirements
Common lawTraditional view: Parties' agreement & New consideration

Modern view: Parties' agreement & New consideration unless modification is fair & equitable due to unanticipated circumstances
UCCParties' agreement & Good faith (ie, honesty & observance of reasonable commercial standards of fair dealing) & New consideration not required
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for services are governed by the common law. Under the common law, contract modifications must be supported by new consideration - ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance - to be enforceable. This requirement is only met if both parties alter their duties in some way. As a result, the promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty is insufficient for new consideration and will not discharge the parties' duties under the initial (ie, unmodified) contract.

Here, the contractor agreed to build a building and pave a sidewalk for the landowner for $200,000. The parties later agreed that the contractor did not have to pave the sidewalk. However, there was no consideration for this modification because the landowner's duty to pay the full $200,000 contract price remained the same. This means that the modification is not binding and did not discharge the contractor's duty to pave. As a result, the contractor breached the contract by refusing to pave the sidewalk.

(Choice A) Under the UCC, contract modifications need only be made in good faith to be enforceable - new consideration is not required. But since the UCC only applies to contracts for the sale of goods, the common law applies here.

(Choice B) There is no rule requiring the discharge of a contractual obligation to be in writing.

(Choice C) The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior oral or written agreement to modify or contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But this rule does not bar evidence of subsequent agreements between the parties (eg, the oral modification that occurred after the contract was entered).

Educational objective: Under the common law, contract modifications are only binding if they are supported by new consideration. This requires both parties to alter their duties in some way.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 4%，C选项 1%，D选项 79%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

修改现有合同


管辖法律要求
普通法 (Common law)传统观点：双方协议 & 新的对价

现代观点：双方协议 & 新的对价 除非因未预见情况而作出的修改是公平合理的
UCC双方协议 & 善意（即诚实及遵守合理的商业公平交易标准）& 不需要新的对价
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

服务合同受普通法 (common law)管辖。根据普通法，合同修改必须有新的对价 (consideration) 支持——即为达成交易而进行的允诺或履行的交换——才能具有执行力。只有当双方都以某种方式改变了其义务时，此要求才算满足。因此，履行已存义务的允诺或履行本身，不足以构成新的对价，并且不会免除双方在初始（即未经修改的）合同下的义务。

在本案中，承包商同意为土地所有者建造一栋建筑并铺设人行道，费用为200,000美元。双方后来同意承包商不必铺设人行道。然而，这项修改没有对价，因为土地所有者支付全部200,000美元合同价款的义务保持不变。这意味着该修改不具约束力，也未免除承包商铺设人行道的义务。因此，承包商因拒绝铺设人行道而违反了合同。

(选项A) 根据UCC，合同修改只需基于善意作出即具有执行力——不需要新的对价。但由于UCC仅适用于货物销售合同，因此本案适用普通法。

(选项B) 没有规则要求合同义务的免除必须以书面形式进行。

(选项C) 口头证据规则(parol evidence rule)通常禁止采纳旨在修改或抵触最终书面协议条款的先前口头或书面协议的证据。但此规则不禁止采纳双方后续达成的协议的证据（例如，在合同签订后发生的口头修改）。

教学目的：根据普通法，合同修改只有在得到新对价支持的情况下才具有约束力。这要求双方都以某种方式改变其义务。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Modification
正确答案：D

是的，因为免除承包商铺设人行道义务的行为没有对价 (Consideration)。

⚖️ 核心考点：普通法下的合同修改
1. 法律适用 (Governing Law)

本题涉及建筑和铺路，属于服务合同 (Services)，因此适用普通法 (Common Law)，而非《统一商法典》(UCC)。

2. 既有义务原则 (Pre-existing Duty Rule)

在普通法下，修改合同必须有新的对价 (New Consideration) 才能生效。

如果一方只是承诺做他本来就有义务做的事情，或者一方同意接受更少的服务但支付同样的钱，这通常被视为缺乏对价。

🔍 案情逻辑分析

让我们拆解本案中的交易交换：

  • 原合同：承包商建楼 + 铺路 ↔ 业主付 $200,000。
  • 修改后：承包商建楼 (不做铺路) ↔ 业主仍付 $200,000。

问题所在：业主同意支付全款，但得到的服务变少了；承包商做的工作变少了，但得到的钱没变。

承包商没有提供任何“新的”东西来换取业主“免除铺路义务”的承诺。因此，这个口头修改因缺乏对价 (Lack of Consideration) 而无效。原合同依然有效，承包商必须铺路。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (UCC 规则混淆)
选项 A 提到了“善意 (Good Faith)”。这是 UCC Article 2 (货物销售) 的规则。在 UCC 下，修改合同不需要对价，只要是善意的即可。但本案是服务合同，必须适用普通法的对价要求。
选项 B (书面形式)
普通法并不要求所有的免除义务 (Discharge) 都必须是书面的。除非涉及《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 的特定情况，否则口头修改在有对价的情况下是有效的。本案的关键缺陷是对价，而不是形式。
选项 C (口头证据规则 PER)
Parol Evidence Rule 仅禁止引入合同签订前或签订时的口头协议来反驳书面合同。它不禁止证明合同签订之后的修改 (Subsequent Modification)。
🎓 MBE 抢分技巧：

看到“合同修改 (Modification)”题目时，第一步永远是判断：
👉 卖东西 (Goods)? → 适用 UCC → 不需要对价 (No Consideration Needed)，只要善意 (Good Faith)。
👉 服务/房产 (Services/Real Estate)? → 适用 Common Law → 必须有新对价 (New Consideration Required)。

questions.question:
A national distributor of windows selected a retailer to sell its windows in a specified geographic area. The parties negotiated a written distribution agreement, which stated that any order for windows placed by the retailer would be binding on the distributor "only when expressly accepted by the distributor."
For the next two years, the retailer forwarded orders to the distributor, and the distributor always filled the orders. In the third year, the distributor accused the retailer of overcharging customers to install the distributor's windows. The retailer responded that the distributor had no control over the retailer's installation prices. When the distributor received the retailer's next order for windows, it refused to fill the order.
If the retailer sues the distributor for breach of contract, will it be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the retailer's forwarding of orders to the distributor did not give rise to an obligation on the distributor's part to fill the orders.
choices.b: No, because the retailer's practice of overcharging customers excused the distributor's refusal to fill the order.
choices.c: Yes, because the distributor's claim regarding overcharging customers is independent of its obligation to fill the retailer's order.
choices.d: Yes, because the parties' course of dealing binds the distributor to fill the retailer's order.

data.questionStem:
Q81803 A national distributor of windows selected a retailer to sell its windows in a specified geographic area. The parties negotiated a written distribution agreement, which stated that any order for windows placed by the retailer would be binding on the distributor "only when expressly accepted by the distributor."

For the next two years, the retailer forwarded orders to the distributor, and the distributor always filled the orders. In the third year, the distributor accused the retailer of overcharging customers to install the distributor's windows. The retailer responded that the distributor had no control over the retailer's installation prices. When the distributor received the retailer's next order for windows, it refused to fill the order.

If the retailer sues the distributor for breach of contract, will it be likely to prevail? 一家全国性的窗户经销商选择了一家零售商在特定地理区域销售其窗户。双方协商签订了一份书面分销协议，其中规定，零售商下的任何窗户订单“仅在经销商明确接受后”才对经销商具有约束力。

在接下来的两年里，零售商向经销商转发订单，经销商总是履行这些订单。第三年，经销商指责零售商在为客户安装经销商的窗户时收费过高。零售商回应称，经销商无权控制零售商的安装价格。当经销商收到零售商的下一个窗户订单时，它拒绝履行该订单。

如果零售商以违约为由起诉经销商，它是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the retailer's forwarding of orders to the distributor did not give rise to an obligation on the distributor's part to fill the orders.
不会，因为零售商向经销商转发订单的行为并未使经销商产生履行订单的义务。

B. No, because the retailer's practice of overcharging customers excused the distributor's refusal to fill the order.
不会，因为零售商向客户多收费的做法，为经销商拒绝履行订单提供了正当理由。

C. Yes, because the distributor's claim regarding overcharging customers is independent of its obligation to fill the retailer's order.
会，因为经销商关于客户收费过高的主张与其履行零售商订单的义务无关。

D. Yes, because the parties' course of dealing binds the distributor to fill the retailer's order.
会，因为双方的交易过程使经销商有义务履行零售商的订单。
data.explanation:
Elements of valuable consideration


Bargained-for exchangeEach party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise
Legal detrimentEach party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or
refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act
At common law and under the UCC, contractual obligations must be supported by valuable consideration—i.e., a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. This requirement is not met if either party makes an illusory promise—i.e., one that essentially pledges nothing because it is vague or because the promising party can choose whether to honor it. In that case, there is no contract—and so there can be no breach.

Here, the distribution agreement provided that orders placed by the retailer would be binding on the distributor only when expressly accepted by the distributor. Since the distributor can choose whether or not to accept the orders, its promise was illusory. Due to this lack of consideration, the distribution agreement did not create an enforceable contract. This means that when the distributor received the retailer's final order, the distributor was not obligated to fill it. Therefore, the retailer is unlikely to prevail in a breach of contract suit.

(Choices B & C) If there had been an enforceable contract limiting the retailer's installation charges, the retailer's alleged practice of overcharging would be a breach that entitled the distributor to refuse additional orders. But since there was no such contract, the retailer's charging practices are irrelevant.

(Choice D) Under the UCC, the parties' course of dealing (e.g., filling orders for two years) is relevant to interpreting their agreement. But the express terms of the agreement prevail if they are inconsistent with the parties' course of dealing. Therefore, the parties' course of dealing here does not bind the distributor to fill the retailer's order.

Educational objective:
An illusory promise—i.e., one that essentially pledges nothing because it is vague or because the promisor can choose whether to honor it—cannot supply the necessary consideration for contract formation.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code



有效对价的要素


对价交易各方签订协议的意愿必须由另一方的行为/承诺所引诱
法律上的损害各方当事人必须通过以下任一方式放弃一项合法权利：

履行（或承诺履行）一项法律上不要求的行为或
不实施（或承诺不实施）一项法律上允许的行为
在普通法和《统一商法典》(UCC)下，合同义务必须有有效对价支持——即经讨价还价的承诺或履行的交换。如果任何一方做出虚幻承诺，则不满足此要求。虚幻承诺即指那些基本上不承诺任何事情的承诺，因为它含糊不清，或者因为承诺方可以选择是否履行它。在这种情况下，合同不成立——因此也就不可能违约。

本案中，分销协议规定，零售商下的订单仅在经销商明确接受后才对经销商具有约束力。由于经销商可以选择是否接受订单，其承诺是虚幻的。由于缺乏对价，该分销协议并未创设一份可强制执行的合同。这意味着当经销商收到零售商的最后一份订单时，经销商没有义务履行它。因此，零售商在违约诉讼中不太可能胜诉。

(选项 B 和 C) 如果存在一份可强制执行的合同来限制零售商的安装费用，那么零售商被指控的多收费行为将构成违约，使经销商有权拒绝额外的订单。但由于不存在这样的合同，零售商的收费行为是无关紧要的。

(选项 D) 根据《统一商法典》，双方的交易过程（例如，两年内一直履行订单）与解释其协议有关。但如果协议的明示条款与双方的交易过程不一致，则以明示条款为准。因此，本案中双方的交易过程并不能约束经销商必须履行零售商的订单。

教学目标：
一个虚幻的承诺——即一个基本上不承诺任何事情，因为它含糊不清或者因为承诺方可以选择是否履行的承诺——不能为合同的成立提供必要的对价。

UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 2 cmt. e (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that there is no promise when performance is entirely optional).

data.htmlContent:
Contracts 考点解析

Illusory Promise & Consideration

正确答案：A (零售商败诉)

本题的核心考点在于合同的形成 (Formation) 和 对价 (Consideration)，特别是如何识别“虚幻承诺”。

🔑 核心概念：虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise) 如果一方做出的承诺使其可以完全自由地选择是否履行（例如：“我想做就做”），那么这个承诺就是“虚幻的”。

在法律上，虚幻承诺不构成有效的对价 (Consideration)。没有对价，合同就不成立。
⚖️ 法律推理逻辑
  • 分析协议条款：
    题目中的分销协议规定，订单“仅在经销商明确接受后” (only when expressly accepted) 才具有约束力。
  • 识别法律效力：
    这意味着经销商实际上没有承诺任何事情。对于任何一个订单，经销商都可以随心所欲地接受或拒绝。这种“完全的自由裁量权”使得经销商的承诺成为虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise)。
  • 结论：
    由于缺乏有效的对价（Mutuality of Obligation），这份原本的“分销协议”并不是一份可强制执行的合同。它仅仅是一个邀请要约的框架。因此，当经销商拒绝最新的订单时，它并没有违反任何合同义务。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
关于选项 D (Course of Dealing)：
这是最具迷惑性的选项。虽然 UCC 确实允许用“交易过程” (Course of Dealing) 来解释合同，但有一个重要原则：
明示条款 > 交易过程
(Express Terms control Course of Dealing)。
既然书面协议明确规定了“必须明确接受才有效”，这一明示条款压倒了过去两年“总是发货”的行为模式。
关于选项 B & C (Overcharging)：
这两个选项都在讨论“多收费”是否构成违约或抗辩理由。但前提必须是先有一份有效的合同。既然合同本身因缺乏对价而不成立，违约问题就无从谈起。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在 Contracts 题目中，当你看到类似 "unless I decide not to", "if I want to", 或 "subject to my approval" (且无限制条件) 的语言时，立即警惕 Illusory Promise。

如果一方的履行完全取决于其单方面的意愿，通常意味着没有合同 (No Contract)。
