questions.question:
On May 1, an uncle mailed a letter to his adult nephew that stated: "I am thinking of selling my pickup truck, which you have seen and ridden in. I would consider taking $7,000 for it." On May 3, the nephew mailed the following response: "I will buy your pickup for $7,000 cash." The uncle received this letter on May 5 and on May 6 mailed a note that stated: "It's a deal." On May 7, before the nephew had received the letter of May 6, he phoned his uncle to report that he no longer wanted to buy the pickup truck because his driver's license had been suspended.
Which of the following statements concerning this exchange is accurate?

choices.a: There was a contract as of May 3.
choices.b: There was a contract as of May 5.
choices.c: There was a contract as of May 6.
choices.d: There is no contract.

data.questionStem:
Q81128

On May 1, an uncle mailed a letter to his adult nephew that stated: "I am thinking of selling my pickup truck, which you have seen and ridden in. I would consider taking $7,000 for it." On May 3, the nephew mailed the following response: "I will buy your pickup for $7,000 cash." The uncle received this letter on May 5 and on May 6 mailed a note that stated: "It's a deal." On May 7, before the nephew had received the letter of May 6, he phoned his uncle to report that he no longer wanted to buy the pickup truck because his driver's license had been suspended.

Which of the following statements concerning this exchange is accurate?

5月1日，一位叔叔给他的成年侄子邮寄了一封信，信中写道：“我正在考虑出售我的皮卡车，你见过也坐过。我会考虑以7000美元的价格出售。”5月3日，侄子邮寄了以下回复：“我将以7000美元现金购买你的皮卡。”叔叔于5月5日收到此信，并于5月6日邮寄了一张便条，写道：“成交。”5月7日，在侄子收到5月6日的信之前，他打电话给叔叔，告知他不想再买这辆皮卡车了，因为他的驾照被吊销了。

关于这次往来，以下哪个陈述是准确的？
options:
A. There was a contract as of May 3.
截至5月3日，合同成立。

B. There was a contract as of May 5.
截至5月5日，合同成立。

C. There was a contract as of May 6.
截至5月6日，合同成立。

D. There is no contract.
合同不成立。
data.explanation:
Contract negotiations by mail†


Offeror's actions: Offer, Revocation of offerEffective upon receipt
Offeree's actions: Acceptance (mailbox rule)Effective upon dispatch.
Exceptions - effective upon receipt if:
  • improperly stamped/addressed
  • acceptance by mail unreasonable
  • rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective)
  • acceptance of option contract
Offeree's actions: Rejection/counterofferEffective upon receipt
†Applicable under common law & UCC

Contract formation begins with an offer that expresses more than a mere willingness to negotiate. The offer must (1) communicate definite terms to the offeree and (2) make an objectively reasonable expression of the offeror's intent to enter a binding contract. Here, the uncle's May 1 letter was not an offer since he was merely "thinking" of selling his pickup truck and would "consider" taking $7,000. In contrast, the nephew's May 3 response was an offer because it expressed definite terms ("$7,000 cash") and an intent to be bound ("I will buy").

Once an offer has been made, a contract will be formed if the offeree accepts the offer before it is revoked. Under the mailbox rule, acceptance by mail is:
  • permitted if mail is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance - eg, when the offer was communicated by mail and
  • effective upon dispatch - ie, when the acceptance is properly addressed and placed with the postal service with paid postage.
Here, the uncle received the nephew's offer on May 5. The uncle reasonably accepted this offer by mailing a note on May 6 since the parties had been negotiating by mail. As a result, there was a binding contract as of May 6 that prevented the nephew from revoking his offer on May 7 (Choices A & B).

(Choice D) Had the subject matter of the offer become illegal prior to acceptance, the offer would have been terminated by law and no contract would have been formed. Here, the nephew's suspended license only made it illegal for him to drive the truck - not to purchase it. Therefore, this did not cause the offer to terminate.

Educational objective: An offer to form a contract must (1) communicate definite terms to the offeree and (2) make an objectively reasonable expression of the offeror's intent to enter a binding contract. Such an offer can then be accepted by mail, and will be effective upon dispatch, if a mailing is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 2%，C选项 77%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

通过邮件进行的合同协商†


要约人的行为: 要约、要约的撤销到达时生效
受要约人的行为: 承诺 (邮箱规则)发出时生效。
例外情况 - 如果出现以下情况，则在到达时生效：
  • 邮票不足或地址错误
  • 通过邮件承诺不合理
  • 拒绝先于承诺寄出（以先到达者为准）
  • 选择权合同的承诺
受要约人的行为: 拒绝/反要约到达时生效
†适用于普通法和UCC

合同的成立始于一项要约，该要约所表达的不仅仅是协商的意愿。该要约必须 (1) 向受要约人传达确定的条款，并且 (2) 对要约人订立有约束力的合同之意图做出客观合理的表达。在本案中，叔叔5月1日的信件不是一项要约，因为他仅仅是“正在考虑”出售他的皮卡车，并且“会考虑”收取7000美元。相反，侄子5月3日的回复是一项要约，因为它表达了确定的条款（“7000美元现金”）和受约束的意图（“我将要购买”）。

一旦要约做出，如果受要约人在要约被撤销前承诺该要约，合同即告成立。根据邮箱规则，通过邮件做出的承诺：
  • 如果邮件是传达承诺的合理方式，则是允许的——例如，当要约是通过邮件传达时，并且
  • 发出时生效——即，当承诺被正确填写地址、贴足邮票并交予邮政部门时。
在本案中，叔叔于5月5日收到了侄子的要约。由于双方一直通过邮件进行协商，叔叔于5月6日通过邮寄便条的方式合理地承诺了该要约。因此，截至5月6日，一份有约束力的合同已经成立，这使得侄子无法在5月7日撤销其要约（选项 A 和 B）。

（选项 D）如果要在承诺前，要约的标的物变为非法，则该要约将因法律规定而终止，且合同不会成立。在本案中，侄子被吊销的驾照只使其驾驶该卡车的行为非法，而非购买行为。因此，这并未导致要约终止。

教学目的：构成合同的要约必须 (1) 向受要约人传达确定的条款，并且 (2) 对要约人订立有约束力的合同之意图做出客观合理的表达。如果邮寄是传达承诺的合理方式，那么此等要约可以通过邮件进行承诺，并且在发出时生效。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 24 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirements for an offer).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 63 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirements for acceptance).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 98 (Am. Law Inst. 2019) (mailbox rule).

MBE 合同法解析

Contracts: Offer & Acceptance

正确答案：C (5月6日)

本题考察的核心是要约的识别以及邮箱规则 (Mailbox Rule) 的应用。

📅 案件时间轴分析
5月1日 - 叔叔寄信
"I am thinking of selling... I would consider taking..."
这不是要约 (Not an Offer)。
Preliminary Negotiation / Invitation to Deal
5月3日 - 侄子回信
"I will buy... for $7,000 cash."
这是要约 (Offer)。
条款明确，意图清晰。
5月5日 - 叔叔收到信
要约到达受要约人，要约正式生效。
5月6日 - 叔叔寄出承诺信
"It's a deal."
合同成立 (Contract Formed)。
依据：邮箱规则 (Mailbox Rule)。
5月7日 - 侄子电话撤销
试图撤销要约。
无效 (Ineffective)。
因为合同已于昨日成立。
⚖️ 核心考点详解
1. 初步磋商 vs. 要约
Preliminary Negotiations vs. Offer

叔叔5月1日的信使用了 "thinking of"（考虑）和 "would consider"（会考虑）等词汇。在法律上，这仅仅是表达协商的意愿，缺乏受法律约束的意图 (Intent to be bound)。因此，它不是要约，侄子无法通过“接受”它来成立合同。
2. 邮箱规则 (Mailbox Rule)
Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 63

这是本题的解题关键。普通法规定，承诺 (Acceptance) 在寄出时 (upon dispatch) 即生效，而不是在收到时生效。
  • 前提：使用邮件是合理的沟通方式（本案中双方一直通过邮件沟通，符合条件）。
  • 结果：叔叔在5月6日将信投入邮箱的那一刻，合同锁死。
🚫 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (5月3日)： 错误。此时侄子刚发出要约，叔叔尚未承诺。单方发出要约不能成立合同。

选项 B (5月5日)： 错误。这是叔叔收到要约的时间。收到要约赋予了叔叔承诺的权力 (Power of Acceptance)，但收到本身并不构成合同。

选项 D (无合同)： 错误。侄子试图在5月7日撤销要约 (Revocation)。虽然撤销通常在收到时生效，但必须发生在承诺生效之前。由于承诺已于5月6日生效，5月7日的撤销太晚了。

关于驾照吊销： 这属于个人履行困难，不构成合同目的落空 (Frustration of Purpose) 或 履行不能 (Impossibility)。买车不代表必须由本人驾驶，购买行为本身并不违法。

questions.question:
A written construction contract, under which a contractor agreed to build a new house for a landowner at a fixed price of $200,000, contained the following provision: "Prior to construction or during the course thereof, this contract may be modified by mutual agreement of the parties as to 'extras' or other departures from the plans and specifications provided by the landowner and attached hereto. Such modifications, however, may be authorized only in writing, signed by both parties."
During construction, the contractor incorporated into the structure overhanging gargoyles and other "extras" orally requested by the landowner for orally agreed prices in addition to the contract price. The landowner subsequently refused to pay anything for such extras, aggregating $30,000 at the agreed prices, solely on the ground that no written, signed authorization for them was ever effected.
If the contractor sues the owner on account of the "extras," which, if any, of the following will effectively support the landowner's defense?

choices.a: The parol evidence rule and the failure of an express condition.
choices.b: The parol evidence rule and the statute of frauds.
choices.c: The preexisting duty rule and the failure of an express condition.
choices.d: Neither the parol evidence rule, the preexisting duty rule, the failure of an express condition, nor the statute of frauds.

Q81104

A written construction contract, under which a contractor agreed to build a new house for a landowner at a fixed price of $200,000, contained the following provision: "Prior to construction or during the course thereof, this contract may be modified by mutual agreement of the parties as to 'extras' or other departures from the plans and specifications provided by the landowner and attached hereto. Such modifications, however, may be authorized only in writing, signed by both parties."

During construction, the contractor incorporated into the structure overhanging gargoyles and other "extras" orally requested by the landowner for orally agreed prices in addition to the contract price. The landowner subsequently refused to pay anything for such extras, aggregating $30,000 at the agreed prices, solely on the ground that no written, signed authorization for them was ever effected.

If the contractor sues the owner on account of the "extras," which, if any, of the following will effectively support the landowner's defense?

一份书面建筑合同约定，承包商同意以20万美元的固定价格为土地所有者建造一座新房。该合同包含以下条款：“在施工前或施工期间，经双方共同同意，可就‘额外项目’或对土地所有者提供并附于此的计划和规格的其他偏离之处对本合同进行修改。但是，此类修改只能以书面形式授权，并由双方签字。”

在施工期间，承包商应土地所有者的口头要求，将悬挑的滴水嘴兽和其他“额外项目”并入建筑结构中，双方口头商定了在合同价格之外的额外费用。土地所有者随后拒绝为这些“额外项目”支付任何费用，按商定价格计算总计30,000美元，其唯一理由是双方从未就这些项目达成任何书面签署的授权。

如果承包商因“额外项目”起诉所有者，以下哪一项（如有）将有效支持土地所有者的抗辩？
options:
A. The parol evidence rule and the failure of an express condition.
口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule) 和明示条件 (express condition) 不成就。

B. The parol evidence rule and the statute of frauds.
口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule) 和防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds)。

C. The preexisting duty rule and the failure of an express condition.
已存义务规则 (preexisting duty rule) 和明示条件 (express condition) 不成就。

D. Neither the parol evidence rule, the preexisting duty rule, the failure of an express condition, nor the statute of frauds.
口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule)、已存义务规则 (preexisting duty rule)、明示条件 (express condition) 不成就或防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 均不适用。
data.explanation:
The parol evidence rule generally prevents a party to a written contract from presenting evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts the terms of the contract as written. But this rule does not bar evidence of subsequent agreements between the parties (eg, the parties' oral modifications regarding "extras" that occurred after the contract was entered) (Choices A & B).

An express condition is an explicit clause stating that an uncertain future event will (1) create a duty to perform (ie, condition precedent) or (2) extinguish a duty to perform (ie, condition subsequent). In addition, a party's duty to perform is excused if a condition precedent fails to occur. Here, the landowner's duty to pay for extras required a written modification signed by both parties - not the occurrence of an uncertain future event. Therefore, the failure to make such a writing was not a failure of an express condition (Choices A & C).

Under the statute of frauds, certain types of contract modifications must be in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. But a signed writing is not required to modify a construction contract if the modified contract can be completed within one year. And here, there is no indication that construction would necessarily take more than one year (Choice B).

Contract modifications require new consideration - ie, each party must alter his/her duties in some way. But a promise to perform, or the performance of, a preexisting duty does not constitute consideration. Here, the parties agreed that any "extras" would require a written modification - ie, there was no preexisting duty to provide extras. Therefore, the parties' oral modifications were supported by consideration (Choice C).

Educational objective: In a contract dispute, (1) the parol evidence rule can exclude evidence that contradicts a written contract, (2) the failure of an express condition can excuse a duty to perform, (3) the statute of frauds can invalidate an unwritten or unsigned contract, and (4) the preexisting duty rule can make a contract unenforceable for lack of consideration.

选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 20%，C选项 14%，D选项 45%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule) 通常禁止书面合同的一方当事人，就与书面合同条款相矛盾的先前或同期的协议，提交相关证据。但该规则不禁止关于双方当事人之间后续协议的证据（例如，双方在合同签订后就“额外项目”达成的口头修改）（选项 A & B）。

明示条件 (express condition) 是一个明确的条款，规定某个不确定的未来事件将会 (1) 创设一项履行义务（即先决条件, condition precedent），或 (2) 消灭一项履行义务（即后决条件, condition subsequent）。此外，如果先决条件 (condition precedent) 未能成就，一方当事人的履行义务将被免除。在本案中，土地所有者支付额外项目费用的义务要求有一份经双方签署的书面修改文件——而非一个不确定未来事件的发生。因此，未能出具该书面文件并非明示条件不成就 (选项 A & C)。

根据防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds)，某些类型的合同修改必须采用书面形式，并由被请求强制执行的一方签署。但是，如果修改后的建筑合同能够于一年内完成，则不需要书面签署文件。而在本案中，没有迹象表明建筑工程必然需要超过一年的时间 (选项 B)。

合同修改需要新的对价 (consideration)——即每一方当事人都必须以某种方式变更其义务。但是，履行或承诺履行一项已存义务 (preexisting duty) 不构成对价。在本案中，双方约定任何“额外项目”都需要书面修改——即不存在提供额外项目的已存义务。因此，双方的口头修改是有对价支持的 (选项 C)。

教学目标： 在合同纠纷中，(1) 口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule) 可以排除与书面合同相矛盾的证据，(2) 明示条件 (express condition) 不成就可以免除履行义务，(3) 防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 可以使未采用书面形式或未经签署的合同归于无效，(4) 已存义务规则 (preexisting duty rule) 可以因缺乏对价 (consideration) 而使合同不可强制执行。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 213 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an integrated writing supersedes inconsistent terms of prior agreements).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the non-occurrence of a condition precedent discharges the duty to perform when the condition can no longer occur).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 125 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (statute of frauds vis-à-vis transfers of land).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 73 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that performance of a preexisting legal duty is not consideration).

MBE 考点解析

合同修改与抗辩理由

✅ 正确答案：D

没有任何一项理由能有效支持土地所有者的抗辩。这意味着承包商有权获得“额外项目”的付款。

本题考察的核心是：当书面合同规定“禁止口头修改”时，后续的口头修改是否有效？ 以及常见的合同抗辩理由是否适用。

📜 1. 口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule)

定义： 禁止引入与书面合同矛盾的先前或同期的口头协议证据。

为什么不适用？
本案中的口头修改发生在合同签订之后 (Subsequent Agreement)。PER 规则从不禁止双方在合同签订后改变主意并修改合同。

✍️ 2. 防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

定义： 某些特定类型的合同（如土地买卖、无法在一年内履行的合同）必须书面签署才有效。

为什么不适用？
这是一个服务合同（建筑），不适用 UCC 的 $500 商品规则。且题目未表明该工程无法在一年内完成。因此，法律不强制要求此修改必须书面化。

🔄 3. 已存义务规则 (Preexisting Duty Rule)

定义： 承诺做一件你法律上已经有义务做的事，不构成新的对价 (Consideration)。

为什么不适用？
承包商建造的是“额外项目” (Extras)，这是原合同范围之外的工作。承包商承担了新的义务，因此构成了有效的新对价。

🚫 4. 明示条件 (Express Condition)

核心考点： 合同中规定“修改必须书面” (No Oral Modification Clause)。

为什么不适用？
在普通法 (Common Law) 下，即使合同写明“禁止口头修改”，双方随后的口头协议和实际履行行为（承包商建造了滴水嘴兽）通常被视为对该书面要求的弃权 (Waiver) 或有效的修改。

书面要求并非支付义务的“先决条件”，而是一个程序性条款，当双方都同意口头变更并依此履行时，该条款即失效。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 涉及普通法 (Common Law) 的服务/建筑合同中，如果看到“禁止口头修改”条款，但双方随后进行了口头修改并实际履行了，法院通常会支持口头修改有效（视为 Waiver）。不要被合同里的书面条款吓倒！

questions.question:
On April 1, the owner of a house and a real estate investor signed a writing in which the owner, "in consideration of $100 to be paid to the owner by the investor," offered the investor the right to purchase the house for $100,000 within 30 days. The writing further provided, "This offer will become effective as an option only if and when the $100 consideration is in fact paid."
On April 20, the owner, having received no payment or other communication from the investor, sold and conveyed the house to the investor's business rival for $120,000. On April 21, the owner received a letter from the investor enclosing a cashier's check for $100 payable to the owner and stating, "I am hereby exercising my option to purchase the house and am prepared to close whenever you're ready."
Which of the following, if proved, best supports the investor's suit against the owner for breach of contract?

choices.a: On April 15, the investor decided to purchase the house, and applied for and obtained a commitment from a bank for a $75,000 loan to help finance the purchase.
choices.b: The investor was unaware of the sale to his business rival when the owner received the letter and check from the investor on April 21.
choices.c: The owner and the investor are both professional dealers in real estate.
choices.d: When the April 1 writing was signed, the owner said to the investor, "Don't worry about the $100; the recital of '$100 to be paid' makes this deal binding."

data.questionStem:
Q81080

On April 1, the owner of a house and a real estate investor signed a writing in which the owner, "in consideration of $100 to be paid to the owner by the investor," offered the investor the right to purchase the house for $100,000 within 30 days. The writing further provided, "This offer will become effective as an option only if and when the $100 consideration is in fact paid."

On April 20, the owner, having received no payment or other communication from the investor, sold and conveyed the house to the investor's business rival for $120,000. On April 21, the owner received a letter from the investor enclosing a cashier's check for $100 payable to the owner and stating, "I am hereby exercising my option to purchase the house and am prepared to close whenever you're ready."

Which of the following, if proved, best supports the investor's suit against the owner for breach of contract?

4月1日，一所房屋的所有权人与一位房地产投资者签署了一份书面文件，其中所有权人“以投资者向所有权人支付100美元为对价”，向该投资者要约，授予其在30天内以100,000美元购买该房屋的权利。该书面文件进一步规定，“该要约只有在100美元的对价实际支付后，才作为一项选择权生效。”

4月20日，所有权人在未收到投资者任何付款或其他通知的情况下，以120,000美元的价格将该房屋出售并转让给了该投资者的商业竞争对手。4月21日，所有权人收到了投资者的一封信，内附一张抬头为所有权人的100美元银行本票，信中写道：“我在此行使我购买该房屋的选择权，并准备好随时完成交易。”

以下哪一项如果得以证明，最能支持投资者以违约为由对所有权人提起的诉讼？
options:
A. On April 15, the investor decided to purchase the house, and applied for and obtained a commitment from a bank for a $75,000 loan to help finance the purchase.
4月15日，投资者决定购买该房屋，并向银行申请且获得了一笔75,000美元的贷款承诺，以资助此次购买。

B. The investor was unaware of the sale to his business rival when the owner received the letter and check from the investor on April 21.
在所有权人于4月21日收到投资者的信和支票时，投资者对其商业竞争对手购得此房一事并不知情。

C. The owner and the investor are both professional dealers in real estate.
所有权人和投资者都是专业的房地产交易商。

D. When the April 1 writing was signed, the owner said to the investor, "Don't worry about the $100; the recital of '$100 to be paid' makes this deal binding."
在4月1日的书面文件签署时，所有权人对投资者说：“别担心那100美元；‘将支付100美元’的叙述已使这笔交易具有约束力。”
data.explanation:
Irrevocable offers


TypeDescriptionConsiderationDuration
UCC Firm offerMerchant gives written & signed assurance that offer will remain openNot requiredSpecified or reasonable time
Common law Option contractOfferor promises to keep offer open in exchange for considerationRequired
Common law Partial performance (unilateral contracts)Offeror invites acceptance only by performance & offeree begins to performReasonable time for full performance
Promissory estoppel†Offeror could reasonably foresee reliance on offer & offeree reasonably relies to his/her detrimentNot requiredReasonable time
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

†Also referred to as "detrimental reliance."An option is a contract in which the offeree gives consideration (eg, money) in exchange for the offeror's promise to keep an outstanding offer open for a specified period of time. An offer to form an option is revocable prior to acceptance of the option. Revocation occurs when:

  • the offeror directly communicates the revocation to the offeree or
  • the offeree learns information from a reliable source that reasonably indicates the offer was revoked (eg, house sold to another buyer).


Here, the owner offered the investor the option to purchase the house for $100,000 within 30 days. The investor had to pay $100 to accept this option, which the owner received on April 21.† Although the owner had already sold the house to someone else, he had not told the investor that the offer to form an option was revoked. So if the investor was unaware of the other sale, there was no revocation prior to his acceptance and exercise of the option on April 21, and the owner breached the resulting sales contract.

†Under the mailbox rule, acceptance of an offer is generally effective upon dispatch. However, one exception to the mailbox rule applies to option contracts, where acceptance is effective upon receipt.

(Choice A) An offer may become irrevocable under the doctrine of promissory estoppel (also called detrimental reliance) if the offeree reasonably and detrimentally relied upon that offer. But here, it was unreasonable for the investor to obtain a loan before paying the $100 required to keep the offer open.

(Choice C) Under Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code, a firm offer from a merchant (ie, professional dealer in the type of goods sold) is binding. But this only applies to contracts for the sale of goods, not real property.

(Choice D) A binding option requires actual consideration - not sham consideration (eg, a recital of consideration that is not intended to be paid). Here, the investor's statement ("Don't worry about the $100") would show that the consideration was not intended to be paid.

Educational objective: An offer to form an option contract is revocable before the option is accepted. Revocation occurs when (1) the offeror directly communicates the revocation to the offeree or (2) the offeree obtains reliable information that reasonably indicates the offer was revoked.

选项正确率统计：A选项 24%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 31%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不可撤销的要约


类型描述对价期限
UCC商家固定要约商家以书面形式并签署保证，该要约将保持开放非必需指定时间或合理时间
普通法上的选择权合同要约人承诺保持要约开放，以换取对价必需
普通法上的部分履行 (单方合同)要约人仅以履行行为邀请承诺，且受要约人已开始履行完成全部履行的合理时间
允诺禁反言原则†要约人可合理预见到受要约人将信赖其要约，且受要约人已合理信赖该要约并因此遭受损害非必需合理时间
UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)。

†亦称“损害性信赖”。

选择权是一种合同，其中受要约人支付对价（例如，金钱），以换取要约人承诺在指定期限内保持一项未决的要约开放。订立选择权合同的要约在选择权被接受之前是可撤销的。撤销发生在以下情况：

  • 要约人直接向受要约人传达撤销的意图或
  • 受要约人从可靠来源获知了合理表明要约已被撤销的信息（例如，房屋已售予另一买家）。


在本案中，所有权人向投资者要约，授予其在30天内以100,000美元购买该房屋的选择权。投资者必须支付100美元来接受此选择权，所有权人于4月21日收到了这笔款项。† 尽管所有权人已将房屋出售给他人，但他并未告知投资者订立选择权合同的要约已被撤销。因此，如果投资者不知情该房屋已另行出售，那么在他于4月21日接受并执行选择权之前，要约并未被撤销，所有权人违反了因此成立的买卖合同。

†根据邮箱规则，对要约的接受通常在发出时生效。但是，邮箱规则的一个例外适用于选择权合同，其接受在收到时生效。

(选项A) 根据允诺禁反言原则（也称为损害性信赖），如果受要约人合理地信赖了要约并因此遭受损害，则该要约可能变为不可撤销。但在本案中，投资者在支付为保持要约开放所需的100美元之前就去获取贷款，是不合理的。

(选项C) 根据《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code) 第2条，来自商家（即所售货物类型的专业经销商）的固定要约具有约束力。但这仅适用于货物买卖合同，而不适用于不动产。

(选项D) 一个有约束力的选择权需要真实的对价——而不是虚假的对价（例如，名义上记载但无意支付的对价）。此处，所有权人的陈述（“别担心那100美元”）将表明该对价并无意被支付。

教学目的：订立选择权合同的要约在选择权被接受之前是可撤销的。撤销发生于（1）要约人直接向受要约人传达撤销意图，或（2）受要约人从可靠来源获得合理表明要约已被撤销的信息。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 42 - 43 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (direct and indirect communication of revocation).

MBE 考点解析

合同法：要约的撤销与选择权合同
⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题考察的是普通法下要约的撤销（Revocation of Offer）以及间接撤销（Indirect Revocation）的构成要件。

关键原则：要约人在受要约人承诺之前，通常可以随时撤销要约。撤销可以通过两种方式生效：

  1. 直接撤销：要约人直接通知受要约人。
  2. 间接撤销 (Indirect Revocation)：受要约人从可靠渠道获知要约人已采取了与合同不一致的行为（例如将标的物卖给了他人）。

📝 案情拆解

  • 4月1日：所有权人发出要约。注意，这还不是一个有效的选择权合同（Option Contract），因为题目明确规定“只有支付100美元后才生效”。在此之前，它只是一个可撤销的要约。
  • 4月20日：所有权人将房子卖给了第三方。这是与原要约不一致的行为。
  • 4月21日：投资者寄出支票试图行权（承诺）。
✅ 选项 B 是正确答案

理由：为了使“间接撤销”生效，受要约人（投资者）必须知情。

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》第43条 (Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 43)，只有当受要约人获得可靠信息表明要约人已采取与要约不一致的行动时，要约才算被撤销。

如果投资者在4月21日寄出支票（承诺）时，不知道房子已经卖给了竞争对手，那么对他而言，要约仍然有效。他在不知情的情况下完成了承诺（支付对价），合同因此成立。所有权人无法履行合同，构成违约。

❌ 选项 A 错误 (允诺禁反言)

虽然允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel) 可以让要约不可撤销，但这要求受要约人的信赖是“合理的”。在本案中，仅需支付100美元即可锁定选择权，投资者却在未支付这笔小额款项的情况下先去办理7.5万美元的贷款，这种信赖通常被认定为不合理 (Unreasonable)，因此不能阻止要约的撤销。

❌ 选项 C 错误 (UCC vs Common Law)

这是MBE常见的干扰项。UCC (统一商法典) 的“商家固定要约规则” (Firm Offer Rule) 确实不需要对价，但它仅适用于货物买卖 (Sale of Goods)。本案涉及房地产 (Real Estate)，适用普通法 (Common Law)，必须有对价才能形成不可撤销的选择权。

❌ 选项 D 错误 (虚假对价)

如果双方同意“不用担心那100美元”，这意味着该对价是虚假的 (Sham Consideration) 且无意支付。没有真实的对价，就没有有效的选择权合同，要约人可以随时撤销要约。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“房屋出售给第三方”的题目时，立即检查受要约人是否知道这一事实：

  • 如果知道（哪怕是听说） ➡️ 要约已撤销 (Revoked)。
  • 如果不知道 ➡️ 要约仍有效，受要约人仍可承诺 (Accept)。

A general contractor about to bid on a construction job for an office building invited a carpenter and several others to bid on the carpentry work. The carpenter agreed to bid if the general contractor would agree to give the carpenter the job provided that his bid was lowest and the general contractor was awarded the main contract. The general contractor so agreed. The carpenter, incurring time and expense in preparing his bid, submitted the lowest carpentry bid. The general contractor used the carpenter's bid in calculating its own bid, which was successful.
Which of the following best supports the carpenter's position that the general contractor is obligated to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter?

choices.a: The carpenter detrimentally relied on the general contractor's conditional promise in preparing his bid.
choices.b: The carpenter gave consideration for the general contractor's conditional promise to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter.
choices.c: The general contractor has an implied duty to deal fairly and in good faith with all bidders whose bids the general contractor used in calculating its main bid to the building owner.
choices.d: The general contractor has an obligation to the owner of the building to subcontract with the carpenter because the carpenter's bid was used in calculating the general contractor's bid, and the carpenter is an intended beneficiary of that obligation.

Q81818 A general contractor about to bid on a construction job for an office building invited a carpenter and several others to bid on the carpentry work. The carpenter agreed to bid if the general contractor would agree to give the carpenter the job provided that his bid was lowest and the general contractor was awarded the main contract. The general contractor so agreed. The carpenter, incurring time and expense in preparing his bid, submitted the lowest carpentry bid. The general contractor used the carpenter's bid in calculating its own bid, which was successful.

Which of the following best supports the carpenter's position that the general contractor is obligated to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter? 一位总承包商准备对一栋办公楼的建筑工程进行投标，邀请了一位木工和其他几个人对木工工程进行投标。该木工同意投标，条件是如果他的报价最低且总承包商获得了主合同，总承包商就同意将该工作授予他。总承包商同意了。该木工在准备其投标时花费了时间和费用，并提交了最低的木工报价。总承包商在计算自己的投标报价时使用了该木工的报价，并成功中标。

以下哪项最能支持该木工的立场，即总承包商有义务将木工分包合同授予该木工？
options:
A. The carpenter detrimentally relied on the general contractor's conditional promise in preparing his bid.
该木工在准备其投标时，对总承包商的附条件承诺产生了不利依赖。

B. The carpenter gave consideration for the general contractor's conditional promise to award the carpentry subcontract to the carpenter.
该木工为总承包商授予其木工分包合同的附条件承诺提供了对价。

C. The general contractor has an implied duty to deal fairly and in good faith with all bidders whose bids the general contractor used in calculating its main bid to the building owner.
总承包商对其在计算给业主的总报价时所使用的所有投标人的投标，都负有公平和善意交易的默示义务。

D. The general contractor has an obligation to the owner of the building to subcontract with the carpenter because the carpenter's bid was used in calculating the general contractor's bid, and the carpenter is an intended beneficiary of that obligation.
总承包商对业主有义务与该木工签订分包合同，因为该木工的报价被用于计算总承包商的投标，并且该木工是该义务的意图受益人。
data.explanation:
Elements of valuable consideration


Bargained-for exchangeEach party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise
Legal detrimentEach party must relinquish legal right by either:

performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or
refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act
A contract is generally formed when an exchange of promises is supported by valuable consideration—ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. However, performance under that agreement can be made contingent upon a condition. There are two types of conditions:

Condition precedent – where a party's duty to perform arises upon the occurrence or nonoccurrence of an uncertain future event (ie, the event creates the duty)

Condition subsequent – where a party's duty to perform is released upon the occurrence or nonoccurrence of an uncertain future event (ie, the event extinguishes the duty)

Here, the carpenter offered to bid on the carpentry work in exchange for the contractor's promise to award the carpenter the subcontract. This exchange of promises provided valuable consideration to form a binding agreement. The contractor's performance of that agreement was contingent upon the carpenter submitting the lowest bid and the contractor receiving the main contract. Since these conditions precedent occurred, the contractor was obligated to award the subcontract to the carpenter.

(Choice A) The doctrine of promissory estoppel allows a party to enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. A contract was formed here, so the carpenter's reliance is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The duty of good faith and fair dealing is implied in every contract—but not bids and other mere offers. Therefore, this duty would extend to the carpenter, but not other bidders with whom no contract was formed.

(Choice D) An intended beneficiary is a person who is intentionally given an advantage under a contract to which the person is not a party and may therefore enforce those contractual obligations. Here, the carpenter's bid was used in the contractor and building owner's agreement. But since there is no evidence that this agreement was intended to benefit the carpenter, he is merely an incidental beneficiary who has no right to enforce the agreement.

有效对价的要素


协商交换每一方签订协议的意愿必须由另一方的行为/承诺所引诱
法律上的损害每一方必须通过以下任一方式放弃一项合法权利：

履行（或承诺履行）法律上不要求的行为或
不实施（或承诺不实施）法律上允许的行为
当承诺的交换有有效对价——即承诺或履行的协商交换——支持时，合同通常即告成立。但是，该协议项下的履行可以以一个条件为前提。条件有两种类型：

先决条件 – 指一方的履行义务在一个不确定的未来事件发生或不发生时产生（即，该事件产生了义务）

解除条件 – 指一方的履行义务在一个不确定的未来事件发生或不发生时被解除（即，该事件消灭了义务）

在本案中，木工提出对木工工程进行投标，以换取承包商承诺将分包合同授予该木工。这种承诺的交换为形成一个有约束力的协议提供了有效对价。承包商履行该协议的前提条件是木工提交最低报价且承包商获得主合同。由于这些先决条件已经发生，承包商有义务将分包合同授予该木工。

(选项A) 允诺禁反言原则允许一方在没有成立有效合同的情况下，强制执行其合理且不利地依赖的承诺。本案中已经成立了合同，所以木工的依赖是无关紧要的。

(选项C) 善意和公平交易的义务是每份合同中都默示包含的——但不包括投标和其他仅仅是要约的情况。因此，这项义务将延伸至该木工，但不包括其他未与之形成合同的投标人。

(选项D) 意图受益人是指在一个其并非当事人的合同项下，被有意给予利益的人，因此可以强制执行这些合同义务。在本案中，木工的报价被用于承包商和业主的协议中。但由于没有证据表明该协议意图使木工受益，他仅仅是一个无权强制执行该协议的附带受益人。

Educational objective:
A contract is generally formed when an exchange of promises is supported by valuable consideration and may include conditions that delay (condition precedent) or extinguish (condition subsequent) a party's promised performance.

References
Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange as consideration).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 447 (conditions precedent).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 453 (conditions subsequent).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Consideration & Bidding

⚖️ 核心法律概念

本题考察的是合同法中最基础但也最容易混淆的概念：对价 (Consideration) 与 附条件合同 (Conditional Contract) 的形成。

关键在于识别这是一个“关于投标的协议”，而不仅仅是普通的投标行为。

🔍 案情逻辑拆解
木工 (Carpenter)
承诺：花费时间/金钱去投标
⇅ 交换 (Exchange) ⇅
总包 (General Contractor)
承诺：如果中标且你最低，就给你做

注意：通常情况下，分包商投标只是一个要约 (Offer)，总包使用报价并不构成承诺 (Acceptance)。但本题中，双方在投标前已经达成了一个具体的交换协议。

✅ 为什么选 B (Consideration)？

法律依据：有效的合同需要对价 (Consideration)，即“协商后的交换” (Bargained-for exchange)。

  • 木工的对价：虽然木工想接活，但他没有法律义务必须投标。他花费时间和费用准备标书，构成了法律上的受损 (Legal Detriment)。
  • 总包的对价：承诺在特定条件下（中标+最低价）将工作交给木工。

因为双方交换了相互的承诺，一个附带先决条件 (Condition Precedent) 的有效合同已经成立。一旦条件满足（木工最低价且总包中标），总包必须履行义务。

⚠️ 为什么不选 A (Promissory Estoppel)？

这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。

允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel) 是衡平法上的救济手段，通常用于没有有效合同但需要防止不公平时。

在本题中，既然已经通过“对价”成立了有效合同（如选项 B 所述），就没有必要退而求其次使用“禁反言”理论。合同法原则优先于衡平法原则。

🚫 其他选项排除
  • 选项 C (Good Faith)： 善意原则存在于已成立的合同中。如果认为合同未成立，该原则不适用；如果合同已成立，选项 B 才是合同成立的根基。
  • 选项 D (Beneficiary)： 总包和业主的主合同是为了业主的利益，木工只是附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)，无权据此起诉。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在涉及建筑投标 (Construction Bids) 的题目中：

  1. 默认情况：分包商投标 = Offer（可撤销）；总包使用报价 ≠ Acceptance。
  2. 例外情况 (本题)：如果双方在投标前有明确的对话和交换承诺（"如果你投，我就..."），则构成合同。
  3. 解题思路：先看是否有 Consideration 构成合同；如果没有，再看是否有 Reliance 构成 Estoppel。

questions.question:
A woman was driving home from a crowded shopping mall when a passenger van ran through a stoplight at great speed and hit the woman's car. A physician who witnessed the incident pulled over to the woman's car and saw that her shoulder was seriously injured. The physician told the woman he was a licensed surgeon before helping her out of the car. The woman was delirious and too shaken to speak as the physician removed several glass fragments from her shoulder and applied temporary sutures to close the wound. When the physician finished, he took the woman's contact information and promised to check on her condition later.
If the physician subsequently sends the woman a bill for his services, will she be obligated to pay it?

choices.a: No, because it would be unconscionable to require that the woman pay for the physician's emergency medical services.
choices.b: No, because the physician had a duty to render aid to the woman once he saw that she was injured.
choices.c: Yes, because an implied-in-fact contract was created when the woman allowed the physician to treat her.
choices.d: Yes, because the law will imply a promise to pay for emergency services the physician rendered to the woman.

一名女士正从一个拥挤的购物中心开车回家，一辆客货车高速闯红灯，撞上了她的车。一位目睹了这起事故的医生将车停在女士的车旁，看到她的肩膀严重受伤。在帮助她下车前，医生告诉女士他是一名有执照的外科医生。当医生从她的肩膀上取出几块玻璃碎片并用临时缝合线缝合伤口时，该女士神志不清，惊吓得说不出话来。医生处理完毕后，留下了女士的联系方式，并承诺稍后会查看她的情况。

如果医生随后向该女士发送了服务账单，她是否有义务支付？
options:
A. No, because it would be unconscionable to require that the woman pay for the physician's emergency medical services.
不，因为要求该女士支付医生的紧急医疗服务费用是不合情理的。

B. No, because the physician had a duty to render aid to the woman once he saw that she was injured.
不，因为医生在看到该女士受伤后，有义务向她提供援助。

C. Yes, because an implied-in-fact contract was created when the woman allowed the physician to treat her.
是，因为当该女士允许医生为她治疗时，就形成了一份事实默示合同。

D. Yes, because the law will imply a promise to pay for emergency services the physician rendered to the woman.
是，因为法律将默示一个支付医生为该女士提供的紧急服务的承诺。
data.explanation:
In the absence of any contractual relationship between the parties, courts have the power to construct an implied-in-law ("quasi") contract to prevent unjust enrichment when:

  • the plaintiff has conferred a measurable benefit (eg, medical services) on the defendant
  • the plaintiff acted without gratuitous intent and
  • it would be unfair to let the defendant retain the benefit without compensating the plaintiff.


Unfair retention of a benefit arises when (1) the defendant had an opportunity to decline the benefit but knowingly accepted it or (2) the plaintiff had a reasonable excuse for not giving the defendant such opportunity - often because of an emergency. This allows the plaintiff in a quasi-contract action to recover restitutionary damages equal to the reasonable value of the benefit conferred.

Here, the physician conferred a measurable benefit on the woman when he removed glass from her shoulder and closed the wound. Medical services are typically provided with the expectation of compensation. And since the woman was delirious and too shaken to speak, it was reasonable for the physician to act without obtaining her express consent. Therefore, she must pay the physician's bill because the law will imply a promise to pay for his service.

(Choice A) Allowing the woman to retain a benefit without compensating the physician would be unjust - not unconscionable. Unconscionability instead arises when a contract is so unfair to one party that no reasonable person in that position would have agreed to it.

(Choice B) The physician may have had a moral duty to aid the woman once he saw that she was injured, but he had no legal duty to do so.

(Choice C) An implied-in- fact contract arises when the parties' conduct (or failure to act) demonstrates their mutual intent to contract. But here, a court would not find that the woman intended to contract with the physician since she was delirious and unable to speak.

Educational objective: Courts will construct an implied-in-law ("quasi") contract where the plaintiff has conferred a measurable benefit on the defendant without gratuitous intent and it would be unfair to let the defendant retain the benefit without compensating the plaintiff.



选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 1%，C选项 20%，D选项 46%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在双方之间没有任何合同关系的情况下，当满足以下条件时，法院有权构建一份法律默示（“准”）合同 (implied-in-law ("quasi") contract)，以防止不当得利 (unjust enrichment)：

  • 原告授予了被告可计量的利益 (measurable benefit)（例如，医疗服务）
  • 原告的行为并非出于无偿意图 (without gratuitous intent) 并且
  • 让被告保留该利益 (retain the benefit) 而不对原告进行补偿是不公平的 (unfair)。


不公平地保留利益发生在以下情况：(1) 被告有机会拒绝该利益但知情地接受了它，或 (2) 原告有合理的理由没有给被告这样的机会——通常是由于紧急情况。这允许准合同诉讼中的原告获得相当于所授予利益合理价值的返还性损害赔偿 (restitutionary damages)。

在本案中，医生从女士的肩膀上取出玻璃并缝合伤口，授予了她可计量的利益。医疗服务通常是在期望获得报酬的情况下提供的。而且，由于该女士神志不清，惊吓得说不出话来，医生在未获得她明确同意的情况下采取行动是合理的。因此，她必须支付医生的账单，因为法律将默示一个支付其服务费用的承诺。

(选项 A) 允许该女士保留利益而不对医生进行补偿将是不公正的 (unjust)——而不是不合情理的 (unconscionable)。不合情理是指当一份合同对一方如此不公平，以至于处于该位置的任何理性人都不会同意该合同时才会产生。

(选项 B) 医生在看到该女士受伤后，可能有道义上的责任去帮助她，但他没有法律上的义务这样做。

(选项 C) 当双方的行为（或不作为）表明他们有订立合同的共同意图时，就会产生一份事实默示合同 (implied-in-fact contract)。但在本案中，法院不会认定该女士有意与医生订立合同，因为她神志不清，无法说话。

教学目标：当原告在没有无偿意图的情况下授予被告可计量的利益，并且让被告保留该利益而不对原告进行补偿是不公平的时，法院将构建一份法律默示（“准”）合同。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Restitution & Unjust Enrichment § 20 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (protection of another's life or health).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Quasi-Contract
核心法律原则：准合同 (Quasi-Contract)

本题考查的是在没有正式协议的情况下，法律如何防止不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)。这通常被称为法律默示合同 (Implied-in-Law Contract)。

为什么选 D？(正确答案解析)

虽然双方没有口头或书面的协议，但法律会在特定情况下“构建”一个合同来强制一方付款。这基于恢复原状 (Restitution) 的原则。

构成准合同并要求支付紧急医疗费用的要素通常包括：

  • 原告提供了可计量的利益 (Measurable Benefit)（医疗服务）。
  • 原告的行为并非出于无偿意图 (Without Gratuitous Intent)（医生通常是收费的专业人士，而非路人）。
  • 被告无法表示同意（因神志不清/受伤），但如果神志清醒，理性的被告会同意接受该服务。

在本案中，医生提供了专业的紧急服务，且女士因神志不清无法当场同意。为了防止女士“不公平地”享受了医疗服务而不付费，法律默示了一个支付承诺。

易错项辨析
选项 C 错误：事实默示合同 (Implied-in-Fact Contract)
这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。
  • Implied-in-Fact 需要双方通过行为表现出达成协议的意图（例如：你走进理发店坐下，理发师开始理发）。
  • 本案中，女士神志不清 (delirious)，她没有能力通过行为表达“同意”。因此不存在“事实”上的合同，只有“法律”强加的义务。
选项 B 错误：救助义务 (Duty to Render Aid)
在美国普通法中，除非存在特殊关系（如父母子女），一般人（包括下班的医生）没有法律义务去救助陌生人。虽然医生可能有道德义务，但没有法律义务。因此，他提供服务是自愿的专业行为，有权获得报酬。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
在合同法题目中，如果一方神志不清、昏迷或处于紧急危难中无法说话，而专业人士提供了帮助：
1. 排除 Implied-in-Fact Contract（因为缺乏合意/Intent）。
2. 选择 Implied-in-Law / Quasi-Contract / Restitution（基于防止不当得利）。
3. 记住关键词：Unjust Enrichment。

questions.question:
A restaurant supplier sent a letter to a regular customer offering to sell the customer an industrial freezer for $10,000. Two days later, the customer responded with a letter that stated: "I accept your offer on the condition that you provide me with a warranty that the freezer is merchantable." In response to the customer's letter, the supplier called the customer and stated that the offer was no longer open. The supplier promptly sold the freezer to another buyer for $11,000.
If the customer sues the supplier for breach of contract, is the customer likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the customer's letter added a term, making it a counteroffer.
choices.b: No, because the subsequent sale to a bona fide purchaser for value cut off the claims of the customer.
choices.c: Yes, because the customer's letter was an acceptance of the supplier's offer, since the warranty of merchantability was already implied in the sale.
choices.d: Yes, because the supplier's letter was a firm offer that could not be revoked for a reasonable time.

data.questionStem:
Q81100

A restaurant supplier sent a letter to a regular customer offering to sell the customer an industrial freezer for $10,000. Two days later, the customer responded with a letter that stated: "I accept your offer on the condition that you provide me with a warranty that the freezer is merchantable." In response to the customer's letter, the supplier called the customer and stated that the offer was no longer open. The supplier promptly sold the freezer to another buyer for $11,000.

If the customer sues the supplier for breach of contract, is the customer likely to prevail?

一家餐厅供应商致信一位老客户，要约以10,000美元的价格向该客户出售一台工业冰柜。两天后，该客户回信称：“我接受你的要约，条件是你向我提供一项保证，确保该冰柜具有可商售性。” 针对客户的信函，供应商致电客户，声称该要约已不再有效。供应商随即以11,000美元的价格将该冰柜出售给了另一位买家。

如果客户以违约为由起诉供应商，客户是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the customer's letter added a term, making it a counteroffer.
不会，因为客户的信函增加了一项条款，使其成为一项反要约。

B. No, because the subsequent sale to a bona fide purchaser for value cut off the claims of the customer.
不会，因为随后向善意有偿购买人的出售行为切断了客户的索赔权。

C. Yes, because the customer's letter was an acceptance of the supplier's offer, since the warranty of merchantability was already implied in the sale.
会，因为客户的信函是对供应商要约的承诺，鉴于可商售性保证已经默示包含在销售中。

D. Yes, because the supplier's letter was a firm offer that could not be revoked for a reasonable time.
会，因为供应商的信函是一项在合理期限内不可撤销的确定要约（firm offer）。
data.explanation:
Effect of new terms in reply to offer


Common law
(mirror-image)		Offer rejected
Reply treated as counteroffer
UCC (battle of the forms)
≥1 party is nonmerchant		Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms
New/revised terms treated as proposed additions to contract
UCC (battle of the forms)
All parties are merchants		Offer accepted unless reply expressly required assent to new/revised terms
New terms become part of contract unless:
  • offer expressly required assent to new terms
  • new terms materially alter contract or
  • offeror objects within reasonable time
Revised terms follow split authority & are either:
  • treated as new terms or
  • cancelled out under knockout rule
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the common law, an acceptance is only effective if it is the mirror-image of the terms in the offer. This rule has been relaxed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), which governs contracts for the sale of goods (eg, industrial freezers). The UCC uses the battle-of-the-forms rule, where any reasonable manifestation of acceptance - even one including new terms - is effective unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to the new terms.

Here, the customer's letter conditioned his acceptance on the freezer's warranty of merchantability. But under the UCC, this warranty is implied in all contracts for the sale of goods by a merchant - ie, one who regularly deals in goods of the kind involved in the contract (like the supplier). Therefore, the letter did not add a term (Choice A). Instead, it was an acceptance of the supplier's offer that created an enforceable contract. And since the supplier breached that contract by selling the freezer to another buyer, the customer is likely to prevail.

(Choice B) The sale of the freezer to a bona fide purchaser - ie, one who purchased for value and in good faith - may prevent the customer from seeking specific performance from the supplier. However, this would not prevent the buyer from obtaining a legal remedy (ie, damages) for the supplier's breach.

(Choice D) A firm offer is a merchant's signed, written offer to buy or sell goods that promises to hold the offer open for a period of time - not seen here.

Educational objective: Under the UCC's battle-of-the-forms rule, any reasonable manifestation of acceptance (even one including new terms) is effective unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to the new terms.

选项正确率统计：A选项 38%，B选项 1%，C选项 56%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对要约答复中新增条款的效力


普通法
（镜像规则）		要约被拒绝
答复被视为反要约
UCC（格式之战）
≥1方为非商人		要约被接受，除非答复明确要求同意新增/修改的条款
新增/修改的条款被视为对合同的附加建议
UCC（格式之战）
所有当事人均为商人		要约被接受，除非答复明确要求同意新增/修改的条款
新增条款成为合同的一部分，除非：
  • 要约明确要求同意新增条款
  • 新增条款对合同作出实质性变更或
  • 要约人在合理时间内提出异议
修改条款遵循不同裁判观点，其处理方式为：
  • 被视为新增条款或
  • 根据剔除规则（knockout rule）被取消
UCC = 《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）。

根据普通法，一项承诺只有在与要约条款呈镜像关系时才有效。这一规则已被《统一商法典》（UCC）第二条所放宽，该法典管辖货物（例如工业冰柜）销售合同。UCC采用格式之战规则（battle-of-the-forms rule），据此，任何合理的承诺表示——即使包含新条款——都是有效的，除非该承诺明确以要约人同意新条款为条件。

在本案中，客户的信函将其承诺建立在冰柜具有可商售性保证的基础上。但根据 UCC，此项保证默示包含在商人——即经常从事合同所涉类型货物交易的人（如本案中的供应商）——进行的所有货物销售合同中。因此，该信函并没有增加条款（选项 A）。相反，它构成了对供应商要约的承诺，从而成立了一份可强制执行的合同。由于供应商将冰柜出售给另一买家而违反了该合同，客户很可能胜诉。

（选项 B）将冰柜出售给善意购买人——即有偿且善意购买的人——可能会阻止客户向供应商寻求特定履行。然而，这并不妨碍买方就供应商的违约行为获得法律救济（即损害赔偿）。

（选项 D）确定要约（firm offer）是指商人作出的、经签署的书面货物买卖要约，其中承诺在一段时间内保持要约有效——本案中并未出现此种情况。

教学目标：根据 UCC 的格式之战规则，任何合理的承诺表示（即使包含新条款）都是有效的，除非该承诺明确以要约人同意新条款为条件。

References

U.C.C. § 2-207 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (battle-of-the-forms rule).

U.C.C. § 2-314 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (implied warranty of merchantability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2
正确答案：C

本题考察的是美国《统一商法典》（UCC）下的合同成立规则，特别是关于“格式之战” (Battle of the Forms) 和默示担保 (Implied Warranties) 的交叉应用。

核心考点分析

要理解为什么客户会胜诉，我们需要拆解两个关键法律概念：

1. 默示的可商售性担保
(Implied Warranty of Merchantability)

根据 UCC § 2-314，如果卖方是该类货物的商人 (Merchant)，那么除非明确排除，否则销售合同中自动包含“货物具有可商售性”的默示担保。

在本案中，供应商是“餐厅供应商”，向客户出售“工业冰柜”，显然是该领域的商人。因此，无论客户是否提及，这项担保已经是合同的一部分。

2. 附条件的承诺
(Conditional Acceptance)

通常情况下，根据 UCC § 2-207(1)，如果受要约人在回复中明确表示“接受要约，条件是 (on the condition that) 你同意我的新条款”，这通常构成反要约 (Counteroffer)，而不是承诺。

但是（这是本题的陷阱）：

客户要求的条件（可商售性担保）是法律已经赋予他的权利。客户并没有增加任何新的义务，也没有改变交易的实质内容。

逻辑推演
  • 客户的信函虽然使用了“条件是...”的措辞，但该条件是多余的 (Redundant)，因为法律已经默示了该条款。
  • 因此，这封信函被视为有效的承诺 (Acceptance)，而不是反要约。
  • 合同在供应商收到信函时（或根据邮箱规则寄出时）即已成立。
  • 供应商随后的电话试图撤销要约，但为时已晚（合同已成立）。
  • 供应商将冰柜卖给他人，构成了违约 (Breach of Contract)。
为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (错误)：
虽然客户使用了条件句，但并没有实质性地“增加条款”。如果客户要求的是“保修期延长至10年”，那才构成反要约。要求一个法律已赋予的默示权利，不构成反要约。

选项 B (错误)：
善意购买人 (Bona Fide Purchaser) 的存在可能会阻止客户要求“特定履行” (Specific Performance，即强制拿回那台冰柜)，但这并不妨碍客户起诉供应商要求金钱赔偿 (Damages)。

选项 D (错误)：
确定要约 (Firm Offer) (UCC § 2-205) 必须是商人签署的、书面承诺在一段时间内保持要约有效的函件。本题中供应商只是发出了要约，并没有书面承诺“在这段时间内我不会撤销”。

考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，看到 "I accept on the condition that..." 时，警惕雷达要响：

  1. 通常这是反要约，导致合同未成立。
  2. 例外情况：如果该条件仅仅是重申了法律已经赋予的权利（如本题的 Implied Warranty），则它不构成反要约，而是有效的承诺。

questions.question:
A restorer of classic cars offered to completely repair and refurbish his neighbor's car for $35,000. The neighbor was anxious to return her classic car to its former glory but had not expected the restoration to cost $35,000. She said to the restorer, "The car is already in good condition. Will you consider taking $29,000 to restore it?" The restorer was incensed and said, "Absolutely not!" The neighbor then agreed to pay the restorer $35,000 to restore her car.
Is there a binding contract between the restorer and the neighbor for the restoration of the classic car?

choices.a: No, because the neighbor's statement was both a rejection of the restorer's offer and a counteroffer that the restorer did not accept.
choices.b: No, because the restorer is a merchant with respect to car restoration and his offer to restore the car was not firm.
choices.c: Yes, because the neighbor's statement was a valid acceptance that contained only minor additional terms.
choices.d: Yes, because the neighbor's statement was not a rejection of the restorer's offer but rather an inquiry into different terms.

data.questionStem:
Q81105

A restorer of classic cars offered to completely repair and refurbish his neighbor's car for $35,000. The neighbor was anxious to return her classic car to its former glory but had not expected the restoration to cost $35,000. She said to the restorer, "The car is already in good condition. Will you consider taking $29,000 to restore it?" The restorer was incensed and said, "Absolutely not!" The neighbor then agreed to pay the restorer $35,000 to restore her car.

Is there a binding contract between the restorer and the neighbor for the restoration of the classic car?

一位古董车修复师要约以35,000美元的价格，为其邻居的汽车进行全面维修和翻新。邻居渴望将她的古董车恢复昔日的光彩，但没想到修复费用会高达35,000美元。她对修复师说：“这辆车状况已经很好了。你是否考虑以29,000美元的价格进行修复？”修复师被激怒了，说：“绝对不行！”随后，邻居同意向修复师支付35,000美元来修复她的车。

修复师和邻居之间，就修复古董车一事，是否存在有约束力的合同？
options:
A. No, because the neighbor's statement was both a rejection of the restorer's offer and a counteroffer that the restorer did not accept.
否，因为邻居的陈述既是对修复师要约的拒绝，也是修复师未接受的一项反要约。

B. No, because the restorer is a merchant with respect to car restoration and his offer to restore the car was not firm.
否，因为就汽车修复而言，该修复师是一名商人，而他修复汽车的要约并非一项不可撤销的要约（firm offer）。

C. Yes, because the neighbor's statement was a valid acceptance that contained only minor additional terms.
是，因为邻居的陈述是一项有效的承诺，其中仅包含微小的附加条款。

D. Yes, because the neighbor's statement was not a rejection of the restorer's offer but rather an inquiry into different terms.
是，因为邻居的陈述并非对修复师要约的拒绝，而只是对不同条款的探寻。
data.explanation:
Contracts for services (eg, restoration) are governed by the common law, which follows the mirror-image rule for contract formation. Under this rule, an acceptance must match the terms of the offer exactly. A purported acceptance that contains different or additional terms acts as a rejection of the original offer and as a counteroffer. However, mere suggestions or inquiries that the offeror is free to accept or reject do not. The offeree can therefore accept the original offer in spite of such suggestions or inquiries.

Here, the restorer offered to repair and refurbish the neighbor's classic car for $35,000. Although the neighbor asked if the restorer would consider taking $29,000 instead, this was a mere inquiry that the restorer could accept or reject - not a rejection of the restorer's offer and a counteroffer (Choice A). Therefore, the neighbor's subsequent acceptance of the restorer's $35,000 offer was effective and created a binding contract between them for the restoration of the classic car.

(Choice B) Under the UCC, a merchant's offer to buy or sell goods is firm (ie, irrevocable) if it is written, is signed by the merchant-offeror, and provides assurances that it will remain open for a period of time. However, the UCC does not apply to contracts for services (as seen here).

(Choice C) Under the UCC battle-of-the-forms rule for contract formation, an acceptance that contains revised or new terms is valid unless it is expressly conditioned on the offeror's assent to those terms. But this contract is governed by the common law mirror-image rule, under which an acceptance that contains different or additional terms (not seen here) is invalid .

Educational objective: Under the mirror-image rule, a purported acceptance that contains different or additional terms acts as a rejection and as a counteroffer; however, mere suggestions or inquiries that the offeror is free to accept or reject do not.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code



选项正确率统计：A选项 35%，B选项 0%，C选项 1%，D选项 62%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

服务合同（例如，修复）受普通法管辖，普通法在合同成立方面遵循镜像规则 (mirror-image rule)。根据此规则，承诺 (acceptance) 必须与要约的条款完全一致。任何包含不同或附加条款的所谓承诺，均构成对原要约的拒绝 (rejection) 和一项反要约 (counteroffer)。然而，仅仅是建议或探寻 (suggestions or inquiries)，即要约人可以自由决定接受或拒绝的，则不构成上述情况。因此，受要约人可以在提出此类建议或探寻后，仍然接受原要约。

在本案中，修复师要约以35,000美元的价格修理和翻新邻居的古董车。尽管邻居询问修复师是否考虑接受29,000美元，但这仅仅是一项探寻，修复师可以接受或拒绝——并非对修复师要约的拒绝和反要约（选项 A）。因此，邻居随后对修复师35,000美元要约的承诺是有效的，并在他们之间就修复古董车一事订立了具有约束力的合同。

（选项 B）根据 UCC (美国统一商法典) 的规定，商人买卖货物的要约，如果采用书面形式，由作为要约人的商人签署，并保证其在一定时期内保持开放，则该要约是不可撤销的（即 firm offer）。然而，UCC 不适用于服务合同（如此处所示）。

（选项 C）根据 UCC 关于合同成立的“格式之战”(battle-of-the-forms)规则，包含修订或新条款的承诺是有效的，除非该承诺明确以要约人同意这些条款为条件。但本合同受普通法镜像规则 (mirror-image rule) 管辖，根据该规则，包含不同或附加条款的承诺（本案未见）是无效的。

教学目标：根据镜像规则 (mirror-image rule)，包含不同或附加条款的所谓承诺构成拒绝和反要约；然而，仅仅是要约人可以自由接受或拒绝的建议或探寻则不在此列。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (美国统一商法典)

References

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 80 (2020) (necessity that acceptance comply with offer, generally).

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 86 (2020) (collateral or immaterial matters; inquiries, requests, suggestions, or directions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Contracts: Formation (Counteroffer vs. Inquiry)
核心考点

本题考察的是普通法下反要约 (Counteroffer) 与仅仅是询问 (Mere Inquiry) 之间的关键区别。

法律规则 (Legal Rule) 由于本案涉及的是服务（汽车修复），因此适用普通法 (Common Law)，而非 UCC。

普通法遵循镜像规则 (Mirror-Image Rule)：承诺必须与要约完全一致。
  • 反要约 (Counteroffer): 构成对原要约的拒绝 (Rejection)，原要约失效。
  • 询问 (Inquiry): 仅仅是试探性的建议或问题，不构成拒绝，原要约依然有效。
案情深度解析

让我们拆解对话来判定法律效力：

修复师 (Offeror): "我出价 $35,000 修复你的车。"
→ 这是一个有效的 Offer。
邻居 (Offeree): "你是否考虑 (Will you consider) 接受 $29,000？"
→ 关键点！这使用了询问句式，而非确定性的陈述。这被视为 Mere Inquiry。
修复师: "绝对不行！"
→ 拒绝了询问，但原 $35,000 的要约并未被邻居拒绝，因此依然存续 (Still open)。
邻居: "好吧，我同意支付 $35,000。"
→ 这是对原要约的有效承诺 (Acceptance)。
正确答案 选项 D (Correct)

是，因为邻居的陈述并非对修复师要约的拒绝，而只是对不同条款的探寻。

由于邻居只是询问 "Will you consider..."，她并没有明确拒绝 $35,000 的价格，也没有说 "除非 $29,000 否则我不修"。因此，原要约仍然有效，她随后的承诺创造了有约束力的合同。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (错误): 认为这是反要约。如果邻居说 "I will only pay $29,000" (我只付2万9)，那就是反要约。但询问句通常不被视为反要约。
选项 B (错误): 提到了“商人”和“不可撤销要约”。虽然修复师可能是商人，但 UCC 仅适用于货物 (Goods) 买卖。汽车修复主要是服务 (Service)，适用普通法。
选项 C (错误): 提到了“微小的附加条款”。这是混淆了 UCC 2-207 (Battle of the Forms) 的概念。在普通法下，任何条款变更通常都是致命的（镜像规则），但本题的关键在于它根本不是变更，只是询问。
💡 MBE 抢分技巧 (Pro Tip)

在 Contracts 题目中，仔细观察受要约人 (Offeree) 的措辞：

  • 如果是 "I accept, but..." 或 "I will pay $X instead" → 这是一个 Counteroffer (原要约死亡)。
  • 如果是 "Would you take...?" 或 "Will you consider...?" → 这是一个 Inquiry (原要约存活)。

看到问号 (?) 时，倾向于判断为 Inquiry。

A seller sent an email to a potential buyer, offering to sell his house to her for $150,000. The buyer immediately responded via email, asking whether the offer included the house's front porch swing. The seller emailed back: "No, it doesn't." The buyer then ordered a front porch swing and emailed back to the seller: "I accept your offer." The seller refused to sell the house to the buyer, claiming that the offer was no longer open.
Is there a contract for the sale of the house?

choices.a: No, because the buyer's initial email was a counteroffer.
choices.b: No, because the offer lapsed before the buyer accepted.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer relied on the offer by ordering the swing.
choices.d: Yes, because the buyer's initial email merely asked for information.

Q81116

A seller sent an email to a potential buyer, offering to sell his house to her for $150,000. The buyer immediately responded via email, asking whether the offer included the house's front porch swing. The seller emailed back: "No, it doesn't." The buyer then ordered a front porch swing and emailed back to the seller: "I accept your offer." The seller refused to sell the house to the buyer, claiming that the offer was no longer open.

Is there a contract for the sale of the house?

一名卖方通过电子邮件向一名潜在买方发出要约，愿意以150,000美元的价格将其房屋出售给她。买方立即通过电子邮件回复，询问该要约是否包含房屋的前廊秋千。卖方回信道：“不，不包含。”随后，买方订购了一个前廊秋千，并回信给卖方：“我接受你的要约。”卖方拒绝将房屋出售给买方，声称该要约已不再有效。

关于该房屋的买卖合同是否成立？
options:
A. No, because the buyer's initial email was a counteroffer.
不成立，因为买方的第一封电子邮件构成了一项反要约 (counteroffer)。

B. No, because the offer lapsed before the buyer accepted.
不成立，因为该要约在买方接受之前已经失效 (lapsed)。

C. Yes, because the buyer relied on the offer by ordering the swing.
成立，因为买方因信赖该要约而订购了秋千。

D. Yes, because the buyer's initial email merely asked for information.
成立，因为买方的第一封电子邮件仅仅是询问信息。
data.explanation:
Termination of offer before acceptance


Offeror'srevocation
  • Offeror communicates revocation directly to offeree
  • Offeree learns information from reliable source that reasonably indicates offer was revoked (eg, house sold to another buyer)
Offeree's rejection
  • Offeree communicates rejection directly to offeror
  • Offeree's counteroffer serves as rejection & new offer
Lapse
  • Time period specified in offer expires
  • After reasonable time if no time period specified in offer
By law
  • Either party dies or is adjudicated insane
  • Subject matter of offer is destroyed or becomes illegal
A binding contract is formed when an offeree accepts an offer before it terminates. An offer will terminate if the offeree rejects the offer or responds with a counteroffer - ie, a reply that presents different terms from those in the offer - prior to acceptance. However, merely asking for information (eg, whether the offer includes a porch swing) is not a counteroffer and will not terminate an offer (Choice A).

An offer can also terminate by lapse if the offeree fails to respond within (1) the time period specified in the offer or (2) a reasonable time if no time period is specified. Here, no lapse occurred because the seller's email did not specify a time for acceptance and there is no evidence that the buyer's acceptance was emailed after an unreasonable delay (Choice B). Instead, a contract for the sale of the house was formed.

(Choice C) An offeree's reliance on an offer can create an option contract - ie, a separate agreement not to revoke the offer - if the offeree incurred substantial expense and his/her reliance was foreseeable. But an option contract was unnecessary here since the seller did not try to revoke his offer before acceptance. And even if it was foreseeable that the buyer would order a porch swing, its cost is not substantial compared to a $150,000 house.

Educational objective: An offer will terminate if the offeree makes a counteroffer - ie, a reply that presents different terms than the offer, not merely a request for information. An offer will also terminate by lapse if the offeree fails to respond within the time period specified in the offer or within a reasonable time (if no time period is specified).

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 7%，C选项 5%，D选项 80%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在承诺前要约的终止


要约人的撤销
  • 要约人直接向受要约人传达撤销
  • 受要约人从可靠来源获知信息，该信息合理地表明要约已被撤销（例如，房屋已出售给另一买方）
受要约人的拒绝
  • 受要约人直接向要约人传达拒绝
  • 受要约人的反要约 (counteroffer) 构成拒绝及一项新要约
失效 (Lapse)
  • 要约中规定的期限届满
  • 若要约中未规定期限，则在合理时间过后
依法终止
  • 任何一方当事人死亡或被宣告为精神失常
  • 要约标的物被毁坏或变为非法
当受要约人在要约终止前作出承诺时，一份有约束力的合同即告成立。如果受要约人在承诺前拒绝要约或以反要约 (counteroffer) ——即提出与原要约不同条款的答复——作出回应，则要约将终止。然而，仅仅询问信息（例如，要约是否包含一个门廊秋千）并非反要约，并且不会终止要约（选项A）。

如果受要约人未能在（1）要约规定的期限内或（2）在未规定期限的情况下于合理时间内作出回应，要约也可能因失效 (lapse) 而终止。在此案中，失效并未发生，因为卖方的电子邮件没有指定承诺的时间，也没有证据表明买方的承诺邮件是在不合理的延迟后发出的（选项B）。因此，一份房屋买卖合同已经成立。

（选项C） 如果受要约人付出了重大开销且其信赖是可预见的，那么受要约人对要约的信赖可以构成一份选择权合同 (option contract)——即一份不得撤销要约的独立协议。但在本案中，选择权合同并非必要，因为卖方在承诺前并未试图撤销其要约。而且，即使买方订购门廊秋千是可预见的，与其15万美元的房屋相比，其成本也并非重大。

教学目标： 如果受要约人提出反要约 (counteroffer)——即提出与原要约不同条款的答复，而不仅仅是询问信息——则要约将终止。如果受要约人未在要约规定的期限内或在合理时间内（若未规定期限）作出回应，要约也将因失效 (lapse) 而终止。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 39 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (requirements for counteroffers).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Formation & Termination

正确答案：D

本题的核心考点在于区分反要约 (Counteroffer) 与仅仅询问信息 (Mere Inquiry)。

⚖️ 法律规则 (Legal Rule)

根据普通法 (Common Law)，反要约构成对原要约的拒绝 (Rejection) 并终止原要约。然而，仅仅对要约条款进行询问 (Inquiry regarding terms) 并不构成反要约，也不会终止原要约。

详细解析

1. 要约的现状 (Status of the Offer):
卖方发出以 $150,000 出售房屋的要约。这是一个有效的要约。

2. 买方的回应 (Buyer's Response):
买方回复问道：“是否包含前廊秋千？”
在法律上，这是一个询问 (Inquiry)，而不是反要约。

  • 如果是反要约，买方会说：“如果是包含秋千的，我就买。” (I accept if...)
  • 因为这只是询问，原要约（$150,000 买房）仍然有效且开放 (Open)。

3. 卖方的澄清与买方的承诺:
卖方回答“不包含”后，原要约依然存在。随后买方明确表示“我接受你的要约”。这构成了有效的承诺 (Acceptance)。

因此，合同在买方发送“我接受”的邮件时成立。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A 错误 (Counteroffer):
这是本题最大的干扰项。反要约必须是对原条款的实质性变更或附加条件。仅仅询问“是否包含X”并不等于说“除非包含X，否则我不买”。因此，原要约未被终止。
选项 B 错误 (Lapse):
要约确实会因时间流逝而失效 (Lapse)。但题目中使用了 "immediately"（立即）和电子邮件交流，表明时间非常短，远未达到“合理时间”过期的程度。
选项 C 错误 (Reliance):
虽然信赖利益 (Reliance) 有时可以防止要约被撤销（构成 Option Contract），但本题中合同成立的直接原因是有效的承诺，而不是信赖。且买个秋千通常不算“重大”信赖。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理要约/承诺题目时，仔细观察标点符号和语气：

❓ 问号 (Question Mark): 通常代表 "Inquiry"（询问），要约不终止。
Example: "Does the price include shipping?"

🛑 句号/条件句 (Period/Conditional): 通常代表 "Counteroffer"（反要约），要约终止。
Example: "I will take it for $150k including shipping."

questions.question:
A plumber went to a home to inspect a broken water heater. After the plumber had finished the inspection, he told the homeowner, "I have my tools and the replacement part with me. I can repair your water heater now for $600." The homeowner then asked, "Would you consider taking less?" The plumber replied, "No, $600 is the lowest price I can offer." The homeowner was undecided, so the plumber left.
The next day, the homeowner called the plumber and said, "I accept your offer at $600." The plumber replied, "I used the part on another job yesterday afternoon. And I just found out today that my parts supplier increased its prices, so I cannot do the job for less than $700." The homeowner refused to pay $700 and demanded that the plumber repair the water heater for $600.
Is there an enforceable contract between the homeowner and the plumber?

choices.a: No, because the homeowner failed to accept the plumber's offer to repair the water heater for $600 before their conversation ended.
choices.b: No, because the homeowner rejected the plumber's offer by asking if he would take less than $600.
choices.c: Yes, because the homeowner accepted the plumber's offer to repair the water heater for $600 before it lapsed.
choices.d: Yes, because the plumber was a merchant with respect to water heaters, so his quote for $600 was a firm offer.

questions.question:
A shop owner faxed the following signed message to his long-time widget supplier: "Urgently need blue widgets. Ship immediately three gross at your current list price of $600." Upon receipt of the fax, the supplier shipped three gross of red widgets to the shop owner and faxed to him the following message: "Temporarily out of blue. In case red will help, am shipping three gross at the same price. Hope you can use them."
Upon the shop owner's timely receipt of both the shipment and the supplier's fax, which of the following best describes the rights and duties of the shop owner and the supplier?

choices.a: The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, less any damages sustained because of the nonconforming shipment, or he may reject the shipment and recover from the supplier for total breach of contract, subject to the supplier's right to cure.
choices.b: The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, less any damages sustained because of the nonconforming shipment, or he may reject the shipment provided that he promptly covers by obtaining conforming widgets from another supplier.
choices.c: The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, or he may reject the shipment, in which case he has no further rights against the supplier.
choices.d: The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, or he must reject the shipment and recover from the supplier for total breach of contract.

In case red will help, am shipping three gross at the same price. Hope you can use them."

Upon the shop owner's timely receipt of both the shipment and the supplier's fax, which of the following best describes the rights and duties of the shop owner and the supplier?

一位店主向其长期合作的小部件供应商传真了以下经签署的消息：“急需蓝色小部件。请立即以您现行的目录价格600美元发运三罗。”供应商收到传真后，向店主发运了三罗红色小部件，并向他传真了以下消息：“蓝色暂时缺货。为解您燃眉之急，现发运三罗红色小部件，价格相同。希望您能用得上。”

在店主及时收到货物和供应商的传真后，以下哪项最能描述店主和供应商的权利与义务？
options:
A. The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, less any damages sustained because of the nonconforming shipment, or he may reject the shipment and recover from the supplier for total breach of contract, subject to the supplier's right to cure.
店主可以接受该批货物，在此情况下，他必须向供应商支付目录价格，并减去因货物不符所遭受的任何损害赔偿；或者，他可以拒绝该批货物，并就供应商的完全违约行为要求赔偿，但这受制于供应商的补救权。

B. The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, less any damages sustained because of the nonconforming shipment, or he may reject the shipment provided that he promptly covers by obtaining conforming widgets from another supplier.
店主可以接受该批货物，在此情况下，他必须向供应商支付目录价格，并减去因货物不符所遭受的任何损害赔偿；或者，他可以拒绝该批货物，前提是他必须通过从另一供应商处获得相符小部件来及时进行替代采购。

C. The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, or he may reject the shipment, in which case he has no further rights against the supplier.
店主可以接受该批货物，在此情况下，他必须向供应商支付目录价格；或者，他可以拒绝该批货物，在此情况下，他对供应商不再享有任何进一步的权利。

D. The shop owner may accept the shipment, in which case he must pay the supplier the list price, or he must reject the shipment and recover from the supplier for total breach of contract.
店主可以接受该批货物，在此情况下，他必须向供应商支付目录价格；或者，他必须拒绝该批货物，并就供应商的完全违约行为要求赔偿。
data.explanation:
Seller's reply to buyer's offer

(UCC § 2-206)
ReplyEffect
Promise to shipAcceptance
Shipment of conforming goodsAcceptance & performance
Shipment of nonconforming goods
  • With notice of accommodation: Rejection & counteroffer
  • With no notice: Acceptance & breach
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs contracts for the sale of goods. The UCC allows a seller to accept an offer to buy goods for prompt or immediate shipment by promising to ship or actually shipping goods that conform to the offer. But a shipment of nonconforming goods serves as both a rejection and a counteroffer if the seller:
  • made no prior promise to ship conforming goods and
  • notifies the buyer that the nonconforming shipment is merely an accommodation - ie, an offer of similar goods for the buyer to consider.
In that case, the buyer may accept the shipment (creating a contract for the nonconforming goods) OR reject the shipment (creating no contract).

Here, the shop owner offered to buy blue widgets for immediate shipment, but the supplier rejected that offer by shipping red widgets with a notice of accommodation ("[i]n case red will help"). Since the shop owner's offer was rejected - ie, no contract for blue widgets was formed - she did not sustain any damages (Choices A & B). However, the shop owner can still accept the shipment, thereby creating a contract for red widgets at the list price.

Alternatively, the shop owner may reject the shipment. There would then be no contract for blue or red widgets, and the shop owner would have no further rights against the supplier. This also means that:
  • the shop owner could not recover for breach of contract (Choice D)
  • the supplier would have no right to cure (ie, fix a breach by shipping conforming goods) (Choice A) and
  • the shop owner would not be required to cover (ie, purchase substitute goods to mitigate the damages after a breach) (Choice B).
Educational objective: Under the UCC, a seller can accept an offer to buy goods for prompt or immediate shipment by promising to ship or actually shipping conforming goods. However, shipping nonconforming goods serves as both a rejection and counteroffer if the seller notifies the buyer that the shipment was merely an accommodation.

选项正确率统计：A选项 40%，B选项 4%，C选项 49%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方对买方要约的答复

(UCC § 2-206)
答复法律效果
发货承诺承诺
发运相符货物承诺与履行
发运不符货物
  • 附有通融通知：拒绝与反要约
  • 未附通知：承诺与违约
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (美国统一商法典)

Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) 第二条管辖货物买卖合同。UCC允许卖方通过承诺发货或实际发运与要约相符的货物，来承诺一项要求即时或立即发运的货物购买要约。但是，如果卖方出现以下情况，其发运不符货物的行为既构成拒绝，也构成反要约：
  • 事先未承诺发运相符货物，并且
  • 通知买方，此次不符货物的发运仅为一种通融——即提供类似货物供买方考虑的要约。
在这种情况下，买方可以接受该批货物（从而就该不符货物成立一份合同），或者拒绝该批货物（从而不成立任何合同）。

在本案中，店主发出要约，欲购买立即发运的蓝色小部件，但供应商通过发运红色小部件并附上通融通知（“或许红色能帮上忙”）的方式，拒绝了该要约。由于店主的要约已被拒绝——即关于蓝色小部件的合同并未成立——她没有遭受任何损害赔偿 (选项 A 和 B)。然而，店主仍然可以接受这批货物，从而以目录价格就红色小部件成立一份合同。

或者，店主可以拒绝这批货物。这样一来，无论是关于蓝色还是红色小部件的合同都不会成立，并且店主对供应商不再享有任何进一步的权利。这也意味着：
  • 店主不能因违约而要求赔偿 (选项 D)
  • 供应商将没有补救权（即通过发运相符货物来纠正违约行为） (选项 A) 并且
  • 店主将无须进行替代采购（即在违约后购买替代货物以减轻损失）(选项 B)。
教学目标：根据UCC，卖方可以通过承诺发货或实际发运相符货物的方式，来承诺一项要求即时或立即发运的货物购买要约。然而，如果卖方通知买方其发货仅为一种通融，那么发运不符货物行为既构成拒绝，也构成反要约。

References

U.C.C. § 2-206 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that a shipment of nonconforming goods is not an acceptance if the seller notifies the buyer that the shipment was merely an accommodation).

MBE 考题解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2
核心考点：UCC § 2-206

根据《美国统一商法典》(UCC)，针对“立即发货”的要约，卖方发运不符货物 (Non-conforming goods) 的法律后果取决于是否附带通知：

  • 无通知：视为承诺 (Acceptance) 加上 违约 (Breach)。
  • 有“通融”通知 (Accommodation Notice)：视为反要约 (Counteroffer)，而不是承诺。
1
店主 (Buyer): 发出要约 (Offer)，急需蓝色部件。
2
供应商 (Seller): 发运红色部件 + 传真说明是“通融” (Accommodation)。
3
法律定性: 这是一个反要约 (Counteroffer)。
为什么选项 C 是正确的？

本题的关键在于供应商的传真内容：“Temporarily out of blue... In case red will help...”。

根据 UCC § 2-206(1)(b)，如果卖方在发货时（或发货前后合理时间内）通知买方该发货仅作为一种通融 (Accommodation)，那么这批不符货物的发运不构成承诺 (Acceptance)。

既然没有承诺，就没有成立关于蓝色部件的合同。因此：

  1. 没有合同，就没有违约 (No Contract = No Breach)。 供应商没有义务必须提供蓝色部件。
  2. 现在的局面是：供应商向店主发出了一个新的要约（反要约），内容是“以原价购买红色部件”。
  3. 店主作为受要约人 (Offeree)，拥有完全的决定权：
    • 接受 (Accept)： 留下红色部件，按目录价付款。
    • 拒绝 (Reject)： 退回红色部件。因为之前没有成立合同，店主不能起诉供应商违约。
其他选项错在哪里？
选项 A & D 这两个选项都提到了“recover for total breach”（因完全违约要求赔偿）。
错误原因： 只有在合同成立后才存在违约。因为“通融通知”的存在，原合同（买蓝色）从未成立，所以不存在违约赔偿请求权。
选项 B 提到了“cover”（替代采购）作为拒绝的前提。
错误原因： 既然没有违约，店主就没有义务去进行替代采购来减轻损失（mitigate damages），也没有权利要求供应商承担差价。他可以单纯地拒绝反要约。
🎓 MBE 抢分技巧 看到“发运了错误的货物” (Shipped non-conforming goods) 时，立即寻找“通融” (Accommodation) 这个词或类似表述！
  • 👀 没看到 Accommodation： 卖方违约 (Breach)。买方可接受并索赔，或拒绝并索赔。
  • 👀 看到了 Accommodation： 卖方发出反要约 (Counteroffer)。卖方没有违约。买方只能选“买”或“不买”，不能索赔。

questions.question:
A man, aged 60, who had no plans for early retirement, had worked for a manufacturing company for 20 years as a managerial employee-at-will when he had a conversation with the company's president about the man's post-retirement goal of extensive travel around the United States. A month later, the company president handed the man a written, signed resolution of the company's board of directors stating that when and if the man should decide to retire, at his option, the company, in recognition of his past service, would pay him a $2,000-per-month lifetime pension. (The company had no regularized retirement plan for at-will employees.) Shortly thereafter, the man retired and immediately bought a $30,000 recreational vehicle for his planned travels. After receiving the promised $2,000 monthly pension from the company for six months, the man, now unemployable elsewhere, received a letter from the company advising him that the pension would cease immediately because of recessionary budget constraints affecting in varying degrees all managerial salaries and retirement pensions.
In a suit against the company for damages, will the man win or lose?

choices.a: Lose, because he had been an employee-at-will throughout his active service with the company.
choices.b: Lose, because the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension was an unenforceable gift promise.
choices.c: Win, because he retired from the company as bargained-for consideration for the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension.
choices.d: Win, because he timed his decision to retire and to buy the recreational vehicle in reasonable reliance on the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension.

一名60岁的男子，并无提前退休的计划，在一家制造公司担任随意雇佣的管理层雇员已长达20年。期间，他与公司总裁谈及自己退休后周游美国的宏大目标。一个月后，公司总裁向该男子递交了一份由公司董事会签署的书面决议，声明在该男子决定退休时，他可自行选择，公司为表彰其过往贡献，将向他支付每月2000美元的终身养老金。（该公司对随意雇佣的雇员并无常规的退休计划。）此后不久，该男子便退休，并立即购买了一辆价值3万美元的房车，用于其计划中的旅行。在领取了公司承诺的每月2000美元养老金六个月后，如今已无法在别处就业的该男子，收到公司来信，通知他由于经济衰退导致预算紧缩，在不同程度上影响了所有管理层的薪资和退休金，因此其养老金将立即停止发放。

在该男子对公司提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，他将会胜诉还是败诉？
options:
A. Lose, because he had been an employee-at-will throughout his active service with the company.
败诉，因为他在为公司有效服务期间一直是随意雇佣的雇员。

B. Lose, because the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension was an unenforceable gift promise.
败诉，因为董事会向他作出的终身养老金承诺是一项不可强制执行的赠与承诺。

C. Win, because he retired from the company as bargained-for consideration for the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension.
胜诉，因为他从公司退休，是为换取董事会向其作出的终身养老金承诺而经过协商达成的对价。

D. Win, because he timed his decision to retire and to buy the recreational vehicle in reasonable reliance on the board's promise to him of a lifetime pension.
胜诉，因为他基于对董事会终身养老金承诺的合理信赖，而决定了退休并购买房车的时间。
data.explanation:
Promissory estoppel Allows enforcement of promise when no valid contract exists if:
  • promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on promise
  • enforcing party reasonably relied on promise
  • reliance caused enforcing party to suffer substantial detriment and injustice can be avoided only by enforcing promise
Even when there is no valid contract (as seen here), a party may recover damages under an equitable theory of relief. For example, the doctrine of promissory estoppel allows a party to recover damages stemming from another's promise if:
  • the promisor reasonably expected to induce reliance on the promise
  • the enforcing party reasonably relied on the promise
  • reliance on the promise caused the enforcing party to suffer substantial detriment and injustice can only be avoided by enforcing the promise.
Damages for promissory estoppel may be limited as justice requires. Often, this means reliance damages - ie, damages based on out-of- pocket expenses - are awarded. However, in some instances, courts have awarded expectation damages to put the enforcing party in the same position as if the promise had been performed.

Here, there was no contract between the man and the company. But the man can recover under the equitable theory of promissory estoppel. That is because - in addition to the other requirements - the man reasonably relied upon the promised pension and suffered substantial detriment (unemployment). Therefore, the man is either entitled to reliance damages of $30,000 (for the recreational vehicle) or possibly expectation damages of $2,000 per month in lifetime pension.

(Choice A) Employment is at will if (1) there is no employment contract or (2) the employment contract does not specify a term of employment. But the man's status as an at-will employee does not affect his recovery here.

(Choice B) A gift is a gratuitous transfer of property or services without a return promise. A promise of a gift is unenforceable under contract law (no consideration). But a party may still recover under an equitable theory of relief (eg, promissory estoppel).

(Choice C) The lifetime pension was not promised in exchange for the man's retirement but in recognition of his past service to the company. Therefore, an argument that the man's retirement was consideration for the pension is misplaced.

Educational objective: Even when there is no valid contract, a party may recover damages under an equitable theory of relief such as promissory estoppel.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 11%，C选项 7%，D选项 81%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Promissory estoppel（允诺禁反言原则）允许在不存在有效合同的情况下强制执行承诺，条件是：
  • 允诺人合理预期其允诺会引致信赖
  • 寻求强制执行的一方合理地信赖了该允诺
  • 该信赖导致寻求强制执行的一方遭受重大损害，并且只有通过强制执行该允诺才能避免不公
即使不存在有效合同（如此案所示），一方当事人仍可依据衡平法上的救济理论获得损害赔偿。例如，promissory estoppel原则允许一方当事人在以下情况下，就因他人允诺而产生的损害获得赔偿：
  • 允诺人合理预期其允诺会引致信赖
  • 寻求强制执行的一方合理地信赖了该允诺
  • 对允诺的信赖导致寻求强制执行的一方遭受重大损害，并且只有通过强制执行该允诺才能避免不公。
基于promissory estoppel的损害赔偿可根据司法公正的需要予以限制。这通常意味着判给信赖损害赔偿——即基于实际支出的损害赔偿。然而，在某些情况下，法院也曾判给预期损害赔偿，以使寻求强制执行的一方处于如同允诺已被履行一样的地位。

在本案中，该男子与公司之间没有合同。但该男子可以根据衡平法上的promissory estoppel理论获得赔偿。这是因为——除了满足其他要件外——该男子合理地信赖了所承诺的养老金，并遭受了重大损害（失业）。因此，该男子有权获得30,000美元的信赖损害赔偿（用于购买房车），或可能获得每月2000美元终身养老金的预期损害赔偿。

(选项 A) 如果(1)没有雇佣合同或(2)雇佣合同未指明雇佣期限，则为随意雇佣。但该男子作为随意雇佣雇员的身份并不影响他在本案中获得赔偿。

(选项 B) 赠与是指没有回报承诺的财产或服务的无偿转让。根据合同法，赠与的承诺是不可强制执行的（无对价）。但一方当事人仍可依据衡平法上的救济理论（例如，promissory estoppel）获得赔偿。

(选项 C) 终身养老金的承诺并非为了换取该男子的退休，而是为了表彰他过去为公司所做的服务。因此，主张该男子的退休是养老金的对价，这一论点是错误的。

教学目标：即使在没有有效合同的情况下，一方当事人也可以依据诸如promissory estoppel等衡平法上的救济理论获得损害赔偿。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promissory estoppel).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Promissory Estoppel
正确答案：D

本题的核心考点在于当不存在有效合同时，如何通过衡平法手段强制执行承诺。即 Promissory Estoppel（允诺禁反言）。

核心法律原则：Promissory Estoppel 当满足以下条件时，即使没有对价（Consideration），承诺也是可执行的：
  1. 允诺人应当合理预期其承诺会诱导受诺人的行为或克制；
  2. 受诺人实际上合理地信赖了该承诺；
  3. 该信赖导致了受诺人的重大损害 (Detriment)；
  4. 只有强制执行该承诺才能避免不公。
Ref: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90

本案逻辑推演

  • 承诺存在：公司董事会出具了书面决议，承诺支付终身养老金。
  • 合理预期：公司总裁知道该男子有退休后周游美国的计划，因此应当预见到该承诺会促使他决定退休。
  • 实际信赖与损害：该男子基于对养老金的信赖，辞去了工作（变成了 unemployable）并花费 $30,000 购买了房车。这是典型的损害性信赖 (Detrimental Reliance)。
  • 结论：为了避免该男子陷入困境（无工作、无收入、积蓄已花），法院将适用 Promissory Estoppel 强制公司履行承诺。
为什么不是 C (Contract/Consideration)？

这是本题最大的陷阱。选项 C 认为是“合同对价”。

错误原因：公司承诺养老金是为了“表彰其过往服务 (recognition of his past service)”。在合同法中，过去的对价不是对价 (Past consideration is no consideration)。

此外，该男子并没有承诺退休来交换养老金（决议中写的是 "at his option"）。没有讨价还价的交换 (Bargained-for exchange)，就没有有效的合同，只能寻求 Promissory Estoppel 救济。

为什么不是 B (Gift)？

选项 B 指出这是“赠与承诺”且不可执行。前半句是对的（根据传统合同法，这是无偿赠与），但它忽略了例外情况。当赠与承诺引发了受诺人的合理信赖并导致损害时，Promissory Estoppel 会介入使其变得可执行。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
看到“老员工”、“退休金承诺”、“表彰过去贡献” (Past Service) 的组合时，脑海中要立刻警惕：
1. 这通常不是有效合同（缺乏对价）。
2. 接着寻找信赖 (Reliance) 的事实（如辞职、不再寻找新工作、大额消费）。
3. 如果有信赖，答案通常选 Promissory Estoppel 或 Reliance 相关选项。

注：本题改编自著名判例 Feinberg v. Pfeiffer Co.

questions.question:
A tile floor installer sent a general contractor this fax:
"Will install all marble tile flooring in new office building, per owner's specs, for $50,000 if you accept within reasonable time after main contract awarded."
Three competitors sent the general contractor similar bids to install marble tile floor in the office building in the respective amounts of $55,000, $58,000, and $60,000. The general contractor used the tile floor installer's $50,000 figure in preparing and submitting her own sealed bid on the office building. Before the bids were opened, the tile floor installer truthfully advised the general contractor that the former's sub-bid had been based on a $5,000 computational error and was therefore revoked. Shortly thereafter, the general contractor was awarded the office building construction contract and subsequently contracted with a competitor to install the marble floors for a price of $55,000.
The general contractor then sued the tile floor installer to recover $5,000.
Which of the following, if proved, would best support the tile floor installer's defense?

choices.a: Before submitting her own bid, the general contractor had reason to suspect that the tile floor installer had made a computational mistake in figuring its sub-bid.
choices.b: Even after paying $55,000 for the marble floor installation, the general contractor would make a net profit of $150,000 on the office building contract.
choices.c: The general contractor gave the tile floor installer no consideration for an irrevocable sub-bid.
choices.d: The tile floor installer's sub-bid expressly requested the general contractor's acceptance after awarding of the main contract.
