Q81103

A wallpaper hanger sent a general contractor this fax:

"Will do all paperhanging on the doctor's new building, per owner's specs, for $14,000 if you accept within reasonable time after main contract awarded."

Three competitors sent the general contractor similar bids to hang wallpaper in the doctor's building in the respective amounts of $18,000, $19,000, and $20,000. The general contractor used the wallpaper hanger's $14,000 figure in preparing and submitting her own sealed bid on the doctor's building. Before the bids were opened, the wallpaper hanger truthfully advised the general contractor that the former's sub-bid had been based on a $4,000 computational error and was therefore revoked. Shortly thereafter, the general contractor was awarded the doctor's building construction contract and subsequently contracted with a competitor to wallpaper the building for a price of $18,000.

The general contractor then sued the wallpaper hanger to recover $4,000.

Which of the following, if proved, would most strengthen the general contractor's prospect of recovery?

一位墙纸工向一位总承包商发送了如下传真：

“若主合同授予后，您在合理时间内接受，我将按业主的规格，以14,000美元的价格，承接医生新大楼的所有墙纸铺贴工作。”

三位竞争者向该总承包商发送了类似的墙纸铺贴报价，金额分别为18,000美元、19,000美元和20,000美元。总承包商在准备并提交其对医生大楼的密封投标时，使用了墙纸工14,000美元的报价。在开标前，墙纸工如实告知总承包商，其分包报价是基于一个4,000美元的计算错误，因此予以撤销。此后不久，总承包商获得了医生大楼的建筑合同，并随后与另一家竞争者签约，以18,000美元的价格为该大楼铺贴墙纸。

总承包商随后起诉该墙纸工，要求赔偿4,000美元。

以下哪一项如果得到证实，将最能支持总承包商的求偿前景？
options:
A. After the wallpaper hanger's notice of revocation, the general contractor made a reasonable effort to subcontract with another paperhanger at the lowest possible price.
在墙纸工发出撤销通知后，总承包商做出了合理的努力，以尽可能低的价格与其他墙纸工签订分包合同。

B. The general contractor dealt with all of her subcontractors in good faith and without seeking to renegotiate (lower) the prices they had bid.
总承包商本着诚信原则与所有分包商打交道，并且没有试图重新谈判（降低）他们已经报出的价格。

C. The general contractor had been required by the owner to submit a bid bond in the amount of $50,000 and could not have withdrawn or amended her bid on the main contract without forfeiting that bond.
业主曾要求总承包商提交一份金额为50,000美元的投标保证金，并且如果总承包商撤回或修改其主合同投标，就会丧失该保证金。

D. The wallpaper hanger was negligent in erroneously calculating the amount of his sub-bid.
墙纸工在错误计算其分包报价金额时存在疏忽。
data.explanation:
Irrevocable offers


TypeDescriptionConsiderationDuration
UCCFirm offerMerchant gives written & signed assurance that offer will remain openNot requiredSpecified or reasonable time
Common lawOption contractOfferor promises to keep offer open in exchange for considerationRequired
Common lawPartial performance (unilateral contracts)Offeror invites acceptance only by performance & offeree begins to performReasonable time for full performance
Promissory estoppel†Offeror could reasonably foresee reliance on offer & offeree reasonably relies to his/her detrimentNot requiredReasonable time
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

†Also referred to as "detrimental reliance."Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel (ie, detrimental reliance), an offer is binding as an option contract and is therefore irrevocable for a reasonable period of time if:
  • the offeror reasonably expected to induce reliance on the offer before acceptance
  • the offeree reasonably relied on the offer and
  • reliance caused the offeree to suffer substantial detriment.
When such an offer is revoked before a reasonable period of time has passed, the offeree's remedies range from enforcement of the offer to reimbursement of expenses incurred in reliance on the offer.

Here, the wallpaper hanger knew that the general contractor would factor the wallpaper hanger's sub-bid into her bid for the main contract (reasonable expectation of reliance). The general contractor then used the wallpaper hanger's sub-bid in preparing and submitting her bid (reasonable reliance). Therefore, proof that the general contractor could not have amended or withdrawn her bid without forfeiting a bid bond (substantial detriment) would most strengthen her prospect for recovery.

(Choice A) The general contractor's reasonable efforts to subcontract with another paperhanger at the lowest price (ie, her efforts to mitigate damages) go to the amount of her recovery, not to whether she can recover.

(Choice B) The general contractor's good-faith dealing with all subcontractors is irrelevant to whether she can recover damages stemming from the revocation of the wallpaper hanger's offer.

(Choice D) The wallpaper hanger's negligence in erroneously calculating the amount of his sub-bid has no bearing on the general contractor's chances of recovery.

Educational objective: An offer is binding as an option contract and therefore irrevocable if (1) the offeror reasonably expected to induce reliance on the offer before acceptance, (2) the offeree reasonably relied on the offer, and (3) reliance caused the offeree to suffer substantial detriment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 43%，B选项 5%，C选项 36%（正确选项），D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不可撤销的要约


类型描述对价存续期间
UCC确定要约商人以书面形式并签署保证，该要约将保持有效不需要指定的或合理的时间
普通法选择权合同要约人承诺保持要约有效，以换取对价需要
普通法部分履行 (单方合同)要约人仅邀请以履行方式作出承诺，且受要约人已开始履行完成全部履行的合理时间
禁止反言允诺†要约人可合理预见到受要约人会对要约产生信赖，且受要约人合理地信赖了该要约并因此遭受损害不需要合理时间
UCC = 《美国统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)。

†亦称“信赖损害”。

根据禁止反言允诺（即信赖损害）原则，如果满足以下条件，一个要约就作为选择权合同而具有约束力，因此在合理期限内是不可撤销的：
  • 要约人在承诺前合理预期到其要约会引致信赖
  • 受要约人合理地信赖了该要约，并且
  • 该信赖导致受要约人遭受了重大损害。
当此等要约在合理期限届满之前被撤销时，受要约人的救济措施包括强制执行该要约或补偿因信赖该要约而产生的费用。

在本案中，墙纸工知道总承包商会将其分包报价计入其主合同的投标中（合理的信赖预期）。总承包商随后在准备和提交其投标时使用了墙纸工的分包报价（合理的信赖）。因此，证明总承包商若不丧失投标保证金就无法修改或撤回其投标（重大损害），将最能支持其求偿前景。

(选项A) 总承包商为以最低价格与其他墙纸工签订分包合同而做出的合理努力（即她为减轻损害所做的努力），关系到她可获得的赔偿数额，而非她是否可以获得赔偿。

(选项B) 总承包商与所有分包商的诚信交易，与她是否能就墙纸工撤销要约而获得损害赔偿无关。

(选项D) 墙纸工在错误计算其分包报价金额时的疏忽，对总承包商的求偿机会没有影响。

教学目标： 如果满足以下条件，一个要约就作为选择权合同而具有约束力，因此是不可撤销的：（1）要约人在承诺前合理预期到其要约会引致信赖，（2）受要约人合理地信赖了该要约，以及（3）该信赖导致受要约人遭受了重大损害。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 87 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (option contract by detrimental reliance).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Promissory Estoppel

核心法律原则：禁止反言 / 信赖利益 Promissory Estoppel / Detrimental Reliance

在建筑合同法中，当分包商（Subcontractor）提交报价，且预见到总承包商（General Contractor）会依赖该报价进行投标时，如果总承包商确实产生了合理的信赖并因此受损，分包商的报价在合理时间内不可撤销。

经典判例：Drennan v. Star Paving Co. (1958)
法律依据：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 87(2)

为什么选 C？
正确答案 C

理由：确立了“重大损害” (Substantial Detriment)

要适用“禁止反言”使要约不可撤销，必须满足三个要素：

  1. 要约人可预见受要约人会产生信赖；
  2. 受要约人确实产生了合理信赖；
  3. 信赖导致了损害，且只有执行要约才能避免不公。

选项 C 指出总承包商提交了 $50,000 的投标保证金 (Bid Bond)。这意味着，如果她在得知分包商撤回报价后试图撤回自己的主投标，她将损失这笔巨款。

这证明了她被“锁定”在主合同中，无法无损退出，从而坐实了信赖损害 (Detrimental Reliance)，这是让分包商对其错误报价负责的最强有力证据。

其他选项为何不佳？
选项 A

减损义务 (Mitigation of Damages)

寻找替代分包商是计算赔偿金额时的问题，而不是判断分包商是否承担责任的依据。这发生在违约之后，不能用来证明合同（或不可撤销要约）的成立。

选项 B

诚信原则 (Good Faith)

虽然诚信很重要，但它不是使要约不可撤销的核心要素。即使总承包商没有试图压价，如果她没有遭受“信赖损害”（例如可以随意撤回主投标而不受罚），她可能仍无法根据禁止反言原则胜诉。

选项 D

分包商的过失 (Negligence)

分包商计算错误是其撤销报价的原因，但这通常是分包商用来抗辩（试图撤销合同）的理由（即单方错误 Unilateral Mistake）。证明分包商有过失并不能直接加强总承包商的追偿权，反而有时可能被用来主张总承包商“应当知道”报价有误。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Subcontractor bids"（分包商报价） + "General Contractor uses bid"（总包商使用报价） 的模式时：

  • 这几乎总是考 Promissory Estoppel (禁止反言)。
  • 默认规则是：分包商的报价是不可撤销的选择权合同 (Option Contract)。
  • 关键在于寻找证明总承包商无法脱身（如 Bid Bond）的事实，这锁定了损害赔偿的请求权。

questions.question:
An amateur computer whiz agreed in writing to build and deliver 50 new gaming laptops a year to a computer distributor over a five-year period. The writing provided, in a clause separately signed by the computer whiz, that "[n]o modification shall be binding on the distributor unless made in writing and signed by the distributor's authorized representative."
Because of family problems, the computer whiz delivered and the distributor accepted only 30 gaming laptops a year for the first three years; but the laptops were popular with gamers and the distributor made no objection. Accordingly, the computer whiz spent substantial sums on new laptop parts that would aid in speeding up future builds. In the first quarter of the fourth year, however, the distributor terminated the contract on the ground that the computer whiz had breached the annual-quantity term.
In the computer whiz's suit against the distributor for damages, the jury found that the contract had been modified by conduct, and the trial court awarded the computer whiz substantial compensatory damages.
Is this result likely to be reversed on appeal?

choices.a: No, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was unconscionable as against an amateur computer builder.
choices.b: No, because the distributor by its conduct waived the annual-quantity term and the computer whiz materially changed his position in reasonable reliance on that waiver.
choices.c: Yes, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was a material part of the agreed exchange and could not be avoided without new consideration.
choices.d: Yes, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was not expressly waived by the distributor.

Q81072

An amateur computer whiz agreed in writing to build and deliver 50 new gaming laptops a year to a computer distributor over a five-year period. The writing provided, in a clause separately signed by the computer whiz, that "[n]o modification shall be binding on the distributor unless made in writing and signed by the distributor's authorized representative."

Because of family problems, the computer whiz delivered and the distributor accepted only 30 gaming laptops a year for the first three years; but the laptops were popular with gamers and the distributor made no objection. Accordingly, the computer whiz spent substantial sums on new laptop parts that would aid in speeding up future builds. In the first quarter of the fourth year, however, the distributor terminated the contract on the ground that the computer whiz had breached the annual-quantity term.

In the computer whiz's suit against the distributor for damages, the jury found that the contract had been modified by conduct, and the trial court awarded the computer whiz substantial compensatory damages.

Is this result likely to be reversed on appeal?

一位业余电脑高手书面同意，在五年内每年为一家电脑经销商制造并交付50台新的游戏笔记本电脑。该书面协议中有一项由该电脑高手单独签署的条款规定：“任何修改，除非以书面形式作出并由经销商的授权代表签署，否则对经销商不具约束力。”

由于家庭问题，该电脑高手在前三年每年仅交付了30台游戏笔记本电脑，经销商也接受了；但这些笔记本电脑在游戏玩家中很受欢迎，经销商并未提出异议。因此，该电脑高手花费大量资金购买新的笔记本电脑零件，以帮助加快未来的制造速度。然而，在第四年的第一季度，经销商以该电脑高手违反年度数量条款为由终止了合同。

在该电脑高手对经销商提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，陪审团认定合同已因双方行为而修改，初审法院判予该电脑高手巨额补偿性损害赔偿。

这一判决结果在上诉中是否可能被推翻？
options:
A. No, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was unconscionable as against an amateur computer builder.
不会，因为合同中的禁止口头修改条款对于一位业余电脑制造者而言是不合情理的。

B. No, because the distributor by its conduct waived the annual-quantity term and the computer whiz materially changed his position in reasonable reliance on that waiver.
不会，因为经销商通过其行为放弃了年度数量条款，并且该电脑高手基于对该放弃的合理信赖，其处境发生了实质性改变。

C. Yes, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was a material part of the agreed exchange and could not be avoided without new consideration.
会，因为合同中的禁止口头修改条款是约定交易的实质性部分，在没有新对价的情况下不能被规避。

D. Yes, because the contract's no-oral-modification clause was not expressly waived by the distributor.
会，因为合同中的禁止口头修改条款未被经销商明确放弃。
data.explanation:
Unwritten modifications of contracts


Contract silent on modificationUnwritten modification valid unless statute of frauds applies (common law & UCC)
Contract clause requires written modificationCommon law
Clause unenforceable Unwritten modification valid unless statute of frauds applies.
UCC
Clause enforceable (ie, unwritten modification invalid) if:
  • contract written & signed
  • clause separately signed by nonmerchant if sued by merchant
Clause waived (ie, unwritten modification valid) if:
  • parties intended unwritten modification
  • one party materially changed position in reliance
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

Under the UCC, contract clauses that require modifications to be in writing (ie, no-oral-modification clauses) are generally enforceable against non-merchants who separately sign the clause. But these clauses are waived if:
  • the parties attempt to modify the contract orally or by their conduct (eg, tendering and accepting an alternate performance) and
  • one party materially changes his/her position in reliance on that modification.
In that case, the attempted modification is valid. And if either party breaches or terminates the modified contract, the other party is entitled to compensatory damages.

Here, the computer whiz agreed to deliver 50 gaming laptops a year over a five-year period but delivered only 30 laptops a year for the first three years. By tendering and accepting this alternate performance, the parties attempted to waive the annual-quantity term. And since the computer whiz relied on that modification and materially changed his position by spending substantial sums on new laptop parts, the no-oral-modification clause was waived. Therefore, the computer whiz's compensatory damages will not be reversed on appeal.

(Choice A) A court can refuse to enforce a contract clause that is unconscionable - eg, unfairly influenced by the parties' unequal bargaining power. But here, although the computer whiz was an amateur, there is no indication that the no-oral-modification clause was unfairly influenced by the distributor's superior bargaining power.

(Choice C) A sale-of-goods contract can be modified without new consideration - even if the modification avoids a material part of the agreed exchange - so long as the modification is sought in good faith.

(Choice D) The parties to a sale-of-goods contract can demonstrate their intent to waive a no-oral-modification clause expressly (eg, orally) OR by their conduct (as seen here).

Educational objective: Under the UCC, no-oral-modification clauses are generally enforceable against non-merchants who separately sign the clause. But these clauses are waived if (1) the parties attempt to modify the contract orally OR by their conduct and (2) one party materially changed his/her position in reliance on that modification.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 87%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同的非书面修改


合同对修改未作规定非书面修改有效，除非适用反欺诈法（普通法 & UCC）
合同条款要求书面修改普通法
条款不可执行。非书面修改有效，除非适用反欺诈法。
UCC
条款可执行（即非书面修改无效），如果：
  • 合同是书面形式且已签署
  • 如果被商人起诉，非商人需单独签署该条款
条款被放弃（即非书面修改有效），如果：
  • 双方意图进行非书面修改
  • 一方基于信赖而实质性地改变了其处境
UCC = 美国《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）。

根据UCC，要求修改必须采用书面形式的合同条款（即禁止口头修改条款）对于单独签署该条款的非商人通常是可执行的。但在以下情况下，这些条款被视为放弃：
  • 双方试图通过口头或其行为（例如，提出并接受替代履行）来修改合同，并且
  • 一方基于对该修改的信赖而实质性地改变了他/她的处境。
在这种情况下，试图进行的修改是有效的。并且，如果任何一方违反或终止修改后的合同，另一方有权获得补偿性损害赔偿。

在本案中，该电脑高手同意在五年内每年交付50台游戏笔记本电脑，但在前三年每年只交付了30台。通过提出并接受这种替代履行，双方试图放弃年度数量条款。并且，由于该电脑高手信赖了该修改，并通过花费巨资购买新的笔记本电脑零件而实质性地改变了其处境，禁止口头修改条款被放弃了。因此，判给该电脑高手的补偿性损害赔偿在上诉中将不会被推翻。

(选项A) 如果一个合同条款是不合情理的——例如，因双方不平等的议价能力而受到不公平影响——法院可以拒绝执行该条款。但在本案中，尽管电脑高手是业余人士，但没有迹象表明禁止口头修改条款是因经销商的优势议价能力而受到不公平影响。

(选项C) 货物销售合同可以在没有新对价的情况下进行修改——即使该修改规避了约定交易的实质性部分——只要该修改是本着善意寻求的。

(选项D) 货物销售合同的双方可以通过明示（如口头）或通过其行为（如本案所示）来表明他们放弃禁止口头修改条款的意图。

教学目标：根据UCC，对于单独签署禁止口头修改条款的非商人，该条款通常是可执行的。但如果(1) 双方试图通过口头或其行为修改合同，并且(2) 一方基于对该修改的信赖而实质性地改变了他/她的处境，则该条款被视为放弃。

UCC = 美国《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）

References

U.C.C. § 2-209 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (explaining that a contract clause requiring written modification is generally enforceable by a merchant against a non-merchant who separately signs the clause).

MBE 考点解析

UCC Article 2: Contract Modification & Waiver

本题考察的核心是美国《统一商法典》（UCC）下关于合同修改（Modification）与弃权（Waiver）的规则。

正确答案是 B。

判决不会被推翻，因为经销商的行为构成了对合同条款的弃权，且电脑高手已产生信赖。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (UCC § 2-209)
  1. 禁止口头修改条款 (NOM Clause)： UCC 允许合同规定“修改必须书面”。如果非商人（Non-merchant）单独签署了该条款，该条款通常有效。
  2. 弃权 (Waiver)： 即使修改不符合书面要求，双方的履行行为 (Course of Performance) 仍可能构成对该条款的“弃权”。
  3. 信赖 (Reliance)： 一旦一方基于该弃权实质性地改变了立场（Materially changed position），该弃权便不可撤销。
第一步：识别适用法律

本案涉及笔记本电脑（货物）的买卖，因此适用 UCC Article 2，而非普通法（Common Law）。

第二步：分析 NOM 条款

合同中包含“禁止口头修改条款”（No Oral Modification Clause）。虽然电脑高手是业余人士（非商人），但他单独签署了该条款，因此该条款在形式上是有效的。这意味着，纯粹的口头协议通常无法修改合同。

第三步：行为构成弃权 (关键点)

尽管有书面条款，但经销商在长达三年的时间里，接受了每年30台而非50台的交付，且未提出异议。这种履行过程 (Course of Performance) 构成了对“每年50台”这一数量条款的弃权 (Waiver)。

第四步：信赖导致不可撤销

UCC规定，如果对方尚未信赖该弃权，弃权方可以通知撤回弃权，恢复原合同条款。但本案中，电脑高手基于信赖 (Reliance) 投入巨资购买零件。因此，经销商的弃权已不可撤销，不能再以违反数量条款为由终止合同。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到“书面合同”与“实际履行行为”不一致：

  • 如果是普通法：随后的口头协议或行为通常直接修改合同（即使有 NOM 条款）。
  • 如果是 UCC：NOM 条款通常有效，但是要注意“行为构成弃权 + 信赖”这一例外。只要一方基于对方的行为改变了立场（Detrimental Reliance），法院通常会保护信赖方。

为什么其他选项错误？
❌ A (显失公平 Unconscionability): 门槛极高，仅凭一方是业余人士不足以认定条款显失公平。
❌ C (对价 Consideration): UCC 修改合同不需要新对价 (Good faith is enough)。
❌ D (明示弃权 Express Waiver): 弃权可以通过行为 (Conduct) 默示作出，不需要明确的口头或书面声明。

questions.question:
On June 1, a widget manufacturer entered into a written agreement with a tool maker, in which the tool maker agreed to produce and sell to the widget manufacturer 12 sets of newly designed dies to be delivered August 1 for the price of $50,000, payable ten days after delivery. Encountering unexpected expenses in the purchase of special alloy steel required for the dies, the tool maker advised the widget manufacturer that production costs would exceed the contract price. On July 1 the widget manufacturer and the tool maker signed a modification to the June 1 agreement increasing the contract price to $60,000. After timely receipt of 12 sets of dies conforming to the contract specifications, the widget manufacturer paid the tool maker $50,000 but refused to pay more.
Which of the following concepts of the Uniform Commercial Code, dealing expressly with the sale of goods, best supports an action by the tool maker to recover $10,000 for breach of the widget manufacturer's July 1 promise?

choices.a: Bargained-for exchange.
choices.b: Modification of contracts without consideration.
choices.c: Promissory estoppel.
choices.d: Unconscionability in the formation of contracts.

questions.question:
On March 1, an apartment complex received from an appliance company a signed letter offering to sell 1,200 window air conditioners suitable for the apartments in the complex. The appliance company's offer stated that it would remain open until March 20, but that the apartment complex's acceptance must be received on or before that date. On March 16, the apartment complex posted a letter of acceptance. On March 17, the appliance company emailed the complex to advise that it was revoking the offer. The email was received by the apartment complex on March 17, but the complex's letter did not arrive at the appliance company's address until March 21.
As of March 22, which of the following is a correct statement?

choices.a: The email revoking the offer was effective upon receipt.
choices.b: The mail was the only authorized means of revocation.
choices.c: The offer was revocable at any time for lack of consideration.
choices.d: Under the terms of the appliance company's offer, the apartment complex's attempted acceptance was ineffective.

3月1日，一栋公寓大楼收到一家电器公司签署的信函，该信函要约出售1200台适用于该大楼公寓的窗式空调。电器公司的要约声明，该要约将保持有效至3月20日，但公寓大楼的承诺必须在该日期或之前被收到。3月16日，公寓大楼寄出了一封承诺信函。3月17日，电器公司通过电子邮件通知公寓大楼，其正在撤销该要约。公寓大楼于3月17日收到了该电子邮件，但其信函直到3月21日才送达电器公司的地址。

截至3月22日，以下哪项陈述是正确的？
options:
A. The email revoking the offer was effective upon receipt.
撤销要约的电子邮件一经收到即生效。

B. The mail was the only authorized means of revocation.
邮寄是唯一被授权的撤销方式。

C. The offer was revocable at any time for lack of consideration.
因缺乏对价，该要约可随时撤销。

D. Under the terms of the appliance company's offer, the apartment complex's attempted acceptance was ineffective.
根据电器公司要约的条款，公寓大楼试图作出的承诺是无效的。
data.explanation:
Termination of offer before acceptance


Offeror'srevocation
  • Offeror communicates revocation directly to offeree
  • Offeree learns information from reliable source that reasonably indicates offer was revoked (eg, house sold to another buyer)
Offeree's rejection
  • Offeree communicates rejection directly to offeror
  • Offeree's counteroffer serves as rejection & new offer
Lapse
  • Time period specified in offer expires
  • After reasonable time if no time period specified in offer
By law
  • Either party dies or is adjudicated insane
  • Subject matter of offer is destroyed or becomes illegal
Contract formation (ie, the creation of a legally enforceable agreement) requires both an offer and an acceptance (ie, mutual assent). To effectively accept an offer, the offeree must:
  • manifest an objective intent to be bound by the terms of the offer and
  • follow any specifications in the offer as to the time, place, or manner of acceptance.


Under the mailbox rule, acceptance by mail is generally effective upon dispatch. But the offeror is master of the offer and can therefore override this rule - eg, by stating that acceptance must be received by a certain date.

Here, the appliance company's offer to sell air conditioners specified that acceptance must be received, not merely dispatched, by March 20. Since the apartment complex's reply letter did not arrive at the appliance company's address until March 21, the apartment complex's attempted acceptance was ineffective.

(Choices A, B & C) A merchant's offer is firm (ie, irrevocable) if the merchant provides a written and signed assurance that the offer will be held open for a period of time - no consideration is required. Here, the appliance company (merchant) gave a written and signed assurance that its offer would remain open until March 20. As a result, the offer could not be revoked by email (or any other means) before March 20.

Educational objective: To accept an offer, the offeree must manifest an objective intent to be bound by the terms of the offer AND follow any specifications in the offer as to the time, place, or manner of acceptance (which override the mailbox rule).

选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 5%，C选项 7%，D选项 66%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

承诺前要约的终止


要约人的撤销
  • 要约人直接向受要约人传达撤销
  • 受要约人从可靠来源获知信息，该信息合理地表明要约已被撤销（例如，房屋已售予另一买家）
受要约人的拒绝
  • 受要约人直接向要约人传达拒绝
  • 受要约人的反要约构成拒绝及新要约
失效
  • 要约中规定的期限届满
  • 若要约未规定期限，则在合理时间后
依法
  • 任一方当事人死亡或被宣告为精神失常
  • 要约标的物被毁或变为非法
合同成立（即可依法强制执行的协议的订立）要求要约和承诺（即双方合意）。为有效承诺一项要约，受要约人必须：
  • 表现出受要约条款约束的客观意图并且
  • 遵守要约中关于承诺的时间、地点或方式的任何具体规定。


根据邮箱规则，通过邮寄方式作出的承诺通常在发信时生效。但是，要约人是要约的主人，因此可以推翻此规则——例如，通过声明承诺必须在特定日期前被收到。

在此案中，电器公司出售空调的要约明确规定，承诺必须在3月20日前被收到，而不仅仅是发出。由于公寓大楼的回信直到3月21日才送达电器公司的地址，因此公寓大楼试图作出的承诺是无效的。

（选项 A、B 和 C）如果商人提供书面并签署的保证，承诺要约将在一段时间内保持开放，则该商人的要约构成一项确定要约（即不可撤销的要约）——这不需要对价。在此案中，电器公司（商人）给出了书面并签署的保证，其要约将保持有效至3月20日。因此，在3月20日之前，该要约不能通过电子邮件（或任何其他方式）被撤销。

教学目标：为承诺一项要约，受要约人必须表现出受要约条款约束的客观意图，并遵守要约中关于承诺的时间、地点或方式的任何具体规定（这些规定优先于邮箱规则）。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 60 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an offer's prescriptions regarding the time, place, or manner of acceptance must be complied with to create a contract).
  • 17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 98 (2019) (stating that the parties can modify the default mailbox rule).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Formation & Acceptance
正确答案：D

根据电器公司要约的条款，公寓大楼试图作出的承诺是无效的。

本题考察的是合同法中关于要约的主导地位 (Master of the Offer) 以及 UCC 确定要约 (Firm Offer) 的规则。

核心法律逻辑解析
1. 要约人是要约的主人 (Master of the Offer)

这是本题解题的关键。虽然通常情况下适用邮箱规则 (Mailbox Rule)——即承诺在寄出时生效（Dispatch），但是要约人有权在要约中规定具体的承诺方式。

  • 规则：如果要约明确规定承诺必须在特定日期前被收到 (Received)，那么该条款优先于邮箱规则。
  • 应用：电器公司的要约明确指出“承诺必须在3月20日或之前被收到”。
  • 结果：公寓大楼的信件虽然在3月16日寄出，但直到3月21日才送达。由于未满足“3月20日收到”的条件，该承诺无效 (Ineffective)。
2. UCC 确定要约 (UCC Firm Offer)

本题涉及货物买卖，适用 UCC Article 2。这解释了为什么其他选项是错误的。

  • 定义：根据 UCC § 2-205，如果商人 (Merchant) 在签署的书面文件 (Signed Writing) 中保证要约将保持开放，则该要约在规定时间内不可撤销 (Irrevocable)，且无需对价 (Consideration)。
  • 应用：电器公司是商人，签署了信函，并保证要约开放至3月20日。
  • 结果：电器公司在3月17日发出的撤销邮件是无效的，因为此时要约处于不可撤销期间。
为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误：撤销邮件并未生效。因为这是一个 UCC Firm Offer，在3月20日之前，要约人无权撤销。
选项 B 错误：即使要约可以撤销，法律通常不限制撤销的方式（除非要约有特别规定）。但这不重要，因为本案中要约根本不可撤销。
选项 C 错误：这是普通法 (Common Law) 的规则（期权合同需要对价）。但在 UCC 规则下，商人的书面确定要约不需要对价即可在一定期限内不可撤销。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理合同成立 (Formation) 的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看主体与标的：是服务（普通法）还是货物（UCC）？本题是空调（货物）→ 适用 UCC。
  2. 看要约条款：是否有“Firm Offer”的特征？是否有“Received by”这种排除邮箱规则的语言？
  3. 时间线分析：画出要约、撤销、承诺发出、承诺收到的时间轴。

切记：如果要约规定了“Receipt”作为生效条件，千万不要使用“Dispatch”作为承诺生效的时间点。

questions.question:
A fine clothing store placed an advertisement in a local newspaper that read: "Sale! This weekend only, fur coats for as low as $100!" A local shopper read the advertisement and drove to the clothing store that weekend. All the fur coats were priced between $500 and $1,500. The shopper inquired about the sale. The salesperson told her that the advertisement was incorrect because the sale was not scheduled to occur until the following weekend. The shopper replied, "Why don't you just sell me one of these coats for $100 today?" The salesperson refused, and the shopper angrily left the store.
If the shopper sues the store for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the shopper's question was too equivocal to be an acceptance of the store's offer.
choices.b: No, because the store's advertisement was merely an invitation to negotiate.
choices.c: Yes, because the shopper detrimentally relied on the store's advertisement by driving to the store.
choices.d: Yes, because the shopper had accepted the store's general offer to sell a fur coat for $100.

A local shopper read the advertisement and drove to the clothing store that weekend. All the fur coats were priced between $500 and $1,500. The shopper inquired about the sale. If the shopper sues the store for breach of contract, will she be likely to prevail?

一家高档服装店在当地报纸上刊登了一则广告，内容是：“促销！仅限本周末，皮草大衣最低售价100美元！”一位当地购物者看到了这则广告，并于那个周末驾车前往该服装店。店里所有的皮草大衣标价都在500到1500美元之间。该购物者询问促销活动。销售人员告诉她，广告有误，因为促销活动计划在下个周末才进行。该购物者回答说：“为什么今天不以100美元的价格卖给我一件呢？”销售人员拒绝了，购物者生气地离开了商店。

如果该购物者以违约为由起诉该商店，她是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the shopper's question was too equivocal to be an acceptance of the store's offer.
不会，因为购物者的问题过于含糊，不能构成对商店要约的承诺。

B. No, because the store's advertisement was merely an invitation to negotiate.
不会，因为商店的广告仅仅是要约邀请。

C. Yes, because the shopper detrimentally relied on the store's advertisement by driving to the store.
会，因为购物者因信赖商店的广告而驾车前往商店，从而遭受了不利影响。

D. Yes, because the shopper had accepted the store's general offer to sell a fur coat for $100.
会，因为购物者已经承诺了商店以100美元出售一件皮草大衣的一般要约。
data.explanation:
Advertisements are generally considered invitations to negotiate or solicitations of offers, which create no power of acceptance in the recipient. However, an advertisement can constitute a general offer - the acceptance of which creates a binding contract - if the advertisement :

specifies the subject matter, quantity, and price and places a reasonable limit on who can accept the offer.

Here, the clothing store placed an advertisement in the newspaper stating that fur coats (subject matter) would be sold for as low as $100 (price). However, the ad failed to specify the quantity of fur coats to be sold at this price and placed no limit on who could accept. As a result, the ad was merely an invitation to negotiate. And since there was no offer that could be accepted, the shopper is unlikely to prevail in her breach-of-contract suit.

(Choices A & D) An acceptance must be unequivocal to bind either party. Here, the shopper's question - "Why don't you just sell me one of these coats for $100 today?" - was unequivocal since it clearly indicated her intent to purchase a coat. But her attempted acceptance was ineffective since there was no offer.

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, an unaccepted offer may become irrevocable if the offeree reasonably relies on it and suffers a substantial detriment as a result. But here, the store's advertisement was not an offer. And even if it were, the shopper did not suffer a substantial detriment by driving to the store.

Educational objective: Advertisements are generally considered invitations to negotiate instead of offers to form contracts. However, an advertisement can constitute a general offer if it:
  • specifies the subject matter, quantity, and price and
  • places a reasonable limit on who can accept the offer.




选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 80%（正确选项），C选项 5%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

广告通常被认为是要约邀请或要约的引诱，这并不会赋予收件人承诺的权利。然而，广告可以构成一项一般要约——对其的承诺会形成一份有约束力的合同——如果该广告：

明确了标的物、数量和价格，并且对谁可以承诺该要约设置了合理的限制。

在本案中，服装店在报纸上刊登广告，声明皮草大衣（标的物）将以低至100美元的价格（价格）出售。然而，该广告未能明确以此价格出售的皮草大衣的数量，也未对可以承诺的人设置任何限制。因此，该广告仅仅是要约邀请。并且，由于没有可以被承诺的要约，购物者在她提起的违约诉讼中不太可能胜诉。

（选项 A & D）承诺必须是明确无误的，才能对任何一方产生约束力。在本案中，购物者的问题——“为什么今天不以100美元的价格卖给我一件呢？”——是明确的，因为它清楚地表明了她购买大衣的意图。但是，由于没有要约存在，她尝试作出的承诺是无效的。

（选项 C）根据“禁止反言原则”(promissory estoppel)，如果受要约人合理地信赖一项未被承诺的要约，并且因此遭受了重大的不利影响，那么该要约可能变为不可撤销的。但在本案中，商店的广告并非要约。而且，即使它是一个要约，购物者驾车前往商店也并未遭受重大的不利影响。

教学目标：广告通常被认为是旨在订立合同的要约邀请，而非要约。然而，如果广告满足以下条件，则可以构成一般要约：
  • 明确了标的物、数量和价格，并且
  • 对可以承诺该要约的人设置了合理的限制。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 26 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an advertisement is not an offer unless it contains language of commitment).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Formation
✅ 正确答案：B

购物者不会胜诉，因为商店的广告仅仅是要约邀请 (Invitation to Negotiate)，而非要约 (Offer)。

核心考点：广告的法律性质

在合同法中，大众媒体上的广告通常被视为要约邀请 (Invitation to Deal / Invitation to Negotiate)，而不是要约。

为什么？

因为广告通常是向不特定的大多数人发出的，如果视为要约，商家可能会面临“供不应求”导致违约的风险。

例外情况：广告构成要约

如果广告满足以下所有条件，可视为一般要约 (General Offer)：

  • 内容明确、肯定 (Clear, definite, and explicit)
  • 没有协商余地 (Leaves nothing open for negotiation)
  • 通常包含数量限制或承诺资格限制 (e.g., "First come, first served")
🔍 本案分析

题目中的广告内容为：“促销！仅限本周末，皮草大衣最低售价100美元！”

  • ❌ 缺少数量：没有说明有多少件大衣以该价格出售。
  • ❌ 缺少承诺限制：没有说明“先到先得”或限制前几名顾客。
  • ❌ 用词模糊："As low as"（低至）意味着价格不确定，需要进一步协商。

结论：这只是邀请顾客来店里“谈生意”，顾客进店并要求购买的行为才是发出要约 (Offer)，店员有权拒绝。

💡 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

承诺的明确性：购物者说“卖给我一件”意图非常明确。A 选项错误地攻击了购物者的意图，而真正的问题在于商店根本没有发出要约。

选项 C 错误

禁止反言 (Promissory Estoppel)：这需要受要约人有合理的信赖并遭受重大的不利影响 (Substantial Detriment)。仅仅“开车去商店”通常不被法院视为足以触发禁止反言的重大损失。

选项 D 错误

一般要约：如前所述，因为缺乏具体条款（特别是数量），该广告不构成一般要约。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到“广告”题，首先默认它是要约邀请。
只有当你看到明确的数量（如 "1 fur coat"）和承诺方式（如 "First come, first served"）时，才考虑它是要约。
(参考经典判例: Lefkowitz v. Great Minneapolis Surplus Store)

questions.question:
A U.S. West-Coast manufacturer gave a hardware retailer who was relocating to the East Coast the following signed "letter of introduction" to an East-Coast hardware wholesaler:
"This will introduce you to my good friend and former customer, who is a retailer and will be seeking to arrange the purchase of hardware inventory from you on credit. If you will let him have the goods, I will make good any loss up to $25,000 in the event of his default."
The retailer presented the letter to a wholesaler, who then sold and delivered $20,000 worth of hardware to the retailer on credit. The wholesaler promptly notified the manufacturer of this sale.
Which of the following is NOT an accurate statement concerning the arrangement between the manufacturer and the wholesaler?

choices.a: Although the manufacturer received no consideration from the retailer, the manufacturer's promise is enforceable by the wholesaler.
choices.b: By extending the credit to the retailer, the wholesaler effectively accepted the manufacturer's offer for a unilateral contract.
choices.c: It was important to enforceability of the manufacturer's promise to the wholesaler that it be embodied in a signed writing.
choices.d: The manufacturer's promise is enforceable by the wholesaler whether or not the wholesaler gave the manufacturer seasonable notice of the extension of credit to the retailer.

一家美国西海岸的制造商向一位正搬迁至东海岸的五金零售商出具了以下经签署的致东海岸某五金批发商的“介绍信”：

“兹向您介绍我的好友兼前客户，他是一位零售商，将寻求以赊购方式向您采购五金库存。如果您愿意向他提供货物，在他违约的情况下，我将赔偿任何不超过25,000美元的损失。”

该零售商将信函出示给一位批发商，该批发商随后以赊购方式向该零售商出售并交付了价值20,000美元的五金产品。该批发商及时将此次销售通知了制造商。

以下哪项关于制造商与批发商之间安排的陈述是不准确的？
options:
A. Although the manufacturer received no consideration from the retailer, the manufacturer's promise is enforceable by the wholesaler.
虽然制造商未从零售商处获得对价，但其承诺对批发商而言是可强制执行的。

B. By extending the credit to the retailer, the wholesaler effectively accepted the manufacturer's offer for a unilateral contract.
通过向零售商提供信贷，批发商有效地接受了制造商的单方合同要约。

C. It was important to enforceability of the manufacturer's promise to the wholesaler that it be embodied in a signed writing.
制造商对批发商的承诺必须体现在一份经签署的书面文件中，这对该承诺的可执行性至关重要。

D. The manufacturer's promise is enforceable by the wholesaler whether or not the wholesaler gave the manufacturer seasonable notice of the extension of credit to the retailer.
无论批发商是否就其向零售商提供信贷一事及时通知制造商，制造商的承诺对批发商而言都是可强制执行的。
data.explanation:
A unilateral contract arises when one party (offeror) promises to do something in return for performance of a specific act and the other party (offeree) accepts by completing the requested performance.

The arrangement in this case creates a unilateral contract, and understanding why is key to solving the problem. The determination hinges entirely on what the offeror—the manufacturer—was seeking as acceptance. The manufacturer's letter stated, "If you will let him have the goods, I will make good any loss..." This language does not ask for a promise in return; it asks for an act of performance. The wholesaler could not accept this offer by simply sending a letter back saying, "We promise to sell him the goods." The only way to accept was by actually performing the requested act: selling the hardware to the retailer on credit.

It is crucial to note that a suretyship (guarantee) agreement is not, by nature, an exception to this rule and can absolutely be unilateral. While many guarantees are bilateral (e.g., a bank and a guarantor exchange written promises before a loan is issued), this one was structured unilaterally. The manufacturer essentially made a standing offer to the wholesaler, which the wholesaler accepted at the moment it performed the act of extending credit. That single act served as both the acceptance of the offer and the consideration that made the manufacturer's promise to pay enforceable.

Notice is not required to make the acceptance effective unless the offer so requires. But if the offeree has reason to know that the offeror would not learn of the completed performance within a reasonable time, then the offeror's duty is discharged unless :
  • the offeree exercises reasonable diligence to notify the offeror
  • the offeror learns of the performance within a reasonable time or
  • the offer indicates that notification of acceptance is not required.
Here, the manufacturer promised to guarantee repayment of up to $25,000 if the wholesaler would let the retailer purchase hardware on credit (offer for unilateral contract). The wholesaler then sold and delivered $20,000 worth of hardware to the retailer on credit (acceptance) (Choice B). But the manufacturer would have had no way of learning about that transaction on its own. Therefore, the fact that the wholesaler notified the manufacturer of the wholesaler's extension of credit is the reason why the wholesaler can enforce the manufacturer's promise.

(Choice A) Although the manufacturer received no consideration from the retailer , its agreement with the wholesaler was supported by consideration. That is because the manufacturer's promise was induced by the wholesaler's extension of credit to the retailer (and vice versa). Therefore, the promise is not unenforceable for lack of consideration.

(Choice C) The manufacturer's promise created a suretyship - ie, a contract where one party promises to assume responsibility for the duty of a third party to the contract. Therefore, it fell within the statute of frauds and needed to be in writing and signed by the party to be charged (the manufacturer).

Educational objective: Notice of acceptance is not required to form a unilateral contract unless the offer requires notice OR the offeree has reason to know that the offeror would not learn of the completed performance within a reasonable time.





选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 37%，C选项 16%，D选项 34%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一方（要约人）承诺以某事换取另一方（受要约人）完成特定行为，而另一方（受要约人）通过完成所要求的行为来表示接受时，单方合同即告成立。

本案中的协议构成了一份单方合同，理解其原因正是解决本题的关键。判断的核心完全在于要约人——即制造商——寻求何种方式的承诺。制造商的信函中写道：“如果您愿意向他提供货物，我将赔偿任何损失……” 这个措辞并非要求对方作出一个对待承诺；它要求的是一个履约行为。批发商不能简单地回信说“我们承诺会向他销售货物”来接受此要约。接受该要约的唯一方式就是实际履行所要求的行为：即以赊购方式将五金产品卖给零售商。

必须强调的是，保证合同（suretyship）本质上并非此规则的例外，完全可以是单方合同。尽管许多保证合同是双边的（例如，银行和保证人在贷款发放前交换书面承诺），但本案中的这份保证被构建成了单方合同。制造商实际上是向批发商发出了一个持续有效的要约，而批发商在其履行“提供信贷”这一行为的瞬间，就接受了该要约。这一个行为既是对此要约的接受，也是使制造商的付款承诺具有可执行力的对价。

除非要约有此要求，否则通知并非使接受生效的必要条件。但是，如果受要约人有理由知道要约人无法在合理时间内知晓履约已完成，那么要约人的义务将被免除，除非：
  • 受要约人尽到合理的努力通知要约人
  • 要约人在合理时间内知晓了履约情况或
  • 要约表明不需要接受通知。
在本案中，制造商承诺，如果批发商允许零售商以赊购方式购买五金产品，制造商将担保最高25,000美元的偿付（单方合同的要约）。随后，批发商以赊购方式向零售商出售并交付了价值20,000美元的五金产品（接受）(选项 B)。但制造商无法自行得知该交易的发生。因此，批发商向零售商提供信贷后通知了制造商这一事实，是批发商能够强制执行制造商承诺的原因。

(选项 A) 虽然制造商未从零售商处获得对价，但其与批发商的协议是有对价支持的。这是因为制造商的承诺是由批发商向零售商提供信贷所引出的（反之亦然）。因此，该承诺不会因缺乏对价而不可强制执行。

(选项 C) 制造商的承诺构成了一项保证合同——即一方承诺为合同第三方的义务承担责任的合同。因此，该承诺属于《反欺诈法》(statute of frauds)的管辖范围，并且需要以书面形式订立，并由应承担责任的一方（制造商）签署。

教学目标：除非要约要求通知，或者受要约人有理由知道要约人无法在合理时间内得知履约已完成，否则订立单方合同无需发出接受通知。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 54 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (acceptance by performance and necessity of notification to offeror).

MBE 考点解析：单方合同与通知义务

本题考察的是合同法中关于单方合同 (Unilateral Contract) 的成立以及接受通知 (Notice of Acceptance) 的特殊规则。

正确答案是 D
(因为题目要求选出不准确的陈述)

1. 核心考点：单方合同的接受

本案中，制造商的信函构成了一个要约 (Offer)。关键在于识别这是一个单方合同要约。

单方合同 (Unilateral Contract)
要约人寻求的是受要约人的行为 (Performance)，而非承诺 (Promise)。

信中写道："If you will let him have the goods..."（如果你愿意给他货物……）。这表明制造商不想要批发商回信说“我答应”，而是想要批发商实际发货这一行为。批发商发货即构成接受 (Acceptance)。

2. 为什么 D 是错误的（即本题答案）？

选项 D 声称：无论批发商是否通知制造商，该承诺都是可执行的。这违背了单方合同中关于“通知”的例外规则。

一般规则：单方合同通常不需要通知，履约即接受。

例外规则 (Restatement § 54)：

  • 如果受要约人有理由知道，要约人无法在合理时间内得知履约已完成，那么受要约人必须尽合理的努力通知要约人。
  • 如果未通知，要约人的义务将被免除 (Discharged)。

本案应用：

  • 制造商在西海岸，批发商在东海岸。
  • 制造商无法自动得知批发商是否真的向零售商赊销了货物。
  • 因此，批发商必须通知制造商。如果像 D 选项所说“无论是否通知”都可执行，这在法律上是错误的。

3. 其他选项为何是正确的陈述？

为了排除干扰项，我们需要理解为什么 A、B、C 都是法律上准确的描述：

  • 选项 A (对价 Consideration)：
    虽然制造商没从零售商那里拿钱，但制造商的承诺是由批发商的“不利行为”（赊销货物）换取的。这种交易性交换 (Bargained-for exchange) 构成了有效对价。
  • 选项 B (接受 Acceptance)：
    如前所述，发货行为就是对单方合同要约的有效接受。
  • 选项 C (反欺诈法 Statute of Frauds)：
    这是一个保证合同 (Suretyship)——承诺为他人的债务负责。根据《反欺诈法》，此类合同必须是书面的并由被执行方签署。本案中有签署的信函，符合要求。

4. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到单方合同加上地理隔离（如一方在纽约，一方在加州），立刻警惕通知义务 (Notice Requirement)。

虽然单方合同通常不需要通知，但如果“要约人不可能自己知道履约发生”，则必须通知。

questions.question:
A notorious spendthrift who was usually broke for that reason received the following letter from his uncle, a wealthy and prudent man: "I understand you're in financial difficulties again. I promise to give you $5,000 on your birthday next month, but you'd better use it wisely or you'll never get another dime from me." The spendthrift thereupon signed a contract with a car dealer to purchase a $40,000 automobile and to make a $5,000 down payment on the day after his birthday.
If the spendthrift sues the uncle for $5,000 after the uncle learned of the car-purchase contract and then repudiated his promise, which of the following is the uncle's best defense?

choices.a: A promise to make a gift in the future is not enforceable.
choices.b: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless injustice can be avoided only by such enforcement.
choices.c: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless that reliance also results in an economic benefit to the promisor.
choices.d: Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless the value of the promised gift is substantially equivalent to the promisee's loss by reliance.

I promise to give you $5,000 on your birthday next month, but you'd better use it wisely or you'll never get another dime from me." The spendthrift thereupon signed a contract with a car dealer to purchase a $40,000 automobile and to make a $5,000 down payment on the day after his birthday.

If the spendthrift sues the uncle for $5,000 after the uncle learned of the car-purchase contract and then repudiated his promise, which of the following is the uncle's best defense?

一个臭名昭著的挥霍者因此经常身无分文，他收到了他富有且审慎的叔叔的来信："我知道你又陷入财务困境了。我承诺下个月你生日时给你5000美元，但你最好明智地使用这笔钱，否则你再也别想从我这里拿到一分钱。" 于是，这个挥霍者与一家汽车经销商签订了一份合同，购买一辆价值4万美元的汽车，并约定在他生日后的第二天支付5000美元的首付款。

如果叔叔在得知购车合同后反悔其承诺，而挥霍者因此起诉叔叔索要5000美元，以下哪项是叔叔的最佳抗辩理由？
options:
A. A promise to make a gift in the future is not enforceable.
未来赠与的承诺不具有强制执行力。

B. Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless injustice can be avoided only by such enforcement.
受诺人对未来赠与承诺的信赖，并不使该承诺具有强制执行力，除非只有通过强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正。

C. Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless that reliance also results in an economic benefit to the promisor.
受诺人对未来赠与承诺的信赖，并不使该承诺具有强制执行力，除非该信赖也为允诺人带来了经济利益。

D. Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless the value of the promised gift is substantially equivalent to the promisee's loss by reliance.
受诺人对未来赠与承诺的信赖，并不使该承诺具有强制执行力，除非所承诺的赠与价值与受诺人因信赖而遭受的损失基本相当。
data.explanation:
Promises binding without consideration


Pay debt barred by technical defensePromise to pay debt that would be enforceable absent technical defense to enforcement (eg, statute of limitations, bankruptcy)
Perform voidable dutyPromise to perform voidable duty, provided that new promise is not also voidable (eg, minor reaffirms promise to perform contract after reaching age of majority)
Pay for material benefits receivedPromise to pay for material benefits received in the past & not intended as a gift (eg, promise to pay for emergency services previously received)
Promissory estoppelAny promise (eg, promise of future gift) if:
  • promisor should reasonably expect promisee to rely on promise
  • promisee relies on promise to his/her detriment and
  • injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of promise
To be enforceable, a contract must be supported by consideration - ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. A promise to make a gift - eg, the uncle's promise to give the spendthrift $5,000 on his birthday without asking for anything in return - does not involve a bargained-for exchange and is generally unenforceable. But under the doctrine of promissory estoppel , a gift promise may be enforceable if :
  • the promisor should reasonably expect the promisee to rely on the promise
  • the promisee relies on the promise to his/her detriment and
  • injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of the promise (Choice A).


Here, the uncle promised to gift the spendthrift $5,000 on his birthday. The uncle likely should have expected the spendthrift to rely on that promise since the uncle knew about the spendthrift's financial difficulties. And the spendthrift did rely on that promise when he entered into a car- purchase contract and agreed to make a $5,000 down payment the day after his birthday. As a result, the uncle's best defense is that the spendthrift's reliance on the promise does not make it enforceable unless injustice can be avoided only by such enforcement.

(Choice C) Promissory estoppel (also known as detrimental reliance) does not require proof that the promisee's reliance resulted in an economic benefit to the promisor.

(Choice D) Reliance by the promisee on a promise to make a future gift does not make the promise enforceable unless the value of the promised gift is substantially equivalent to the promisee's loss by reliance for promissory estoppel to apply. However, the promisee's remedy is limited to actual loss suffered in reliance on the promise - not necessarily the full value of the promise.

Educational objective: A party's promise to make a gift is enforceable under the doctrine of promissory estoppel if (1) the promisor should reasonably expect the promisee to rely on that promise, (2) the promisee detrimentally relies on that promise, and (3) injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of that promise.

选项正确率统计：A选项 32%，B选项 57%（正确选项），C选项 5%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

无对价但有约束力的承诺


支付因技术性抗辩而被禁止的债务承诺支付在没有技术性执行抗辩（例如，诉讼时效、破产）的情况下本可强制执行的债务
履行可撤销的义务承诺履行可撤销的义务，前提是新的承诺本身不是可撤销的（例如，未成年人在成年后再次确认履行合同的承诺）
为已获得的物质利益支付承诺为过去收到的且非意图作为赠与的物质利益付款（例如，承诺支付先前获得的紧急服务费用）
允诺禁反言 (Promissory estoppel)任何承诺（例如，未来赠与的承诺），如果：
  • 允诺人应合理预期受诺人会信赖该承诺
  • 受诺人因信赖该承诺而遭受损害 并且
  • 只有强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正
为具备强制执行力，合同必须有对价（consideration）支持——即，一个经过讨价还价的承诺或履行的交换。赠与承诺——例如，叔叔承诺在挥霍者生日时给他5000美元，而没有要求任何回报——不涉及讨价还价的交换，因此通常不具有强制执行力。但根据允诺禁反言 (promissory estoppel) 原则，赠与承诺在以下情况下可能具有强制执行力：
  • 允诺人应合理预期受诺人会信赖该承诺
  • 受诺人因信赖该承诺而遭受损害 并且
  • 只有通过强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正 (选项A)。


在本案中，叔叔承诺在他生日时赠与挥霍者5000美元。由于叔叔知道挥霍者的财务困境，他理应预见到挥霍者会信赖这一承诺。而挥霍者也确实信赖了该承诺，签订了购车合同，并同意在他生日后的第二天支付5000美元的首付款。因此，叔叔的最佳抗辩理由是，挥霍者对该承诺的信赖并不使其具有强制执行力，除非只有通过强制执行才能避免不公正。

(选项C) 允诺禁反言（promissory estoppel，亦称“不利信赖”）不要求证明受诺人的信赖为允诺人带来了经济利益。

(选项D) 适用允诺禁反言原则，并不要求所承诺的赠与价值必须与受诺人因信赖而遭受的损失大致相当。但是，受诺人的救济仅限于因信赖承诺而遭受的实际损失——而不必然是承诺的全部价值。

教学目的： 根据允诺禁反言 (promissory estoppel) 原则，一方当事人作出的赠与承诺在以下情况下具有强制执行力：(1) 允诺人应合理预期受诺人会信赖该承诺，(2) 受诺人因信赖该承诺而遭受了不利影响（不利信赖），以及 (3) 只有强制执行该承诺才能避免不公正。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 71 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (bargained-for exchange).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (promissory estoppel).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Promissory Estoppel
核心考点：允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel) 本题考察的是在没有对价 (Consideration) 的情况下，赠与承诺何时可以被强制执行。

在普通法合同法中，一般的赠与承诺（Gift Promise）因为缺乏对价通常是不可执行的。但是，允诺禁反言原则提供了一个重要的例外。

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 90

一个承诺若要根据允诺禁反言原则被强制执行，必须满足以下三个要素：

  • 合理预期 (Reasonable Expectation): 允诺人应合理预期该承诺会诱导受诺人的行为或克制。
  • 不利信赖 (Detrimental Reliance): 受诺人实际上信赖了该承诺，并采取了行动或克制。
  • 避免不公 (Prevention of Injustice): 只有通过强制执行该承诺，才能避免不公正的结果。
为什么 B 是最佳抗辩？

本题中，挥霍者（受诺人）确实信赖了叔叔的承诺去买了车。如果叔叔仅仅辩称“这是赠与，没有对价”（选项 A），这个抗辩是不完整的，因为原告会立刻提出“允诺禁反言”来反驳。

选项 B 击中了允诺禁反言原则中最关键的限制条件——“避免不公” (Injustice)。

叔叔的最佳策略是承认承诺和信赖的存在，但辩称：即使你信赖了我的承诺，但不强制执行也不会导致“不公正”。

例如，叔叔可以主张：让一个经常破产的挥霍者因为指望5000美元就去买4万美元的豪车是不理智的，法院拒绝执行承诺并不会产生法律上的不公。

其他选项为何不是最佳？
选项 A (错误)
虽然“未来赠与承诺不可执行”是一般原则，但在本案事实中已经发生了信赖行为（买车），因此这一抗辩会被允诺禁反言原则击破，不是“最佳”防守。
选项 C (错误)
允诺禁反言关注的是受诺人的损失 (Detriment)，而不是允诺人的获益 (Benefit)。这混淆了“对价”理论中的获益/受损原则。
选项 D (错误)
法律并不要求赠与的价值必须与损失“基本相当”才具有执行力。虽然救济范围可能会限制在信赖利益（Reliance Damages）范围内，但这不影响承诺本身的可执行性分析。
💡 MBE 答题技巧 当题目涉及“家庭成员间的赠与承诺”且有人“基于承诺花了钱”时：
  1. 首先判断是否有对价（通常没有）。
  2. 然后应用 Promissory Estoppel。
  3. 注意：该原则是最后的救济手段，只有在不执行会导致明显不公时才适用。辩护方最好的切入点通常是攻击“不公正 (Injustice)”这一要素。

questions.question:
A restaurant owner sent a signed order form to a produce supplier that read: "Please ship us 100 pounds of potatoes at your current price." The supplier received the order form on November 9. Later the same day, the supplier mailed the owner a letter with the proper address and postage. The letter stated that the order had been accepted at the supplier's current price for potatoes. On November 10, before receiving the supplier's reply, the owner telephoned the supplier to inform the supplier that the owner had found a closer supplier and was canceling the order. The supplier asked the owner to reconsider, but the owner refused. On November 11, the owner received the supplier's letter. Relying on the owner's telephone call, the supplier never shipped any potatoes to the restaurant.
As of November 12, is there an enforceable contract between the supplier and the owner?

choices.a: No, because the owner effectively revoked its offer before it was properly accepted.
choices.b: No, because the owner's offer could be accepted only by shipment of the goods, and the supplier never shipped the potatoes.
choices.c: Yes, because the owner's offer was irrevocable for a reasonable time.
choices.d: Yes, because the supplier effectively accepted the owner's offer before the owner revoked it.

一位餐厅所有者向一家农产品供应商发送了一份已签署的订单，内容是：“请按你们的现价运送100磅土豆给我们。” 供应商于11月9日收到了该订单。同日晚些时候，供应商给所有者邮寄了一封地址和邮资均正确的信件。该信件声明，订单已按供应商当前的土豆价格被接受。11月10日，在收到供应商的回复之前，所有者致电供应商，告知其已找到更近的供应商并正在取消订单。供应商请求所有者重新考虑，但所有者拒绝了。11月11日，所有者收到了供应商的信件。基于所有者的电话，供应商从未向餐厅运送任何土豆。

截至11月12日，供应商和所有者之间是否存在一份可强制执行的合同？
options:
A. No, because the owner effectively revoked its offer before it was properly accepted.
不，因为所有者在其要约被适当接受之前，有效地撤销了该要约。

B. No, because the owner's offer could be accepted only by shipment of the goods, and the supplier never shipped the potatoes.
不，因为所有者的要约只能通过货物发运来接受，而供应商从未发运土豆。

C. Yes, because the owner's offer was irrevocable for a reasonable time.
是，因为所有者的要约在一段合理的时间内是不可撤销的。

D. Yes, because the supplier effectively accepted the owner's offer before the owner revoked it.
是，因为在所有者撤销其要约之前，供应商已经有效地接受了该要约。

Offeror's actions
OfferEffective upon receipt

Rejection/counterofferEffective upon receipt
Acceptance (mailbox rule)Effective upon dispatch.
Exceptions - effective upon receipt if:
  • improperly stamped/addressed
  • acceptance by mail unreasonable
  • rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective)
  • acceptance of option contract
Applicable under common law & UCC

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, potatoes) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, a seller can accept a buyer's offer to purchase goods for prompt or immediate shipment by promising to ship, or by shipping , the goods. Once accepted, the offer cannot be revoked because a contract has been formed.

Here, the restaurant owner sent the produce supplier a signed order form that read: "Please ship us 100 pounds of potatoes at your current price." This was an offer that the supplier could accept by promising to ship, or by shipping, the potatoes (Choice B). On November 9, the supplier mailed the owner an acceptance letter that was effective when sent - not upon receipt.† This means that the owner's attempt to revoke its offer on November 10 was ineffective , and there is an enforceable contract between the parties (Choice A).

†An acceptance by mail is generally effective when sent (not upon receipt). But this mailbox rule does not apply to (1) option contracts, which require that the acceptance be received before the offer expires, or (2) offers that specify that acceptance must be received by a certain date.

(Choice C) Certain offers are irrevocable. This includes firm offers - ie, a merchant's written and signed assurance that the offer will be held open for the time stated in the offer or a reasonable time (not to exceed 90 days). No firm offer was made here, however, so the owner could revoke its offer at any time prior to acceptance.

Educational objective: An offer to buy goods for prompt or immediate shipment can be accepted by promising to ship (or by shipping) the goods. Once the offer has been accepted, it cannot be revoked because a contract has already been formed.

要约人的行为
要约送达时生效
要约的撤销送达时生效
受要约人的行为
拒绝/反要约送达时生效
接受 (邮箱规则)发出时生效。
例外情况 - 在以下情况下送达时生效:
  • 邮票或地址不当
  • 以邮寄方式接受不合理
  • 在接受之前邮寄了拒绝（以先收到者为准）
  • 对选择权合同的接受
适用于 common law & UCC

货物买卖合同（例如土豆）受《Uniform Commercial Code》(UCC) 第二条管辖。根据UCC，卖方可以通过承诺发货，或通过发运货物的方式，接受买方购买货物以供即时或立即装运的要约。一旦接受，该要约不可被撤销，因为合同已经成立。

在本案中，餐厅所有者向农产品供应商发送了一份已签署的订单，内容是：“请按你们的现价运送100磅土豆给我们。” 这是一个要约，供应商可以通过承诺发货或通过发运土豆来接受该要约(选项 B)。11月9日，供应商给所有者邮寄了一封接受信，该信在寄出时即生效——而非送达时生效。† 这意味着所有者在11月10日试图撤销其要约是无效的，双方之间存在一份可强制执行的合同 (选项 A)。

†通过邮件进行的接受通常在寄出时生效（而非送达时）。但此邮箱规则不适用于 (1) 选择权合同，该合同要求接受必须在要约到期前被收到；或 (2) 明确规定接受必须在特定日期前被收到的要约。

(选项 C) 某些要约是不可撤销的。这包括确定要约 (firm offers)——即商人以书面形式签署的、保证要约将在规定时间或合理时间内（不超过90天）保持开放的保证。然而，本案中并未作出确定要约，因此所有者可以在接受之前的任何时间撤销其要约。

教学目标：购买货物以供即时或立即装运的要约，可以通过承诺发货（或通过发运）货物的方式来接受。一旦要约被接受，它就不能被撤销，因为合同已经成立。

References

U.C.C. § 2-206 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (offer and acceptance).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2

✅ 正确答案：D

是的，因为供应商在所有者撤销要约之前，已经有效地接受了该要约。

本题考察的核心是合同法中经典的“邮箱规则” (Mailbox Rule) 以及 UCC 对货物买卖合同成立的规定。

关键时间线分析 (Timeline)
11月9日 (早些时候)
收到要约 (Offer Received)
供应商收到买方购买土豆的订单。
11月9日 (晚些时候)
寄出接受信 (Acceptance Mailed)
合同在此刻成立！
根据邮箱规则，接受在寄出时 (Dispatch) 生效。
11月10日
电话撤销 (Attempted Revocation)
买方试图撤销。但撤销通常在收到时 (Receipt) 才生效。此时合同已于昨日成立，撤销无效。
11月11日
收到接受信 (Letter Received)
虽然此时才收到信，但法律效力追溯至寄出日。

⚖️ 法律依据解析

1. 适用法律：UCC Article 2

因为土豆属于货物 (Goods)，所以适用《统一商法典》(UCC) 而非普通法 (Common Law)。

根据 UCC § 2-206，对于要求立即发货的要约，卖方可以通过以下两种方式接受：

  • 实际发货 (Shipping the goods)
  • 承诺发货 (Promising to ship)

因此，供应商寄信承诺发货是有效的接受方式（排除选项 B）。

2. 邮箱规则 (The Mailbox Rule)

这是本题的决胜点。规则如下：

  • 接受 (Acceptance)：通常在寄出 (Dispatch) 时生效（只要地址正确且贴足邮资）。
  • 撤销 (Revocation)：通常在受要约人收到 (Receipt) 时生效。

在本案中，供应商在 11月9日 寄出信件时，接受已经生效，合同已经锁死 (Formed)。买方在 11月10日 的撤销电话为时已晚，因为你不能撤销一个已经存在的合同。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (撤销有效)： 错误。撤销必须在接受生效之前送达。这里接受生效在前（9日），撤销在后（10日）。

❌ 选项 B (必须发货)： 错误。UCC 允许通过“承诺发货”来接受要约，不强制要求必须实际发货才能成立合同。

❌ 选项 C (不可撤销要约)： 错误。虽然结果是“有合同”，但理由错误。买方的要约并非“确定要约” (Firm Offer, UCC § 2-205)，因为没有书面保证在特定时间内不撤销。如果买方在9日寄信之前打电话，撤销就是有效的。

questions.question:
A private high school was in the market for new desks and chairs for its classrooms. It had inquired into the cost of acquiring 1,000 new desks and chairs from a particular vendor. On June 15, the vendor sent a signed letter to the private high school offering to sell it 1,000 desks and chairs for $30,000. The letter stated that the offer was guaranteed through June 25 but that the private high school's acceptance would be effective only if the vendor actually received it by that date. On June 23, the private high school mailed its signed, written acceptance of the vendor's offer. On June 24, the vendor, after concluding that the price it originally requested was too low, directly notified the private high school that it was revoking its offer. The vendor received the private high school's acceptance on June 26.
Was an enforceable contract between the private high school and the vendor formed?

choices.a: No, because the vendor did not actually receive the acceptance until June 26.
choices.b: No, because the vendor revoked the offer on June 24.
choices.c: Yes, because the private high school mailed its acceptance on June 23.
choices.d: Yes, because under the UCC firm-offer rule, the vendor's offer was irrevocable.

Q81095

A private high school was in the market for new desks and chairs for its classrooms. It had inquired into the cost of acquiring 1,000 new desks and chairs from a particular vendor. On June 15, the vendor sent a signed letter to the private high school offering to sell 1,000 desks and chairs for $30,000. The letter stated that an acceptance of the offer by the private high school would be effective so long as it was received by June 25. On June 23, the private high school mailed its signed, written acceptance of the vendor's offer. On June 24, the vendor, after concluding that the price it originally requested was too low, directly notified the private high school that it was revoking its offer. The vendor received the private high school's acceptance on June 26.

Was an enforceable contract between the private high school and the vendor formed?

一所私立高中正在为其教室寻求购买新的书桌和椅子。它向一家特定供应商询问了采购1000套新书桌和椅子的成本。6月15日，该供应商向该私立高中发出一封签署的信函，要约以30,000美元的价格出售1000套书桌和椅子。信中声明，私立高中对该要约的承诺，只要在6月25日之前被收到即为有效。6月23日，该私立高中邮寄了其签署的对供应商要约的书面承诺。6月24日，供应商在认定其最初要求的价格过低之后，直接通知私立高中其正在撤销其要约。供应商于6月26日收到了私立高中的承诺。

该私立高中与供应商之间是否成立了可强制执行的合同？
options:
A. No, because the private high school's acceptance was received on June 26.
否，因为私立高中的承诺于6月26日才被收到。

B. No, because the vendor revoked the offer on June 24.
否，因为供应商于6月24日撤销了要约。

C. Yes, because the private high school mailed its acceptance on June 23.
是，因为私立高中于6月23日邮寄了其承诺。

D. Yes, because the vendor's offer was irrevocable.
是，因为供应商的要约是不可撤销的。

Contract negotiations by mail


Offeror's actionsOfferee's actions
Offer
Effective upon receipt
Revocation of offer
Effective upon receipt
Acceptance (mailbox rule)
Effective upon dispatch
Exceptions - effective upon receipt if:
  • improperly stamped/addressed
  • acceptance by mail unreasonable
  • rejection mailed before acceptance (first received is effective)
  • acceptance of option contract
Rejection/counteroffer
Effective upon receipt
†Applicable under common law & UCC

Once an offer has been made, a binding contract will be formed if the offeree accepts the offer before it terminates (eg, before the allotted response time expires). Under the mailbox rule, acceptance by mail is:

  • permitted if mail is a reasonable method of communicating acceptance - eg, because the offer was communicated by mail - and

  • effective upon dispatch - ie, when the acceptance is properly addressed and placed with the postal service with paid postage.


However, the default mailbox rule does not apply if it is inconsistent with the offer's terms, such as when the offer states that acceptance is effective only upon receipt.†

Here, the vendor's offer stated that an acceptance would be effective only if it was received by June 25. Therefore, the mailbox rule does not apply. And since the private high school's acceptance was received on June 26, after the allotted time for acceptance had expired, it was ineffective. As a result, no contract was formed.

†The reason is that the offeror, as master of the offer, can dictate the manner and means by which the offer may be accepted.

(Choices B & D) Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, desks, chairs) are governed by the UCC. Under the UCC firm-offer rule, a merchant's written and signed assurance that an offer will remain open is irrevocable for the time stated in the offer. Therefore, the vendor's offer was irrevocable through June 25, and the vendor could not revoke it on June 24. Nevertheless, there is no contract because the high school's acceptance was not received in time.

(Choice C) Although the private high school mailed its acceptance on June 23, the vendor's offer stated that acceptance would be effective when received - not upon dispatch.

Educational objective: The default mailbox rule does not apply if it is inconsistent with the offer's terms, such as when the offer states that acceptance is effective only upon receipt.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

通过邮件进行的合同谈判


要约人的行为受要约人的行为
要约
收到时生效
要约的撤销
收到时生效
承诺（邮箱规则）
发出时生效
例外情况 - 在以下情况下，收到时生效：
  • 邮票粘贴不当/地址错误
  • 通过邮件承诺不合理
  • 拒绝先于承诺邮寄（先收到者为准）
  • 对选择权合同的承诺
拒绝/反要约
收到时生效
†适用于普通法和UCC

一旦要约作出，如果受要约人在要约终止前（例如，在指定的答复时间到期前）承诺该要约，则有约束力的合同即告成立。根据邮箱规则（mailbox rule），通过邮件作出的承诺：

  • 如果邮件是传达承诺的合理方式——例如，因为要约是通过邮件传达的——则是允许的，并且

  • 一经发出即生效——即，当承诺被正确填写地址、付清邮资并交由邮政服务投递时。


然而，如果默认的邮箱规则与要约的条款不一致，例如当要约声明承诺仅在收到时方为有效时，则该规则不适用。†

在本案中，供应商的要约声明，承诺必须在6月25日之前被收到才有效。因此，邮箱规则不适用。并且，由于私立高中的承诺是在6月26日收到的，即在指定的承诺时间到期之后，因此该承诺是无效的。结果，没有合同成立。

†其原因是，要约人作为“要约的主人”（master of the offer），可以规定承诺要约的方式和方法。

（选项B和D）货物（例如，书桌、椅子）买卖合同受UCC管辖。根据UCC的“商家固定要约规则”（firm-offer rule），商家以书面形式签署的、保证要约在规定时间内保持开放的承诺，在该规定时间内是不可撤销的。因此，供应商的要约在6月25日之前是不可撤销的，供应商不能在6月24日撤销它。尽管如此，合同并未成立，因为高中的承诺没有及时被收到。

（选项C）尽管私立高中于6月23日邮寄了其承诺，但供应商的要约声明承诺在收到时生效——而非发出时生效。

教学目标：如果默认的邮箱规则与要约的条款不一致，例如当要约声明承诺仅在收到时方为有效时，则该规则不适用。

UCC = 《统一商法典》（Uniform Commercial Code）

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：合同的成立

本题考查的是合同法中关于承诺生效时间的核心规则，特别是当“邮箱规则”与“要约条款”发生冲突时的处理方式，同时涉及UCC下的“固定要约”概念。

核心法律原则

要约的主人 (Master of the Offer)
虽然通常适用“邮箱规则”（Mailbox Rule，即承诺发出时生效），但要约人（Offeror）有权规定承诺的具体方式和时间。如果要约明确规定承诺必须在收到时才生效，那么该条款凌驾于邮箱规则之上。

案情时间线分析

6月15日 - 要约发出
供应商发出要约，包含关键条款：
"Acceptance... effective so long as it was received by June 25"
（承诺必须在6月25日前收到才有效）。
6月23日 - 承诺寄出
学校寄出承诺信。如果适用普通邮箱规则，合同此时成立。但本案不适用。
6月24日 - 试图撤销
供应商试图撤销要约。
注意：根据UCC固定要约规则，此撤销无效，但这对最终结果无影响。
6月25日 - 截止日期
这是要约规定的最后期限。此时供应商仍未收到承诺。要约失效 (Lapsed)。
6月26日 - 承诺收到
供应商收到信件。但为时已晚，要约已过期。

正确答案解析

正确答案：A

"No, because the private high school's acceptance was received on June 26."

法律依据：要约人明确规定了“承诺必须在6月25日前收到”。这一条款排除了默认的邮箱规则（Mailbox Rule）。

推理逻辑：

  • 虽然学校在截止日期前寄出了信件，但要约的条款控制了合同成立的条件。
  • 因为承诺信在6月26日才送达，晚于规定的6月25日，所以承诺无效。
  • 没有有效的承诺，就没有合同。

干扰项陷阱分析

选项 B 错误 (关于撤销)：
虽然供应商试图在6月24日撤销要约，但这是无效的。根据 UCC Firm Offer Rule (商家固定要约规则)，商家签署的书面要约在规定时间内（此处为6月25日）是不可撤销的 (Irrevocable)。所以，合同未成立的原因不是因为撤销，而是因为承诺超时。

选项 C 错误 (关于邮箱规则)：
此选项试图诱导考生应用默认的 Mailbox Rule（发出即生效）。考生必须记住：要约的具体条款 > 默认法律规则。当要约说“收到才有效”时，邮箱规则自动失效。

选项 D 错误 (关于不可撤销性)：
要约确实是不可撤销的（直到6月25日），但这并不意味着合同自动成立。受要约人（学校）仍然必须在要约开放期间内，按照要约规定的方式完成承诺。他们失败了（晚了一天收到），所以即便要约不可撤销，合同依然未能成立。

MBE 考试技巧

遇到涉及邮件承诺的题目时，第一步永远是检查要约内容中是否有"Effective upon receipt" (收到时生效) 的字样。如果有，直接划掉脑海中的“邮箱规则”，严格按照收到日期判断。

questions.question:
A buyer sent a signed letter to a seller that stated: "Ship 100 boxes of nails at $3 per box, the price quoted in your circular." The seller mailed the buyer a signed form acknowledgment that agreed to the buyer's terms and stated on the reverse side: "Disputes regarding quality shall be arbitrated." The buyer did not reply to the seller's acknowledgment, and the seller shipped the nails. When the buyer received the nails, he found their quality to be unsatisfactory and sued the seller for breach of warranty. The seller has asked an attorney whether the parties' contract requires arbitration of the buyer's claim.
What is the best advice the attorney can provide?

choices.a: A contract was formed pursuant to conduct when the buyer received the nails, and a court would exclude the arbitration provision from the contract.
choices.b: A contract was formed when the seller mailed its acknowledgment, and the arbitration term became part of the contract.
choices.c: A contract was formed when the seller mailed its acknowledgment, and the court must decide whether the arbitration term should be excluded as a material alteration of the contract.
choices.d: No contract exists, because the arbitration term in the seller's acknowledgment created a counteroffer that the buyer never accepted.

Q81813 A buyer sent a signed letter to a seller that stated: "Ship 100 boxes of nails at $3 per box, the price quoted in your circular." The seller mailed the buyer a signed form acknowledgment that agreed to the buyer's terms and stated on the reverse side: "Disputes regarding quality shall be arbitrated." The buyer did not reply to the seller's acknowledgment, and the seller shipped the nails. When the buyer received the nails, he found their quality to be unsatisfactory and sued the seller for breach of warranty. The seller has asked an attorney whether the parties' contract requires arbitration of the buyer's claim.

What is the best advice the attorney can provide? 一位买方向一位卖方寄发了一封经签署的信函，信中写道：“请发运100箱钉子，每箱3美元，此价格为贵方宣传册中的报价。”卖方给买方邮寄了一份经签署的格式确认函，同意了买方的条款，并在背面声明：“有关质量的争议应通过仲裁解决。”买方未回复卖方的确认函，卖方遂发运了钉子。当买方收到钉子时，发现其质量不尽人意，遂以违反担保为由起诉卖方。卖方已咨询律师，双方的合同是否要求通过仲裁解决买方的主张。

律师能提供的最佳建议是什么？
options:
A. A contract was formed pursuant to conduct when the buyer received the nails, and a court would exclude the arbitration provision from the contract.
合同在买方收到钉子时因行为而成立，法院会将仲裁条款从合同中排除。

B. A contract was formed when the seller mailed its acknowledgment, and the arbitration term became part of the contract.
合同在卖方邮寄其确认函时成立，且仲裁条款成为合同的一部分。

C. A contract was formed when the seller mailed its acknowledgment, and the court must decide whether the arbitration term should be excluded as a material alteration of the contract.
合同在卖方邮寄其确认函时成立，法院必须决定是否应因仲裁条款构成对合同的重大变更而将其排除。

D. No contract exists, because the arbitration term in the seller's acknowledgment created a counteroffer that the buyer never accepted.
合同不存在，因为卖方确认函中的仲裁条款构成了一项反要约，而买方从未接受该反要约。

new terms materially alter contract or
offeror objects within reasonable time
Revised terms follow split authority & are either:
treated as new terms or
cancelled out under knockout rule
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

The UCC, which governs contracts for the sale of goods, uses the battle-of-the-forms rule for contract formation. Under this rule, an acceptance of an offer is effective even if the acceptance contains new terms. If both parties are merchants, the new terms become part of the contract unless:
  • the offer expressly requires the offeror's assent to new terms
  • the offeror objects within a reasonable time or
  • the new terms materially alter the contract.
Here, the buyer ordered 100 boxes of nails at $3 per box (offer). The seller mailed an acknowledgment agreeing to the buyer's terms (acceptance), which was effective upon dispatch. And although that acknowledgment contained a new arbitration term, the buyer's offer did not expressly require assent to new terms, and the buyer did not object to the new term. Therefore, since both parties are likely merchants, the court must decide whether the arbitration term should be excluded as a material alteration of the contract.

(Choice A) Had the seller shipped the nails prior to mailing the acknowledgment, his conduct would have created a contract when the nails were shipped (not received). Here, a contract was created pursuant to the seller's mailed acknowledgment—not his conduct in shipping the nails.

(Choice B) Jurisdictions are split on whether the addition of an arbitration term materially alters a contract, so the court would need to decide this issue to determine whether the arbitration term became part of the contract.

(Choice D) Under the common law mirror image rule, the seller's acknowledgment containing a new term would constitute a counteroffer. However, the UCC follows the battle-of-the-forms rule instead.

Educational objective: Under the battle-of-the-forms rule, an acceptance is effective even when it contains new terms. If both parties are merchants, the new terms become part of the contract unless (1) the offer expressly required the offeror's assent to new terms, (2) the offeror objected within a reasonable time, or (3) the new terms materially alter the contract.

对要约答复中新增条款的效力


普通法
（镜像规则）		要约被拒绝
答复被视为反要约
UCC
（格式之争）		≥1方为非商人要约被接受，除非答复明确要求同意新增/修订的条款
新增/修订的条款被视为对合同的拟议补充
所有当事人均为商人要约被接受，除非答复明确要求同意新增/修订的条款
新增条款成为合同的一部分，除非：
要约明确要求同意新增条款
新增条款对合同构成重大变更或
要约人在合理时间内提出反对
修订条款遵循不同权威意见，其结果为：
被视为新增条款或
根据剔除规则被取消
UCC = 《统一商法典》。

《统一商法典》（UCC）管辖货物销售合同，其在合同成立方面采用格式之争规则。根据此规则，对要约的承诺即使包含新增条款也属有效。如果双方均为商人，新增条款将成为合同的一部分，除非：
  • 要约明确要求要约人同意新增条款
  • 要约人在合理时间内提出反对或
  • 新增条款对合同构成重大变更。
在本案中，买方订购了100箱钉子，每箱3美元（要约）。卖方邮寄了一份确认函，同意了买方的条款（承诺），该承诺自发出时生效。尽管该确认函包含一项新的仲裁条款，但买方的要约并未明确要求同意新增条款，且买方也未对该新增条款提出反对。因此，由于双方很可能都是商人，法院必须决定是否应因仲裁条款构成对合同的重大变更而将其排除。

（选项A）如果卖方在邮寄确认函之前发运了钉子，其行为将在钉子发运时（而非收到时）成立合同。在本案中，合同是根据卖方邮寄的确认函成立的，而非其发运钉子的行为。

（选项B）关于增加仲裁条款是否构成对合同的重大变更，各司法管辖区的意见不一，因此法院需要就此问题作出裁决，以确定仲裁条款是否成为合同的一部分。

（选项D）根据普通法的镜像规则，卖方包含新增条款的确认函将构成反要约。然而，《统一商法典》遵循的是格式之争规则。

教学目的： 根据格式之争规则，承诺即使包含新增条款也属有效。如果双方均为商人，新增条款将成为合同的一部分，除非（1）要约明确要求要约人同意新增条款，（2）要约人在合理时间内提出反对，或（3）新增条款对合同构成重大变更。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

U.C.C. § 2-207 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2019) (battle-of-the-forms rule).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: UCC Battle of the Forms

UCC § 2-207

本题考察的是合同法中经典的“格式之争” (Battle of the Forms)。这是MBE考试中关于货物销售合同（Sale of Goods）的高频考点。

核心法律规则：UCC § 2-207 在《统一商法典》(UCC) 下，承诺中包含的新增条款 (Additional Terms) 不会自动导致拒绝要约（这与普通法的“镜像规则”不同）。

如果双方都是商人 (Merchants)，新增条款会自动成为合同的一部分，除非：
  1. 要约明确限制了对条款的接受；
  2. 新增条款对合同构成了重大变更 (Material Alteration)；
  3. 要约人已提出异议或在合理时间内提出异议。

📝 案例逻辑分析

1 适用法律：
题目涉及“100箱钉子”的买卖，属于货物销售，因此适用 UCC (Article 2)，而非普通法。
2 合同是否成立？
买方发出要约 (Offer)，卖方寄回确认函 (Acknowledgment) 表示同意。根据 UCC § 2-207(1)，这构成有效的承诺 (Acceptance)。
关键点：合同在卖方邮寄确认函时即已成立（适用投递规则 Mailbox Rule），而不是等到发货或收货时。
3 仲裁条款的命运：
卖方在确认函中增加了“仲裁条款”。由于双方都是商人（买方引用“宣传册”，卖方销售大量钉子，通常推定为商人），我们需要判断该条款是否进入合同。
买方没有明确反对，要约也没有限制条款。因此，唯一能阻止该条款进入合同的理由是：它是否构成了“重大变更” (Material Alteration)？
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

理由：合同在卖方邮寄确认函时成立。至于仲裁条款是否有效，取决于法院判定该条款是否构成“重大变更”。

在法律实践中，关于仲裁条款是否构成重大变更，不同法院有不同判例（Split Authority）。因此，律师最严谨的建议是：法院必须裁决这一点。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 A (错误)： 认为合同因“行为” (Conduct) 成立。这是错误的，因为卖方的书面确认函已经构成了有效的书面承诺，合同在书面往来阶段已经锁死，无需等到发货行为。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 过于绝对。仲裁条款不会自动成为合同一部分，必须先通过“非重大变更”的测试。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 这是普通法 (Common Law) 的“镜像规则” (Mirror Image Rule) 逻辑。在 UCC 下，包含新条款的承诺通常不是反要约 (Counteroffer)，除非卖方明确声明“除非你同意新条款，否则我不卖”。
考试技巧： 看到 "Acknowledgment" 和 "New Terms"，立即定位 UCC § 2-207。如果是商人之间，问自己：这是重大变更吗？

questions.question:
A chef purchased the front portion of the land needed for a restaurant he desired to build and operate, but the back portion was the subject of a will dispute between a brother and sister. The sister's attorney advised her that her claim was doubtful. The chef, knowing only that the unresolved dispute existed, agreed in a signed writing to pay the sister $6,000, payable $1,000 annually, in exchange for a quitclaim deed (a deed containing no warranties). The sister promptly executed such a deed to the chef and received his first annual payment. Shortly thereafter, the probate court handed down a decision in the brother's favor, ruling that the sister had no interest in the land. This decision has become final. The chef subsequently defaulted when his second annual installment came due.
In an action against the chef for breach of contract, will the sister probably win or lose?

choices.a: Lose, because she suffered no legal detriment in executing the quitclaim deed.
choices.b: Lose, because she was aware at the time of the agreement with the chef that her claim to the property quitclaimed was doubtful.
choices.c: Win, because the chef bargained for and received in exchange a quitclaim deed from the sister.
choices.d: Win, because the chef, by paying the first $1,000 installment, is estopped to deny that his agreement with the sister is an enforceable contract.

In an action against the chef for breach of contract, will the sister probably win or lose?

一位厨师购买了他想建造和经营的餐厅所需土地的前半部分，但后半部分土地正处于一对兄妹之间的遗嘱纠纷中。妹妹的律师告知她，她的主张胜算不大。厨师只知道存在未解决的纠纷，他同意在一份签署的书面文件中向妹妹支付6000美元，每年支付1000美元，以换取一份免责地契（一种不含任何担保的契据）。妹妹立即向厨师签发了该地契，并收到了他的第一笔年度付款。此后不久，遗嘱检验法庭作出了有利于哥哥的裁决，裁定妹妹在该土地上没有任何权益。该裁决已成为终审裁决。随后，当第二笔年度分期付款到期时，厨师违约了。

在对厨师提起的违约诉讼中，妹妹可能会赢还是会输？
options:
A. Lose, because she suffered no legal detriment in executing the quitclaim deed.
败诉，因为她在签发免责地契时没有遭受任何法律上的不利益。

B. Lose, because she was aware at the time of the agreement with the chef that her claim to the property quitclaimed was doubtful.
败诉，因为在与厨师达成协议时，她意识到她所放弃主张的财产权利是胜算不大的。

C. Win, because the chef bargained for and received in exchange a quitclaim deed from the sister.
胜诉，因为厨师协商换取并收到了妹妹的免责地契作为交换。

D. Win, because the chef, by paying the first $1,000 installment, is estopped to deny that his agreement with the sister is an enforceable contract.
胜诉，因为厨师支付了第一笔1000美元的分期付款，根据禁止反言原则，他不能否认他与妹妹的协议是可强制执行的合同。
data.explanation:
Elements of valuable consideration


Bargained-for exchangeEach party's willingness to enter agreement must be induced by other party's act/promise
Legal detrimentEach party must relinquish legal right by either: performing (or promising to perform) act that is not legally required or refraining (or promising to refrain) from performing legally permissible act
A valid contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration - ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. A promise to surrender a claim or defense constitutes consideration so long as: the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good faith dispute or the surrendering party honestly believes that the claim or defense may be valid.

Issuing a quitclaim deed - ie, a deed that conveys whatever interest the grantor has in the property, if any, without any warranties - amounts to surrendering the grantor's claims against the property. A quitclaim deed can therefore serve as consideration if the foregoing requirements are met.

Here, the chef promised to pay the sister $6,000, payable in $1,000 installments, in exchange for a quitclaim deed. Although the sister's claim to the property quitclaimed was doubtful, it was subject to an unresolved will dispute (good faith dispute) (Choice B). As a result, the sister's issuance of the quitclaim deed in exchange for the chef's promise of payment constituted bargained-for consideration. A valid contract was therefore formed, and the sister will probably win.

(Choice A) Surrendering a claim or defense that may be valid (eg, the sister's issuing the quitclaim deed to the chef) does constitute a legal detriment.

(Choice D) The doctrine of promissory estoppel lets a party enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. A valid contract arose between the parties here, so estoppel does not apply.

Educational objective: A promise to surrender a claim or defense (eg, by issuing a quitclaim deed) can serve as consideration so long as (1) the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good faith dispute or (2) the surrendering party honestly believes it may be valid.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 36%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

有效对价的要素


协商换取各方签订协议的意愿必须由另一方的行为或承诺所引致
法律上的不利益各方必须通过以下任一方式放弃法律权利：履行（或承诺履行）法律上不要求的行为，或克制（或承诺克制）不去从事法律上允许的行为
当一项双方合意得到有效对价——即，经协商换取的承诺或履行——的支持时，一份有效合同通常即告成立。放弃一项主张或抗辩的承诺构成对价，只要：该主张或抗辩是有效的或处于一场善意纠纷之中，或放弃方真诚地相信该主张或抗辩可能是有效的。

签发一份免责地契——即，一份转让授予人在该财产中拥有的任何权益（若有）且不附带任何担保的契据——等同于放弃授予人对该财产的主张。因此，如果满足上述要求，免责地契可以作为对价。

在本案中，厨师承诺向妹妹支付6000美元，以分期付款1000美元的方式，来换取一份免责地契。尽管妹妹对所放弃主张的财产的权利胜算不大，但该权利正处于一场未解决的遗嘱纠纷（善意纠纷）中（选项B）。因此，妹妹签发免责地契以换取厨师的付款承诺，构成了经协商换取的对价。于是，一份有效的合同成立了，妹妹可能会胜诉。

（选项A）放弃一项可能有效的主张或抗辩（例如，妹妹向厨师签发免责地契）确实构成了法律上的不利益。

（选项D）允诺禁反言原则允许一方在没有成立有效合同的情况下，强制执行其已合理且有损害性地依赖的承诺。在本案中，双方之间已产生了一份有效合同，因此禁止反言原则不适用。

教学目标：放弃一项主张或抗辩的承诺（例如，通过签发免责地契）可以作为对价，只要（1）该主张或抗辩是有效的或处于善意纠纷之中，或（2）放弃方真诚地相信其可能是有效的。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (settlement of claims as consideration).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Consideration & Quitclaim Deeds

核心考点：对价 (Consideration)

本题考察的是合同法中关于对价的两个关键概念：

  • 经协商的交换 (Bargained-for Exchange)：双方必须相互承诺或履行，以换取对方的承诺或履行。
  • 放弃法律主张 (Forbearance to Assert a Claim)：放弃一项法律权利或主张（即使该主张最终被证明无效）可以构成有效的对价。
案情关键点分析

厨师 (Chef) 的意图：
他想买地建餐厅，但土地有产权纠纷。他需要清除产权上的“云翳”(Cloud on Title)。

交易标的：
Quitclaim Deed（免责地契）。这种地契的特点是：卖方不保证自己拥有产权，只是把“自己可能拥有的任何权益”转让给买方。

妹妹 (Sister) 的处境：
她的主张虽然“胜算不大”(Doubtful)，但当时纠纷尚未解决 (Unresolved)。

✅ 正确答案：C

胜诉，因为厨师协商换取并收到了妹妹的免责地契作为交换。

法律推理：

  1. 对价的存在： 厨师承诺付款，是为了换取妹妹签署 Quitclaim Deed。妹妹签署了地契，这就是她付出的“法律上的不利益”(Legal Detriment)。
  2. 免责地契的性质： 厨师买的不是“完美的产权”，而是“妹妹放弃对该土地的主张”。即使后来法院判决妹妹没有任何权益，但在签约时，她放弃了“继续争夺产权”的权利，这对厨师来说是有价值的（避免诉讼干扰、推进项目）。
  3. 善意纠纷： 只要放弃的主张是基于善意 (Good Faith) 且具有不确定性 (Doubtful)，放弃该主张就构成有效对价。妹妹虽然知道胜算不大，但并没有恶意欺诈，纠纷在当时是客观存在的。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A (无不利益)： 错误。放弃提起诉讼或主张权利的权利（Forbearance）本身就是一种法律上的不利益 (Legal Detriment)。
  • 选项 B (胜算不大)： 错误。根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74，只要主张在事实或法律上存在不确定性，或者当事人真诚相信其有效，放弃该主张就是有效对价。胜算小不代表没有对价。
  • 选项 D (禁止反言)： 错误。禁止反言 (Promissory Estoppel) 是一种在没有有效合同时的补救措施。本案中双方存在明确的“要约-承诺-对价”，已经形成了有效合同，因此不需要援引禁止反言原则。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

1. 区分 Deed 类型：

  • Warranty Deed (担保地契)： 卖方保证自己有产权。如果后来发现没产权，买方可以告违约。
  • Quitclaim Deed (免责地契)： 卖方说“我有啥给你啥，没啥也不赔”。如果后来发现没产权，买方不能仅因无产权而告违约，因为他买的就是这种风险。

2. 识别“对价”的门槛：

法院通常不审查对价的“充分性”(Adequacy)。只要是双方协商交换的 (Bargained-for)，哪怕是一粒胡椒 (Peppercorn) 换一座城堡，合同也是有效的。

questions.question:
A woman encountered her coworker and the coworker's friend at a local coffee shop. The woman, who knew that the coworker needed a new laptop for his personal use, had planned to offer her extra laptop to the coworker. The woman went to the counter to place her coffee order and, with her back to the table where the coworker and his friend sat, said, "By the way, I know you are looking for a new laptop. I will sell you my laptop for $100." The friend immediately replied, "I accept your offer!"
Has a contract been formed between the friend and the woman?

choices.a: No, because the friend was mistaken as to the terms of the contract.
choices.b: No, because the friend was not the party with whom the woman intended to contract.
choices.c: Yes, because the friend reasonably believed that he had the power to accept the woman's offer.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman's objective intent was to contract with whoever overheard the offer.

一名女子在当地一家咖啡店遇到了她的同事和同事的朋友。该女子知道其同事因个人使用需要一台新笔记本电脑，所以她计划将自己多余的笔记本电脑要约出售给该同事。该女子走到柜台点咖啡时，背对着同事和其朋友坐的桌子说：“顺便说一下，我知道你在找一台新笔记本电脑。我把我的笔记本电脑以100美元的价格卖给你。”那位朋友立即回答：“我接受你的要约！”

请问，该朋友和女子之间是否已成立合同？
options:
A. No, because the coworker, as the intended party, can choose to exercise his right of first refusal.
否，因为同事作为预期的相对方，可以选择行使其优先购买权(right of first refusal)。

B. No, because the friend was not the party with whom the woman intended to contract.
否，因为该朋友并非女子意图订立合同的相对方。

C. Yes, because the friend reasonably believed that he had the power to accept the woman's offer.
是，因为该朋友合理地认为他有权接受该女子的要约。

D. Yes, because the woman's objective intent was to contract with whoever overheard the offer.
是，因为该女子的客观意图是与任何听到该要约的人订立合同。
data.explanation:
The offeror is master of the offer. This means, among other things, that the power to accept an offer belongs only to the person (or class of persons) with whom the offeror intended to contract. In contract law, intent is measured by an objective standard, not by the subjective intent or belief of a party. Therefore, whether the offeror intended to contract with someone is judged by outward objective facts, as they would be interpreted by a reasonable person.

Here, the woman knew that her coworker needed a new laptop. Her statement - "I know you are looking for a new laptop" - demonstrated her objective intent to contract with the coworker (Choice D). Although the friend overheard the woman's offer to sell her laptop, he could not reasonably believe that he had the power to accept it. This is especially true since there is no indication that the two had ever met (Choice C). Therefore, no contract was formed because the friend was not the party with whom the woman intended to contract.

(Choice A) A right of first refusal is a contractual right that gives a party the option to purchase something before it is offered for sale to others. Here, the coworker did not contract with the woman for such a right. And even if he had, the coworker would not need to exercise this right since the woman was not offering the laptop to the friend.

Educational objective: The power of acceptance belongs only to the person(s) with whom the offeror intended to contract. Such intent is judged by outward objective facts, as interpreted by a reasonable person.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

要约人是要约的主人。这意味着，除其他事项外，一项要约的接受权(power to accept)仅属于要约人意图与之订立合同的个人（或某一类人）。在合同法中，意图是按客观标准来衡量的，而非根据一方的主观意图或想法。因此，要约人是否意图与某人订立合同，应根据一个理性人会如何解释的外部客观事实来判断。

在本案中，该女子知道她的同事需要一台新笔记本电脑。她的陈述——“我知道你在找一台新笔记本电脑”——表明了她与同事订立合同的客观意图（选项D）。尽管该朋友无意中听到了女子出售笔记本电脑的要约，但他不能合理地认为自己有权接受该要约。尤其是没有任何迹象表明他们二人曾经见过面（选项C）。因此，合同并未成立，因为该朋友并非女子意图与之订立合同的相对方。

（选项A） 优先购买权(A right of first refusal)是一项合同权利，它赋予一方在某物品向他人要约出售之前，选择购买该物品的权利。在本案中，同事并未与该女子就此权利订立合同。而且，即使他拥有此权利，同事也无需行使，因为该女子并未向那位朋友要约出售笔记本电脑。

教学目的：接受权仅属于要约人意图与之订立合同的个人。此等意图应根据一个理性人所解释的外部客观事实来判断。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 29 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (to whom an offer is addressed).
