MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Formation
正确答案：B

本题考察的核心法律原则是：要约的相对人 (The Offeree) 与 承诺权 (Power of Acceptance) 的归属。

⚖️ 法律原则 (Legal Rule) "The Offeror is the Master of the Offer."
要约人是要约的主人。这意味着，只有要约人意图与之订立合同的人（或群体），才拥有接受该要约的权力 (Power of Acceptance)。

📝 案情分析

1
客观意图标准 (Objective Standard)：
合同法判断意图不看内心想法，而是看理性人 (Reasonable Person) 如何解读外部事实。
2
特定语境 (Context)：
女子说：“我知道你在找新电脑...我把电脑卖给你。”
虽然朋友也在场，但这句话的前半部分明确指向了有特定需求（需要电脑）的同事。
3
结论：
在理性的旁观者看来，这个要约是专门发给同事的。朋友只是一个旁听者 (Bystander) 或无意听到的人，因此没有承诺权。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (Right of First Refusal)：
错误。优先购买权需要预先存在的合同约定。本案中没有证据表明同事拥有此权利，且即使有，也不影响朋友是否有权承诺的问题。
选项 C (Reasonable Belief)：
错误。朋友不能“合理地”认为要约是发给他的。因为女子明确提到了“我知道你在找电脑”，这个描述只符合同事的情况，不符合朋友的情况。
选项 D (Public Offer)：
错误。这并非像广告那样的“向公众发出的要约” (Offer to the Public)。这是一个针对特定个人的私下对话。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 题目中，注意代词 "You" 的指向性。如果要约是基于接收者的特定特征（如“我知道你需要...”）发出的，旁听者通常无权接受。

questions.question:
An ice hockey goalie received word that his favorite team's only backup goaltender had been injured in an accident and would likely be unable to play during the upcoming season. The goalie sent a letter to the team's general manager on September 18 offering to play for the team for an annual salary of $450,000. The general manager received the offer letter on September 21 and, in desperation, immediately mailed the goalie a letter accepting the offer on behalf of the team.
On September 22, the team's injured goaltender made a miraculous recovery and the general manager sent the goalie a second letter rejecting the goalie's offer. The goalie received the general manager's rejection on September 25 and received the general manager's acceptance the following day.
Was a contract formed between the goalie and the ice hockey team?

choices.a: No, because the goalie received the general manager's rejection before the acceptance.
choices.b: No, because there was no meeting of the minds between the goalie and the general manager.
choices.c: Yes, because the team assumed the risk that the backup goaltender would recover from his injury.
choices.d: Yes, because the team effectively accepted the goalie's offer prior to the attempted rejection.

data.questionStem:
Q81126

An ice hockey goalie received word that his favorite team's only backup goaltender had been injured in an accident and would likely be unable to play during the upcoming season. The goalie sent a letter to the team's general manager on September 18 offering to play for the team for an annual salary of $450,000. The general manager received the offer letter on September 21 and, in desperation, immediately mailed the goalie a letter accepting the offer on behalf of the team.

On September 22, the team's injured goaltender made a miraculous recovery and the general manager sent the goalie a second letter rejecting the goalie's offer. The goalie received the general manager's rejection on September 25 and received the general manager's acceptance the following day.

Was a contract formed between the goalie and the ice hockey team?

一名冰球守门员得知，他最喜欢的球队中唯一的替补守门员在一场事故中受伤，很可能无法参加即将到来的赛季。该守门员于9月18日致信球队总经理，发出要约，愿以45万美元的年薪为球队效力。总经理于9月21日收到该要约信，并在情急之下，立即代表球队向该守门员邮寄了一封承诺该要约的信函。

9月22日，球队受伤的守门员奇迹般地康复了，总经理又向该守门员发出了第二封信，拒绝了其要约。该守门员于9月25日收到了总经理的拒绝信，并于次日收到了总经理的承诺信。

该守门员与该冰球队之间是否成立了合同？
options:
A. No, because the goalie received the general manager's rejection before the acceptance.
否，因为该守门员在收到承诺信之前先收到了拒绝信。

B. No, because there was no meeting of the minds between the goalie and the general manager.
否，因为该守门员和总经理之间没有达成合意。

C. Yes, because the team assumed the risk that the backup goaltender would recover from his injury.
是，因为球队承担了替补守门员可能从伤病中恢复的风险。

D. Yes, because the team effectively accepted the goalie's offer prior to the attempted rejection.
是，因为球队在试图作出拒绝之前，已经有效地承诺了该守门员的要约。
data.explanation:
Contract formation requires both an offer and an acceptance (ie, mutual assent). Under the mailbox rule, an acceptance by mail is generally effective upon dispatch, while a rejection is effective only upon receipt. If the offeree has a change of heart and sends:

  • An acceptance followed by a rejection - a contract is formed upon dispatch of the acceptance, regardless of which communication is received first
  • A rejection followed by an acceptance - a contract is formed if the acceptance is received first; in contrast, no contract is formed if the rejection is received first†


Here, the general manager sent a letter accepting the goalie's offer followed by a second letter rejecting the offer. Because the acceptance was sent first, a contract was formed upon dispatch of the acceptance. This is true even though the goalie received the general manager's rejection before the acceptance (Choice A). Therefore, an enforceable contract exists between the goalie and the ice hockey team because the team effectively accepted the goalie's offer prior to the attempted rejection.

†However, the offeree may be estopped from enforcing the contract if the offeror received the rejection first and detrimentally relied upon it.

(Choice B) "Meeting of the minds" refers to the parties' mutual assent to form a contract based on agreed-upon terms. Here, there was a meeting of the minds because the goalie offered to play for the team for $450,000 and the general manager accepted the terms of that offer.

(Choice C) The fact that the team assumed the risk of the injured goaltender's recovery would prevent the team from asserting certain defenses to enforcement of a contract (eg, impracticability). But here, the question is whether the parties formed a contract.

Educational objective: Where an offeree mails an acceptance and later mails a rejection, a contract is formed upon dispatch of the acceptance - regardless of which communication is received first.



选项正确率统计：A选项 32%，B选项 1%，C选项 0%，D选项 65%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同的成立需要要约和承诺（即双方合意）。根据邮箱规则 (mailbox rule)，通过邮件发出的承诺通常在发出时生效，而拒绝则仅在收到时生效。如果受要约人改变主意并发出：

  • 先发出承诺，再发出拒绝 - 合同于承诺发出时成立，无论哪一份函件先被收到
  • 先发出拒绝，再发出承诺 - 如果承诺先被收到，则合同成立；相反，如果拒绝先被收到，则合同不成立†


在此案中，总经理发出了一封承诺该守门员要约的信，随后又发出了第二封拒绝该要约的信。因为承诺是先发出的，所以合同在承诺发出时即告成立。尽管该守门员在收到承诺之前先收到了总经理的拒绝信，这一点仍然成立（选项A）。因此，在该守门员和冰球队之间存在一份可执行的合同，因为球队在试图作出拒绝之前已经有效地承诺了该守门员的要约。

†然而，如果要约人先收到拒绝信并因此遭受了不利的信赖，则受要约人可能被禁止反言，不得强制执行该合同。

（选项B）“意思表示一致 (Meeting of the minds)” 指的是双方基于商定的条款达成成立合同的相互同意。在此案中，双方确实达成了意思表示一致，因为守门员要约为球队效力，年薪45万美元，而总经理承诺了该要约的条款。

（选项C）球队承担了受伤守门员康复的风险，这一事实会使其无法就合同的执行提出某些抗辩（例如，履行不能）。但本案的问题是双方是否成立了合同。

教学目标：当受要约人邮寄了承诺，随后又邮寄了拒绝时，合同在承诺发出时即告成立——无论哪封函件先被收到。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 63 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (time when acceptance takes effect).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Mailbox Rule
⚖️ 核心考点：邮箱规则 (Mailbox Rule)

本题考察的是邮箱规则在“先承诺后拒绝”这一特定顺序下的应用。

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 63 (Restatement (Second) of Contracts)，承诺 (Acceptance) 通常在发出 (Dispatch) 时生效，而不是收到时生效。

📅 案情时间轴分析

9月18日
守门员发出要约 (Offer)。
9月21日
总经理发出承诺信 (Acceptance Mailed)。
👉 合同在此刻成立！
9月22日
总经理发出拒绝信 (Rejection Mailed)。
9月25日
守门员收到拒绝信。
9月26日
守门员收到承诺信。

🔍 法律推理

本题的关键在于总经理先寄出了承诺信。

根据普通法规则：

  1. 承诺发出即生效： 当总经理在9月21日将承诺信投入邮箱时，合同已经成立 (Contract Formed)。
  2. 后续行为无效： 既然合同已经成立，9月22日发出的拒绝信实际上是无效的（或者只能被视为一种违约或解除合同的提议，但这不影响合同最初的成立）。
  3. 收到顺序无关紧要： 尽管守门员先收到了拒绝信，但这不能改变合同在9月21日已经成立的法律事实。

正确答案 D 准确指出了这一点：球队在试图拒绝之前，已经有效地承诺了要约。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A 错误

选项A认为“先收到拒绝”导致合同不成立。这混淆了两种情况。只有在“先发出拒绝，后发出承诺”的情况下，才看哪封信先到达。本题是“先承诺”，故承诺直接生效。
注：唯一的例外是如果要约人信赖了先收到的拒绝信并因此受损 (Estoppel)，但这是抗辩理由，不改变合同成立的事实。

选项 B 错误

“意思表示一致” (Meeting of the minds) 是通过客观行为判断的。总经理发出承诺信的客观行为已经构成了合意。

🎓 MBE 提分秘籍：
遇到“承诺”与“拒绝”并存的题目，画出时间轴，紧盯发出 (Sent) 的顺序：
  • 先承诺 ➡️ 后拒绝： 合同在承诺发出时成立。（本题情况）
  • 先拒绝 ➡️ 后承诺： 邮箱规则失效！看哪封信先被收到。

On June 1, a seller received a mail order from a buyer requesting prompt shipment of a specified computer model at the seller's current catalog price. On June 2, the seller mailed to the buyer a letter accepting the order and assuring the buyer that the computer would be shipped on June 3. On June 3, the seller realized that he was out of that computer model, shipped a different computer model to the buyer, and mailed a separate notice of accommodation. On June 5, the buyer received the seller's June 2 letter and the different computer model, but not the notice of accommodation.
On June 5, which of the following is a correct statement of the parties' legal rights and duties?

choices.a: The buyer can either accept or reject the different computer model and, in either event, recover damages, if any, for breach of contract.
choices.b: The buyer can either accept or reject the different computer model, but if he rejects it, he will thereby waive any remedy for breach of contract.
choices.c: The seller's notice of accommodation was timely mailed, and his shipment of the different computer model constituted a counteroffer.
choices.d: The seller's prompt shipment of nonconforming goods constituted an acceptance of the buyer's offer, thereby creating a contract for the sale of the different computer model.

data.questionStem:
Q81090

On June 1, a seller received a mail order from a buyer requesting prompt shipment of a specified computer model at the seller's current catalog price. On June 2, the seller mailed to the buyer a letter accepting the order and assuring the buyer that the computer would be shipped on June 3. On June 3, the seller realized that he was out of that computer model, shipped a different computer model to the buyer, and mailed a separate notice of accommodation. On June 5, the buyer received the seller's June 2 letter and the different computer model, but not the notice of accommodation.

On June 5, which of the following is a correct statement of the parties' legal rights and duties?

6月1日，卖方收到一份来自买方的邮购订单，要求以卖方当前的目录价格立即发运指定型号的电脑。6月2日，卖方邮寄给买方一封信函，接受了该订单，并向买方保证电脑将于6月3日发运。6月3日，卖方意识到该型号电脑已无库存，便向买方发运了另一不同型号的电脑，并另外邮寄了一份通融通知。6月5日，买方收到了卖方6月2日的信函和不同型号的电脑，但未收到通融通知。

在6月5日，以下哪项是关于双方当事人法律权利和义务的正确陈述？
options:
A. The buyer can either accept or reject the different computer model and, in either event, recover damages, if any, for breach of contract.
买方可以接受或拒绝该不同型号的电脑，并且无论接受或拒绝，均可就违约行为索赔（如有）损害赔偿。

B. The buyer can either accept or reject the different computer model, but if he rejects it, he will thereby waive any remedy for breach of contract.
买方可以接受或拒绝该不同型号的电脑，但如果他拒绝，他将因此放弃任何因违约而获得的救济。

C. The seller's notice of accommodation was timely mailed, and his shipment of the different computer model constituted a counteroffer.
卖方的通融通知已及时邮寄，其发运不同型号电脑的行为构成了一项反要约。

D. The seller's prompt shipment of nonconforming goods constituted an acceptance of the buyer's offer, thereby creating a contract for the sale of the different computer model.
卖方立即发运不符规定货物的行为构成了对买方要约的接受，从而就该不同型号的电脑订立了销售合同。
data.explanation:
Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code ( UCC ) governs contracts for the sale of goods (eg, computers). Under the UCC, a seller can accept a buyer's offer to purchase goods for prompt or immediate shipment by promising to ship, or shipping, the goods. Once the offer is accepted, the shipped goods must conform perfectly to the contract. Nonconformance is a breach that allows the buyer to accept or reject the goods in whole or in part. The buyer can also recover any damages suffered as a result of the breach.

Here, the buyer mailed an order to the seller requesting prompt shipment of a specified computer model. This was an offer that the seller could accept by promising to ship, or shipping, the computer. The seller promised to ship the computer. However, the seller breached the resulting contract by shipping a different, nonconforming computer model. As a result, the buyer can either accept or reject the different computer model and, in either event, recover any damages for breach of contract (Choice B).

(Choices C & D) The seller's shipment of the nonconforming computer was not an acceptance. That is because the seller had already accepted the buyer's offer by promising to ship the specified computer model. As a result, the notice of accommodation is irrelevant.

Educational objective: The UCC allows a buyer to accept or reject nonconforming goods in whole or in part and, in either event, recover damages for breach.



选项正确率统计：A选项 79%（正确选项），B选项 8%，C选项 11%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《美国统一商法典》(UCC) 第2条管辖货物销售合同（例如电脑）。根据UCC的规定，卖方可以通过承诺发运或实际发运货物的方式，来接受买方为立即或即时发运而发出的购货要约。一旦要约被接受，所发运的货物必须与合同完全相符。不符规定即构成违约，允许买方全部或部分地接受或拒绝该货物。买方还可以索赔因违约而遭受的任何损害赔偿。

在本案中，买方向卖方邮寄了一份订单，要求立即发运指定型号的电脑。这是一项要约，卖方可以通过承诺发运或实际发运电脑的方式来接受。卖方已承诺发运该电脑。然而，卖方发运了不同的、不符规定的电脑型号，从而违反了由此产生的合同。因此，买方可以接受或拒绝该不同型号的电脑，并且无论接受或拒绝，均可就违约行为索赔任何损害赔偿（选项A）。

（选项C和D）卖方发运不符规定电脑的行为并非一次接受。这是因为卖方已经通过承诺发运指定型号的电脑，从而接受了买方的要约。因此，该通融通知是无关紧要的。

教学目标：《美国统一商法典》(UCC) 允许买方全部或部分地接受或拒绝不符规定的货物，并且无论在哪种情况下，都可以就违约行为索赔损害赔偿。

References

U.C.C. § 2-206 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (offer and acceptance).

U.C.C. § 2-601 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's rights on improper delivery).

U.C.C. § 2-711 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's remedies for breach).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: UCC Offer & Acceptance
合同法：UCC 要约与承诺
💡 核心考点 (Key Concept) 本题考察《统一商法典》(UCC) 第 2-206 条关于承诺 (Acceptance) 的方式，以及通融 (Accommodation) 规则的适用前提。
📅 案情时间线分析
6月1日 (Offer)
买方发出要约，要求立即发货。
6月2日 (Acceptance)
关键点：卖方寄信承诺发货。
此时合同已经成立 (Contract Formed)。
6月3日 (Breach)
卖方发现缺货，发送了不同型号的电脑（不符货物），并附带通融通知。
⚖️ 法律推理 (Legal Reasoning)

1. 合同何时成立？
根据 UCC § 2-206(1)(b)，对于要求立即发货的要约，卖方可以通过两种方式承诺：

  • 承诺发货 (Promise to ship)
  • 实际发货 (Prompt shipment)
在本案中，卖方在6月2日寄出了接受订单的信函。根据投邮生效原则 (Mailbox Rule)，合同在这一刻已经成立。双方已受合同约束。

2. 为什么“通融”规则不适用？
UCC 规定，如果卖方直接发运不符货物作为对要约的回应，这通常构成“承诺+违约”。但如果卖方同时附带了通融通知 (Notice of Accommodation)，则该发货被视为反要约 (Counteroffer)，而不是承诺。
但是！通融规则仅适用于“发货行为本身是唯一的承诺方式”的情况。如果卖方已经通过“承诺发货”接受了要约（如本案6月2日的信），合同已经锁死。后续的发货只是履行合同的行为。

3. 法律后果
由于合同已于6月2日成立，卖方在6月3日发运错误型号的电脑属于违约 (Breach of Contract)。通融通知在法律上无效，不能将违约转化为反要约。

✅ 为什么选 A？

根据完美履行规则 (Perfect Tender Rule, UCC § 2-601)，当货物不符合同规定时，买方有三个选择：

  1. 拒绝所有货物 (Reject the whole)
  2. 接受所有货物 (Accept the whole)
  3. 接受部分商业单位并拒绝其余部分

无论买方选择接受还是拒绝，卖方发运错误货物都已构成违约，因此买方有权要求损害赔偿 (Damages)。选项 A 准确描述了这一权利。

❌ 选项 C 错误原因：
它错误地认为发货构成了反要约。实际上，因为卖方之前已经承诺（Promise），合同已成立，发货是违约履行，而非新的要约。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 看到“发运不符货物 (Nonconforming goods)”和“通融 (Accommodation)”时，必须先检查卖方是否已经通过承诺发货 (Promise to ship) 接受了要约。
  • 如果先承诺，后发货 ➡️ 违约 (Breach)。
  • 如果直接发货且附带通知 ➡️ 反要约 (Counteroffer)。

questions.question:
A testator, whose nephew was his only heir, died leaving a will that gave his entire estate to charity. His nephew, knowing full well that the testator was of sound mind all of his life, and having no evidence to the contrary, nevertheless filed a suit contesting the testator's will on the ground that the testator was incompetent when the will was signed. The testator's executor offered the nephew $5,000 to settle the suit, and the nephew agreed.
If the executor then repudiates the agreement and the foregoing facts are proved or admitted in the nephew's suit against the executor for breach of contract, is the nephew entitled to recover under the prevailing view?

choices.a: No, because an agreement to oust the court of its jurisdiction to decide a will contest is contrary to public policy.
choices.b: No, because the nephew did not bring the will contest in good faith.
choices.c: Yes, because the agreement was a bargained-for exchange.
choices.d: Yes, because the law encourages the settlement of disputed claims.

一位立遗嘱人去世，其侄子是他的唯一继承人。遗嘱将他的全部遗产赠与慈善机构。他的侄子，尽管完全清楚立遗嘱人一生心智健全，并且没有任何相反的证据，但仍以立遗嘱人签署遗嘱时无行为能力为由，提起诉讼对遗嘱提出异议。立遗嘱人的遗嘱执行人向侄子提供5000美元以和解此案，侄子同意了。

如果遗嘱执行人随后否认该协议，并且在侄子对遗嘱执行人提起的违约诉讼中，前述事实得到证实或承认，根据主流观点，侄子是否有权获得赔偿？
options:
A. No, because an agreement to oust the court of its jurisdiction to decide a will contest is contrary to public policy.
否，因为剥夺法院对遗嘱争议案件的管辖权的协议违反公共政策。

B. No, because the nephew did not bring the will contest in good faith.
否，因为侄子并非善意地提起遗嘱争议之诉。

C. Yes, because the agreement was a bargained-for exchange.
是，因为该协议是经过讨价还价的交换。

D. Yes, because the law encourages the settlement of disputed claims.
是，因为法律鼓励和解有争议的请求。
data.explanation:
A contract is generally formed when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration - ie, a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. A promise to surrender a claim or defense can serve as consideration for a settlement agreement so long as:
  • the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good-faith dispute, or
  • the surrendering party honestly believes that the claim or defense may be valid.
If the surrendering party knows that the claim or defense is invalid, an agreement to surrender it lacks consideration and is therefore unenforceable.

Here, the nephew agreed to settle his suit contesting the testator's will in exchange for $5,000. But the nephew did not honestly believe that his claim was valid (ie, he did not bring the will contest in good faith) since he knew that the testator was of sound mind his whole life and had no contrary evidence. Therefore, the nephew's settlement agreement with the executor is unenforceable for lack of bargained-for consideration, and the nephew is not entitled to recover (Choice C).

(Choices A & D) The law does encourage the settlement of legal claims - but not those brought in bad faith. Had the nephew brought the will contest in good faith, there would have been no issue with settling out of court.

Educational objective: A promise to surrender a claim or defense constitutes consideration for a settlement agreement so long as (1) the claim or defense is valid or subject to a good-faith dispute or (2) the surrendering party believes that the claim or defense may be valid.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 74%（正确选项），C选项 20%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一项共同协议得到有价值的对价——即，经讨价还价的允诺或履行的交换——支持时，合同通常即告成立。放弃某项请求或抗辩的允诺可以作为和解协议的对价，只要：
  • 该请求或抗辩是有效的，或属于善意争议的标的，或者
  • 放弃方真诚地相信该请求或抗辩可能是有效的。
如果放弃方明知其请求或抗辩是无效的，则放弃该请求或抗辩的协议因缺乏对价而不可强制执行。

在本案中，侄子同意以5000美元和解他对立遗嘱人遗嘱提出的争议之诉。但是，侄子并不真诚地相信他的请求是有效的（即，他并非善意地提起遗嘱争议之诉），因为他知道立遗嘱人一生心智健全，并且没有任何相反的证据。因此，侄子与遗嘱执行人达成的和解协议因缺乏交易对价而不可强制执行，侄子无权获得赔偿（选项C）。

（选项A和D）法律确实鼓励和解法律请求——但不是那些恶意提起的请求。如果侄子是善意地提起遗嘱争议之诉，那么庭外和解就不会有任何问题。

教学目标：放弃一项请求或抗辩的允诺构成和解协议的对价，只要（1）该请求或抗辩是有效的或属于善意争议的标的，或（2）放弃方相信该请求或抗辩可能是有效的。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (settlement of claims).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Consideration & Settlement

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule) 在合同法中，放弃起诉的权利 (Forbearance to sue) 可以构成有效的对价 (Consideration)，但必须满足以下条件之一：
  1. 该法律请求在客观上是有效的 (Valid)；或者
  2. 原告主观上真诚地相信 (Good faith belief) 该请求可能是有效的。
参考：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 74
案情逻辑分析
❌
关键事实：
侄子明知 (Knowing full well) 立遗嘱人神智健全，且没有任何相反证据。
侄子承诺放弃起诉
(Promise to surrender claim)
↓
检验标准：
他是善意 (Good Faith) 的吗？
或者请求是有效 (Valid) 的吗？
↓
都不是！
因此：没有对价 (No Consideration)

由于侄子明知自己的主张是虚假的（Sham claim），他的“放弃起诉”实际上没有放弃任何合法的权利，因此不构成法律认可的“受损” (Detriment)。

为什么选 B？

选项 B：否，因为侄子并非善意地提起遗嘱争议之诉。 正确答案

这是本题的直接法律依据。如果索赔方知道索赔是无效的（即恶意，Bad Faith），那么放弃该索赔就不能作为支持和解协议的对价。没有对价，和解协议（合同）就不可执行。

陷阱选项排除

选项 C (陷阱)：是，因为该协议是经过讨价还价的交换。

虽然表面上看有“讨价还价” (Bargained-for exchange) 的形式（放弃诉讼换取$5,000），但如果交换的东西（虚假诉讼）在法律眼中一文不值，那么这种交换就缺乏实质对价。恶意诉讼的放弃 = 零对价。

选项 D (政策)：是，因为法律鼓励和解有争议的请求。

法律确实鼓励和解，但前提是针对“善意争议” (Good-faith dispute)。法律绝不鼓励通过威胁提起毫无根据的诉讼来勒索和解金。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 在涉及“和解协议” (Settlement Agreement) 的题目中，一定要检查原告的主观心态：
  • 如果原告诚实地认为自己有理（哪怕后来证明他错了），和解协议有效。
  • 如果题目明确说原告“明知” (Knew) 自己没理，和解协议无效。
